  function updateEarnedStats()

      local c = localPlayer:GetAttribute("Screws")

      if c and e then
        startScrews = c
        startGears = e

        lastCheckedGears = startGears
        hasInitializedStats = true
      else
        return
      end

    local c = localPlayer:GetAttribute("Screws") or 0
    local e = localPlayer:GetAttribute("Gears") or 0
    local f = c - lastCheckedScrews
    if f > 0 then
      screwsEarnedThisSession = screwsEarnedThisSession + f
      lifetimeScrewsEarned = lifetimeScrewsEarned + f

      gearsEarnedThisSession = gearsEarnedThisSession + g
      lifetimeGearsEarned = lifetimeGearsEarned + g
    end
    lastCheckedGears = e
    saveLifetimeStats()
    if updateEarnedUI then
      pcall(updateEarnedUI)
    end
  end

  function toBase36(c)
    c = tonumber(c) or 0
    if c == 0 then
      return "0"
    end
    local e = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    local f = ""
    while c > 0 do
      local g = c % 36
      f = e:sub(g + 1, g + 1) .. f
      c = math.floor(c / 36)
    end
    return f
  end
  function fromBase36(c)
    if not c or c == "" then
      return "0"
    end
    local e = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    local f = 0
    for a = 1, #c, 1 do
      local b = c:sub(a, a)
      local d = e:find(b) or 1
      f = f * 36 + (d - 1)
    end
    return tostring(f)
  end

  local eb = "VD_Configs.json"
  local fb = "VD_Settings.json"
  local gb
  local hb
  local ib
  function serializeTable(c, e)
    if type(c) ~= "table" then
      return c
    end
    e = e or {}
    if e[c] then
      return nil
    end
    e[c] = true
    local f = {}
    for c, g in pairs(c) do
      if typeof(g) == "Color3" then
        f[c] = {
          ["__type"] = "Color3",
          ["r"] = math.round(g.R * 255),
          ["g"] = math.round(g.G * 255),
          ["b"] = math.round(g.B * 255)
        }
      elseif type(g) == "table" then
        local h = serializeTable(g, e)
        if h ~= nil then
          f[c] = h
        end
      elseif type(g) == "boolean" or type(g) == "number" or type(g) == "string" then
        f[c] = g
      end
    end
    return f
  end
  local function jb(c)
    if type(c) ~= "table" then
      return false
    end
    if c.__type == "Color3" then
      return true
    end
    if (c.r or c.R) and ((c.g or c.G) and (c.b or c.B)) then
      return true
    end
    if #c == 3 and (type(c[1]) == "number" and (type(c[2]) == "number" and type(c[3]) == "number")) then
      return true
    end
    return false
  end
  local function kb(c)
    local e = c.r or c.R or c[1]
    local f = c.g or c.G or c[2]
    local g = c.b or c.B or c[3]
    e = tonumber(e) or 255
    f = tonumber(f) or 255
    g = tonumber(g) or 255
    if e > 1 or f > 1 or g > 1 then
      return Color3.fromRGB(e, f, g)
    else
      return Color3.new(e, f, g)
    end
  end
  function deserializeTable(c, e)
    if type(c) ~= "table" or type(e) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    for e, f in pairs(e) do
      if type(f) == "table" then
        if jb(f) then
          c[e] = kb(f)
        else
          if type(c[e]) ~= "table" then
            c[e] = {}
          end
          deserializeTable(c[e], f)
        end
      else
        c[e] = f
      end
    end
  end
  local lb = serializeTable(v)
  local mb = {["activeProfile"] = "Default", ["profiles"] = {}}
  function saveConfigs()
    pcall(function()
      local c = writefile or make_writefile or syn and syn.writefile
      if not c then
        return
      end
      local e = {["activeProfile"] = mb.activeProfile, ["profiles"] = {}}
      for c, f in pairs(mb.profiles) do
        e.profiles[c] = serializeTable(f)
      end
      c(eb, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(e))
    end)
  end
  function loadConfigs()
    mb.profiles.Default = serializeTable(v)
    local c = readfile or make_readfile or syn and syn.readfile
    local e = isfile or syn and syn.isfile
    if c then
      if e and e(eb) then
        pcall(function()
          local e = c(eb)
          if e and e ~= "" then
            local c = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(e)
            if c and c.profiles then
              mb.activeProfile = c.activeProfile or "Default"
              for c, e in pairs(c.profiles) do
                local f = {}
                deserializeTable(f, serializeTable(v))
                deserializeTable(f, e)
                mb.profiles[c] = f
              end
            end
          end
        end)
      elseif e and e(fb) then
        pcall(function()
          local e = c(fb)
          if e and e ~= "" then
            local c = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(e)
            if c then
              local e = {}
              deserializeTable(e, serializeTable(v))
              deserializeTable(e, c)
              mb.profiles.Default = e
              saveConfigs()
            end
          end
        end)
      end
    end
  end

  function loadSettings()
    loadConfigs()
    local c = mb.profiles[mb.activeProfile]
    if c then
      deserializeTable(v, c)
    else
      mb.activeProfile = "Default"
      deserializeTable(v, mb.profiles.Default)
    end
    if v.FirstRunVersion ~= "vv1.7.0_Premium" then
      v.FirstRunVersion = "vv1.7.0_Premium"
      saveSettings()
    end
    normalizeSettings()
    if not q() then
      pcall(D)
    end
  end
  function saveSettings()
    if mb.profiles[mb.activeProfile] == nil then
      mb.profiles[mb.activeProfile] = {}
    end
    mb.profiles[mb.activeProfile] = serializeTable(v)
    saveConfigs()
  end
  function loadProfile(c)
    local e = mb.profiles[c]
    if not e then
      return
    end
    mb.activeProfile = c
    deserializeTable(v, e)
    if v.RevolverAutofarm and q() then
      v.InstantHeal = true
    end
    normalizeSettings()
    saveConfigs()
    pcall(D)
    if applyPerformanceMode then
      pcall(applyPerformanceMode)
    end
    if applyFPSCap then
      pcall(applyFPSCap)
    end
    if w then
      pcall(w)
    end
  end

  function getDistance(c, e)
    local f = P
    if not f then
      local c = localPlayer.Character
      f = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not f then
        return math.huge
      end
    end
    local g = e
    if not g then
      if c:IsA("Player") then
        local e = c.Character
        g = e and e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      elseif c:IsA("Model") then
        g = c.PrimaryPart or c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
      elseif c:IsA("BasePart") then
        g = c
      end
    end
    if g then
      return math.round((f.Position - g.Position).Magnitude)
    end
    return math.huge
  end

  function updateTelemetryAndAFKStates()
    local c = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name or ""
    if c ~= _G.VD_FarmState.farmLastTeamName then
      _G.VD_FarmState.farmTeamStartTime = tick()
      _G.VD_FarmState.farmLastTeamName = c
      _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime = 0
      _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime = 0
    end
    local e = localPlayer.Character
    local f = e and e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if c == "Killer" and f then
      if _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime == 0 then
        _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime = tick()
      end
    elseif c ~= "Killer" then
      _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime = 0
    end
    if c == "Survivors" and f then
      if _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime == 0 then
        _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime = tick()
      end
    elseif c ~= "Survivors" then
      _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime = 0
    end
    local g = tick() - (_G.VD_FarmState.farmTeamStartTime or 0)
    if v.AutoFarmAFKTotal then
      if c == "Survivors" then
        local c = _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime > 0 and tick() - _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime or 0
        if _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime == 0 or c < 15 then
          v.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
          v.AutoFarmKiller = false
          if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
            pcall(function()
              _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
            end)
          end
          if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
            pcall(function()
              _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
            end)
          end
          local e = math.ceil(15 - c)
          updateStatus(string.format("WAITING (%ds)", e > 0 and e or 15))
        else
          local c = e and (ob(e, "Knocked") == true or e:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true)
          local f = e and (ob(e, "IsHooked") == true or e:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true)
          if c or f then
            v.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
            v.AutoFarmKiller = false
            if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
              pcall(function()
                _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
              end)
            end
            if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
              pcall(function()
                _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
              end)
            end
            updateStatus("PAUSED (Knocked/Hooked)")
          else
            v.AutoFarmSurvivor = true
            v.AutoFarmKiller = false
            if _G.VD_FarmState.lastRoundScanned ~= _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime then
              _G.VD_FarmState.lastRoundScanned = _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime
              pcall(scanMapObjects)
              pcall(scanRemotes)
            end
            if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
              pcall(function()
                _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(true)
              end)
            end
            if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
              pcall(function()
                _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
              end)
            end
            if v.AutoPumpkin then
              local c = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
              if c and (c ~= "Idle" and (c ~= "IDLE" and c ~= "OFF")) then
                updateStatus(c)
              else
                updateStatus("RUNNING (Auto Pumpkin)")
              end
            else
              local c = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
              if c and (c ~= "Idle" and c ~= "IDLE") then
                updateStatus(c)
              else
                updateStatus("RUNNING (Survivor Farm)")
              end
            end
          end
        end
      elseif c == "Killer" then
        local c = _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime > 0 and tick() - _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime or 0
        if _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime == 0 or c < 15 then
          v.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
          v.AutoFarmKiller = false
          if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
            pcall(function()
              _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
            end)
          end
          if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
            pcall(function()
              _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
            end)
          end
          local e = math.ceil(15 - c)
          updateStatus(string.format("WAITING (%ds)", e > 0 and e or 15))
        else
          v.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
          v.AutoFarmKiller = true
          if _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerRoundScanned ~= _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime then
            _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerRoundScanned = _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime
            pcall(scanMapObjects)
            pcall(scanRemotes)
          end
          if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
            pcall(function()
              _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
            end)
          end
          if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
            pcall(function()
              _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(true)
            end)
          end
          local c = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
          if c and (c ~= "Idle" and c ~= "IDLE") then
            updateStatus(c)
          else
            updateStatus("RUNNING (Killer Farm)")
          end
        end
      else
        v.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
        v.AutoFarmKiller = false
        if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
          pcall(function()
            _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
          end)
        end
        if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
          pcall(function()
            _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
          end)
        end
        updateStatus("PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)")
      end
    else
      if v.AutoPumpkin then
        local c = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
        if c and (c ~= "Idle" and (c ~= "IDLE" and c ~= "OFF")) then
          updateStatus(c)
        else
          updateStatus("RUNNING (Auto Pumpkin)")
        end
      elseif v.AutoFarmSurvivor then
        if c == "Survivors" or c ~= "Killer" and (c ~= "Spectators" and c ~= "Spectator") then
          local c = e and (ob(e, "Knocked") == true or e:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true)
          local f = e and (ob(e, "IsHooked") == true or e:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true)
          if c or f then
            updateStatus("PAUSED (Knocked/Hooked)")
          else
            local c = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
            if c and (c ~= "Idle" and c ~= "IDLE") then
              updateStatus(c)
            else
              updateStatus("RUNNING (Survivor Farm)")
            end
          end
        elseif c == "Killer" then
          updateStatus("PAUSED (Killer Team)")
        else
          updateStatus("PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)")
        end
      elseif v.AutoFarmKiller then
        if c == "Killer" then
          local c = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
          if c and (c ~= "Idle" and c ~= "IDLE") then
            updateStatus(c)
          else
            updateStatus("RUNNING (Killer Farm)")
          end
        elseif c == "Survivors" then
          updateStatus("PAUSED (Survivor Team)")
        else
          updateStatus("PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)")
        end
      elseif v.AutoServerHopEscape then
        local c = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
        if c and (c ~= "Idle" and (c ~= "IDLE" and c ~= "OFF")) then
          updateStatus(c)
        else
          updateStatus("RUNNING (Hop Escape)")
        end
      elseif v.InstantFinishlineEscape then
        if c == "Survivors" or c ~= "Killer" and (c ~= "Spectators" and c ~= "Spectator") then
          local c = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
          if c and (c ~= "Idle" and c ~= "IDLE") then
            updateStatus(c)
          else
            updateStatus("RUNNING (Instant Escape)")
          end
        elseif c == "Killer" then
          updateStatus("PAUSED (Killer Team)")
        else
          updateStatus("WAITING FOR MATCH (Lobby)")
        end
      else
        updateStatus("OFF")
      end
    end
  end
  function isSurvivorFarmAllowed()
    if not v.AutoFarmSurvivor then
      return false
    end
    local c = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name or ""
    if c ~= "Survivors" then
      return false
    end
    if (_G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime or 0) == 0 then
      return false
    end
    local e = tick() - (_G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime or 0)
    if e < 15 then
      return false
    end
    local f = localPlayer.Character
    local g = f and (ob(f, "Knocked") == true or f:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true)
    local h = f and (ob(f, "IsHooked") == true or f:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true)
    if g or h then
      return false
    end
    return true
  end
  function isKillerFarmAllowed()
    if not v.AutoFarmKiller then
      return false
    end
    local c = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name or ""
    if c ~= "Killer" then
      return false
    end
    if (_G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime or 0) == 0 then
      return false
    end
    local e = tick() - (_G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime or 0)
    if e < 15 then
      return false
    end
    return true
  end

    return v.ESPColors[c] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

  function getSelectedKiller(c)
    if typeof(c) == "Instance" and c:IsA("Model") then
      local e = c:GetAttribute("SelectedKiller")
      if e ~= nil then
        return tostring(e)
      end
      return tostring(c.Name)
    end
    local e = c:GetAttribute("SelectedKiller")
    if e ~= nil then
      return tostring(e)
    end
    local f = c:FindFirstChild("SelectedKiller")
    if f and (f:IsA("StringValue") or f:IsA("ValueObject")) then
      return tostring(f.Value)
    end
    if c.Character then
      local e = c.Character:GetAttribute("SelectedKiller")
      if e ~= nil then
        return tostring(e)
      end
    end
    return "None"
  end
  function getPlayerHealthPercent(c)
    local e = typeof(c) == "Instance" and (c:IsA("Model") and c) or c and c.Character
    if e then
      local c = e:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if c then
        return c.Health, c.MaxHealth
      end
    end
    return 100, 100
  end
  function getGeneratorProgress(c)
    local e = c:GetAttribute("RepairProgress")
    if e == nil then
      local f = c:FindFirstChild("RepairProgress")
      if f and f:IsA("ValueObject") then
        e = f.Value
      end
    end
    if not e then
      return 0
    end
    local f = tonumber(e)
    if f then
      if f <= 1.01 and f > 0 then
        return math.round(f * 100)
      else
        return math.round(f)
      end
    end
    return 0
  end
  local pb = setmetatable({}, {["__mode"] = "k"})
  function isGeneratorRegressing(c)
    if not c then
      return false
    end
    local e = c:GetAttribute("Regressing")
    if e ~= nil then
      return e == true
    end
    local f, g = pcall(function()
      local e = c:FindFirstChild("Regressing")
      if e then
        if e:IsA("ValueObject") or e:IsA("BoolValue") then
          return e.Value == true
        end
        return true
      end
      return c.Regressing == true
    end)
    if f and g == true then
      return true
    end
    local h = c:FindFirstChild("HitBox") or c:FindFirstChild("Hitbox") or c:FindFirstChild("Engine") or c:IsA("Model") and c.PrimaryPart or c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if h then
      local c = h:GetAttribute("Regressing")
      if c == true then
        return true
      end
      local e = h:FindFirstChild("Regressing")
      if e then
        if e:IsA("ValueObject") or e:IsA("BoolValue") then
          return e.Value == true
        end
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  function getGeneratorAnalytics(c)
    if not c then
      return 0, nil, ""
    end
    local e = pb[c]
    if not e then
      return 0, nil, ""
    end
    return e.smoothedSpeed or 0, e.etaSeconds, e.etaFormatted or ""
  end
  local function qb()
    local c = tick()
    local e = v.MasterESP and (v.GeneratorESP and (v.GeneratorESP.Enabled and v.GeneratorESP.AlertThresholdEnabled))
    local f = v.GeneratorESP and v.GeneratorESP.AlertThreshold or 90
    for g, h in ipairs(cachedGenerators or {}) do
      if not h or not h.Parent then
        continue
      end
      if isGeneratorCompleted(h) then
        pb[h] = nil
        continue
      end
      local i = getGeneratorProgress(h)
      local j = pb[h]
      if not j then
        pb[h] = {
          ["lastProgress"] = i,
          ["lastTime"] = c,
          ["history"] = {},
          ["smoothedSpeed"] = 0,
          ["smoothedETA"] = nil,
          ["etaSeconds"] = nil,
          ["etaFormatted"] = "",
          ["alertTriggered"] = i >= f
        }
        continue
      end
      local k = c - j.lastTime
      if k >= .75 then
        local g = i - j.lastProgress
        local l = isGeneratorRegressing(h)
        local m = 0
        if g ~= 0 then
          m = g / k
        elseif l then
          if j.smoothedSpeed and j.smoothedSpeed < 0 then
            m = j.smoothedSpeed
          else
            m = -0.5
          end
        else
          m = 0
        end
        table.insert(j.history, m)
        if #j.history > 5 then
          table.remove(j.history, 1)
        end
        local n = 0
        for c, e in ipairs(j.history) do
          n = n + e
        end
        local o = n / #j.history
        local p = j.smoothedSpeed or 0
        local q = p + (o - p) * .25
        if math.abs(q) < .05 then
          q = 0
        end
        local r = nil
        local s = ""
        if q > .1 then
          local c = 100 - i
          local e = math.max(0, c / q)
          local f = j.smoothedETA or e
          local g = f + (e - f) * .2
          j.smoothedETA = g
          r = g
          if r < 60 then
            s = string.format("%ds", math.ceil(r))
          else
            local c = math.floor(r / 60)
            local e = math.ceil(r % 60)
            s = string.format("%dm %02ds", c, e)
          end
        else
          j.smoothedETA = nil
        end
        j.smoothedSpeed = q
        j.etaSeconds = r
        j.etaFormatted = s
        j.lastProgress = i
        j.lastTime = c
        if e then
          if i >= f then
            if not j.alertTriggered then
              j.alertTriggered = true
              local c = j.etaFormatted and j.etaFormatted ~= "" and "ETA: " .. j.etaFormatted or "Nearly Complete!"
              showNotification("Generator Alert", string.format("Generator reached %d%% progress! (%s)", math.floor(i), c), "warning")
            end
          else
            if i < f - 5 then
              j.alertTriggered = false
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local rb = 0
  registerConnection(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local c = tick()
    local e = v.PerformanceMode and 1.2 or .4
    if c - rb < e then
      return
    end
    rb = c
    qb()
  end))
  local function sb(e)
    if not q() then
      return
    end
    if not e or not e:IsA("Model") then
      return
    end
    local f = v.CustomGenSound
    if not f or not f.Enabled then
      return
    end
    local g = c or _G.VD_PremiumHooks
    if g and type(g.CustomGenSound) == "function" then
      pcall(g.CustomGenSound, e, f.SoundId, f.Volume)
    end
  end
  function applyCustomSoundToAllGens()
    local c = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    local e = c and c:FindFirstChild("Generators")
    local f = e and e:GetChildren() or cachedGenerators or {}
    for a, b in ipairs(f) do
      sb(b)
    end
  end
  local tb = nil
  function playSoundPreview(c)
    if not q() then
      showNotification("Premium Feature +", "Unlock the Premium version to use this feature!", "warning")
      return
    end
    if tb then
      pcall(function()
        tb:Stop()
        tb:Destroy()
      end)
      tb = nil
    end
    local function e(c)
      if not c or c == "" then
        return "rbxassetid://124429695332529"
      end
      if type(c) == "number" then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(c)
      end
      local e = tostring(c):gsub("%s+", "")
      if e:find("^rbxassetid://") or e:find("^http") or e:find("^assetgame") then
        return e
      end
      local f = e:match("%d+")
      if f then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. f
      end
      return e
    end
    local f = e(c)
    local g = v.CustomGenSound and v.CustomGenSound.Volume or 1
    tb = Instance.new("Sound")
    tb.SoundId = f
    tb.Volume = g
    tb.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentCamera") or workspace
    tb:Play()
    showNotification("Sound Preview", "Playing sound: " .. f, "info")
    task.delay(4, function()
      if tb then
        pcall(function()
          tb:Stop()
          tb:Destroy()
        end)
        tb = nil
      end
    end)
  end
  registerConnection(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(c)
    if not c:IsA("Sound") then
      return
    end
    if c.Name == "Done" then
      local e = c.Parent
      if e and ((e.Name == "HitBox" or e.Name == "Hitbox") and e.Parent) then
        sb(e.Parent)
      end
    end
  end))

  end,
    ["isCached"] = function(...)
    if c and c.IsDBDHudCached then
      return c.IsDBDHudCached(...)
    end
    return false
  end,

    if _G.VD_DBD_HUD_Listeners == nil then
      _G.VD_DBD_HUD_Listeners = {}
    end
    table.insert(_G.VD_DBD_HUD_Listeners, c)
  end

  function isGeneratorCompleted(c)
    local e = c:GetAttribute("Completed")
    if e == nil then
      local f = c:FindFirstChild("Completed")
      if f and f:IsA("BoolValue") then
        e = f.Value
      end
    end
    if e == true or e == "true" or tostring(e):lower() == "true" then
      return true
    end
    return false
  end
  function isGeneratorPaused(c)
    if not c then
      return false
    end
    local e = c:GetAttribute("ProgressPaused")
    if e == nil then
      local f = c:FindFirstChild("ProgressPaused")
      if f and f:IsA("ValueBase") then
        e = f.Value
      end
    end
    return e == true or e == "true" or tostring(e):lower() == "true"
  end
  function getGatePartSafe(c)
    if not c or typeof(c) ~= "Instance" or not c.Parent then
      return nil
    end
    if c:IsA("BasePart") then
      return c
    end
    local e = c.Name == "ExitLever" and c or c:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true) or c:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
    if e then
      local c = e:FindFirstChild("Main") or e:IsA("BasePart") and e or e:IsA("Model") and e.PrimaryPart or e:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or e:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
      if c then
        return c
      end
    end
    if c:IsA("Model") and c.PrimaryPart then
      return c.PrimaryPart
    end
    return c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
  end
  function getGateProgress(c)
    if not c then
      return 0
    end
    local function e(c)
      if not c then
        return nil
      end
      local e = c:GetAttribute("ActivationProgress") or c:GetAttribute("Progress") or c:GetAttribute("RepairProgress")
      if e == nil then
        local f = c:FindFirstChild("ActivationProgress") or c:FindFirstChild("Progress")
        if f and f:IsA("ValueObject") then
          e = f.Value
        end
      end
      if e ~= nil then
        local c = tonumber(e)
        if c then
          if c <= 1.01 and c > 0 then
            return math.round(c * 100)
          else
            return math.round(c)
          end
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
    local f = e(c)
    if f then
      return f
    end
    local g = c.Name == "ExitLever" and c or c:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true) or c:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
    if g then
      local c = e(g)
      if c then
        return c
      end
      local f = g:FindFirstChild("Main") or g:IsA("BasePart") and g or g:IsA("Model") and g.PrimaryPart or g:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
      if f then
        local a = e(f)
        if a then
          return a
        end
      end
    end
    local h = c:FindFirstChild("Main", true)
    if h then
      local c = e(h)
      if c then
        return c
      end
    end
    if c.Parent and c.Parent ~= workspace then
      local f = e(c.Parent)
      if f then
        return f
      end
      if c.Parent.Parent and c.Parent.Parent ~= workspace then
        local f = e(c.Parent.Parent)
        if f then
          return f
        end
      end
    end
    return 0
  end
  function isSpectating()
    if localPlayer and localPlayer.Team then
      local c = localPlayer.Team.Name
      if c == "Spectator" or c == "Spectators" then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  nb = function(c, e, f)
    if not c then
      return
    end
    if c:GetAttribute(e) ~= nil then
      c:SetAttribute(e, f)
      return
    end
    local g = c:FindFirstChild(e)
    if g and g:IsA("ValueBase") then
      g.Value = f
      return
    end
    c:SetAttribute(e, f)
  end
  ob = function(c, e)
    if not c then
      return nil
    end
    local f = c:GetAttribute(e)
    if f ~= nil then
      return f
    end
    local g = c:FindFirstChild(e)
    if g and g:IsA("ValueBase") then
      return g.Value
    end
    return nil
  end
  local vb = false
  local wb = nil
  function safeSegmentedTeleport(c, e, f)
    if not c or not c.Parent then
      return
    end
    if vb then
      if wb then
        pcall(function()
          wb:Cancel()
        end)
      end
    end
    vb = true
    local g, h = pcall(function()
      local g = typeof(e) == "CFrame" and e.Position or e
      local h = typeof(e) == "CFrame" and e or CFrame.new(g)
      local i = c.CFrame
      local j = i.Position
      local k = (g - j).Magnitude
      if k <= 2 then
        c.CFrame = h
        pcall(function()
          c.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
          c.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end)
        return
      end
      local l = f or v.SafeTpSpeed or 14
      if l > 22 then
        l = 22
      end
      if l < 6 then
        l = 6
      end
      local m = k / math.max(l, 1)
      local n = c.Parent
      local o = n and n:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local p = {}
      if n and n:IsA("Model") then
        for c, e in ipairs(n:GetDescendants()) do
          if e:IsA("BasePart") and e.CanCollide then
            p[e] = true
            e.CanCollide = false
          end
        end
      end
      local q = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        if n and n.Parent then
          for c, e in ipairs(n:GetDescendants()) do
            if e:IsA("BasePart") and e.CanCollide then
              e.CanCollide = false
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      local r = v.UndergroundTP == true and k > 12
      local s = v.UndergroundDepth or 8.5
      if r then
        pcall(function()
          c.CFrame = c.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, s, 0)
        end)
      end
      local t = g - j
      local u = Vector3.new(t.X, 0, t.Z)
      local w = r and h - Vector3.new(0, s, 0) or h
      if u.Magnitude > .01 then
        local c = r and g - Vector3.new(0, s, 0) or g
        w = CFrame.new(c, c + u.Unit)
      end
      local x = TweenInfo.new(m, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
      local y = TweenService:Create(c, x, {["CFrame"] = w})
      wb = y
      local z = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not c or not c.Parent then
          return
        end
        pcall(function()
          local e = t.Unit
          c.AssemblyLinearVelocity = e * l
          c.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
          if o and o.Health > 0 then
            o:Move(Vector3.new(e.X, 0, e.Z), false)
            o:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
          end
        end)
      end)
      y:Play()
      local A = tick()
      local B = m + 2
      local C = false
      local D
      D = y.Completed:Connect(function()
        C = true
      end)
      while not C and tick() - A < B do
        task.wait(.05)
        if not c or not c.Parent then
          break
        end
        local e = (g - c.Position).Magnitude
        if e > k + 15 then
          pcall(function()
            y:Cancel()
          end)
          break
        end
      end
      if D then
        pcall(function()
          D:Disconnect()
        end)
      end
      if z then
        pcall(function()
          z:Disconnect()
        end)
      end
      if q then
        pcall(function()
          q:Disconnect()
        end)
      end
      if c and c.Parent then
        c.CFrame = h
        pcall(function()
          c.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
          c.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
          if o and o.Health > 0 then
            o:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
          end
        end)
      end
      for c in pairs(p) do
        if c and c.Parent then
          pcall(function()
            c.CanCollide = true
          end)
        end
      end
      task.wait(.05)
    end)
    wb = nil
    vb = false
    return g
  end

  function applyLocalPlayerModifiers()
    local c = localPlayer.Team
    local e = c and c.Name
    local f = v.ModifierTeamFilter or "Both"
    local g = false
    if f == "Both" then
      g = not e or e ~= "Spectators" and e ~= "Spectator"
    elseif f == "Survivors" then
      g = not e or e ~= "Killer" and e ~= "Spectators"
    elseif f == "Killer" then
      g = e == "Killer"
    end
    if not g and v.SpeedBoostEnabled then
      v.SpeedBoostEnabled = false
      pcall(saveSettings)
      if w then
        pcall(w)
      end
      showNotification("Speed Boost", "Disabled: Speed Boost team filter active!", "warning")
    end
    local h = localPlayer.Name
    if not h then
      return
    end
    local i = {}
    if localPlayer.Character then
      table.insert(i, localPlayer.Character)
    end
    local j = workspace:FindFirstChild(h)
    if j and j:IsA("Model") then
      if not table.find(i, j) then
        table.insert(i, j)
      end
    end
    local k = {"climb_obsessing", "climb_collisoning", "climb_collisioning", "climb_colliding"}
    for c, e in ipairs(k) do
      local f = workspace:FindFirstChild(e)
      if f then
        local c = f:FindFirstChild(h)
        if c and c:IsA("Model") then
          if not table.find(i, c) then
            table.insert(i, c)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for c, e in ipairs(i) do
      local f = g and v.VaultSpeed or 1
      nb(e, "vaultspeed", f)
    end
  end
  local Bb = nil
  if not Bb then
    Bb = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      if not activeLoop then
        return
      end
      if not v.SpeedBoostEnabled then
        return
      end
      local c = localPlayer.Character
      if not c then
        return
      end
      local e = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local f = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not e or not f or e.Health <= 0 then
        return
      end
      local g = localPlayer.Team
      local h = g and g.Name
      local i = v.ModifierTeamFilter or "Both"
      if i == "Survivors" and h == "Killer" then
        return
      end
      if i == "Killer" and h ~= "Killer" then
        return
      end
      if h == "Spectators" or h == "Spectator" then
        return
      end
      if c:GetAttribute("IsStunned") == true or c:GetAttribute("Immobile") == true or c:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true or c:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true or c:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true then
        return
      end
      local j = e.MoveDirection
      if j.Magnitude > .05 then
        local e = c:GetAttribute("Speed") or 16
        local g = tonumber(v.SpeedBoost) or 1.3
        if v.CountSpeedPerks then
          local e = c:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1
          g = e + (g - 1)
        end
        local i = tick()
        local k = h ~= "Killer"
        if k and (v.SimulateQuickRecovery and i < (_G.VD_QuickRecoveryBoostEnd or 0)) then
          g = g + .4
        end
        if k and (v.SimulatePerfectLanding and i < (_G.VD_PerfectLandingBoostEnd or 0)) then
          g = g + .4
        end
        if v.AntiRubberbandSpeed ~= false then
          local c = tonumber(v.SafeSpeedCap) or 1.35
          if g > c then
            g = c
          end
        end
        local l = e * g
        local m = Vector3.new(j.X, 0, j.Z).Unit
        local n = f.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        f.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(m.X * l, n.Y, m.Z * l)
      end
    end)
    registerConnection(Bb)
  end
  cachedGenerators = {}

  local function Cb(c)
    if not c or not c.Parent then
      return
    end
    local e = c.ClassName
    if e ~= "Model" and (e ~= "Part" and e ~= "Folder") then
      return
    end
    local f = c.Name
    if f == "Generator" and c:IsA("Model") then
      if not table.find(cachedGenerators, c) then
        table.insert(cachedGenerators, c)
      end
    elseif c:IsA("Model") and (c.Parent and c.Parent.Name == "Pallets" or c.Name == "Pallet" or c:FindFirstChild("Intact")) then
      if not table.find(cachedPallets, c) then
        table.insert(cachedPallets, c)
      end
    elseif f == "Window" or f:lower():find("window") or f == "Vault" or f:lower():find("vault") then
      local e = false
      local f = false
      local g = false
      for c, h in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
        local i = h.Name:lower()
        if i == "bottom" then
          e = true
        elseif i == "inviswall" then
          f = true
        elseif i == "vaulttrigger" then
          g = true
        end
      end
      if e and (f and g) then
        if not table.find(cachedVaults, c) then
          table.insert(cachedVaults, c)
        end
      end
    elseif f == "VaultTrigger" or f:lower():find("vaulttrigger") then
      local e = c.Parent
      if e and (e:IsA("Model") or e:IsA("Folder")) then
        local c = false
        local f = false
        for e, g in ipairs(e:GetDescendants()) do
          local h = g.Name:lower()
          if h == "bottom" then
            c = true
          elseif h == "inviswall" then
            f = true
          end
        end
        if c and f then
          if not table.find(cachedVaults, e) then
            table.insert(cachedVaults, e)
          end
        end
      end
    elseif f == "BloodEffect" and c:IsA("BasePart") then
      if not table.find(cachedBloodEffects, c) then
        table.insert(cachedBloodEffects, c)
      end
    elseif f == "Hook" or f == "HookPoint" then
      local e = Players:GetPlayers()
      local f = {}
      for c, e in ipairs(e) do
        if e.Character then
          f[e.Character] = true
        end
      end
      local g = false
      local h = c
      while h and h ~= workspace do
        if f[h] then
          g = true
          break
        end
        h = h.Parent
      end
      if not g then
        local e = nil
        if c:IsA("BasePart") then
          e = c
        elseif c:IsA("Model") or c:IsA("Folder") then
          e = c:FindFirstChild("HookPoint") or c:IsA("Model") and c.PrimaryPart or c:FindFirstChild("Handle") or c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        end
        if e then
          if not table.find(cachedHooks, e) then
            table.insert(cachedHooks, e)
          end
        end
      end
    elseif (f == "ExitLever" or c:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true) or c:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")) and not (f:lower():find("spot") or f:lower():find("spawn") or f:lower():find("marker") or f:lower():find("point")) then
      local e = c.Name == "ExitLever" and c or c:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true) or c:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
      if e and not table.find(cachedGates, e) then
        table.insert(cachedGates, e)
      end
    elseif f == "BearTrap" or CollectionService and CollectionService:HasTag(c, "BearTrap") then
      if not table.find(cachedBearTraps, c) then
        table.insert(cachedBearTraps, c)
      end
    elseif c.Parent and c.Parent.Name == "Pumpkins" or f:lower():find("pumpkin") and f ~= "Pumpkins" then
      if not c:IsA("Folder") then
        local e = c:IsA("Model") and c or c:IsA("BasePart") and c
        if e and not table.find(cachedPumpkins, e) then
          table.insert(cachedPumpkins, e)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function Db(c)
    if not c then
      return
    end
    local e = c.Name
    if e == "Generator" then
      local e = table.find(cachedGenerators, c)
      if e then
        table.remove(cachedGenerators, e)
      end
      pcall(function()
        removeModelESP(c, "Generator")
      end)
    elseif e == "Pallet" or c.Parent and c.Parent.Name == "Pallets" or table.find(cachedPallets, c) then
      local e = table.find(cachedPallets, c)
      if e then
        table.remove(cachedPallets, e)
      end
      pcall(function()
        removeModelESP(c, "Pallet")
      end)
    elseif e == "Window" or e:lower():find("window") or e == "Vault" or e:lower():find("vault") then
      local e = table.find(cachedVaults, c)
      if e then
        table.remove(cachedVaults, e)
      end
      pcall(function()
        removeModelESP(c, "Vault")
      end)
    elseif e == "VaultTrigger" or e:lower():find("vaulttrigger") then
      local e = c.Parent
      if e then
        local c = table.find(cachedVaults, e)
        if c then
          table.remove(cachedVaults, c)
        end
        pcall(function()
          removeModelESP(e, "Vault")
        end)
      end
    elseif e == "BloodEffect" then
      local e = table.find(cachedBloodEffects, c)
      if e then
        table.remove(cachedBloodEffects, e)
      end
      pcall(function()
        removeModelESP(c, "BloodEffect")
      end)
    elseif e == "Hook" or e == "HookPoint" then
      local e = table.find(cachedHooks, c)
      if e then
        table.remove(cachedHooks, e)
        pcall(function()
          removeModelESP(c, "Hook")
        end)
      else
        for e = #cachedHooks, 1, -1 do
          local f = cachedHooks[e]
          if f == c or f:IsDescendantOf(c) then
            table.remove(cachedHooks, e)
            pcall(function()
              removeModelESP(f, "Hook")
            end)
          end
        end
      end
    elseif e == "Gate" or e == "ESCAPEGATE" or e == "ExitLever" or table.find(cachedGates, c) then
      local e = table.find(cachedGates, c)
      if e then
        table.remove(cachedGates, e)
      end
      pcall(function()
        removeModelESP(c, "Gate")
      end)
    elseif e == "BearTrap" then
      local e = table.find(cachedBearTraps, c)
      if e then
        table.remove(cachedBearTraps, e)
      end
      pcall(function()
        removeModelESP(c, "BearTrap")
      end)
    elseif e == "Pumpkin" or c.Parent and c.Parent.Name == "Pumpkins" or table.find(cachedPumpkins, c) then
      local e = table.find(cachedPumpkins, c)
      if e then
        table.remove(cachedPumpkins, e)
      end
      pcall(function()
        removeModelESP(c, "Pumpkins")
      end)
    end
  end

  local Gb = {}
  function updateSCPCache()
    local c = {}
    local e = {}
    local function f(f)
      if f and not e[f] then
        e[f] = true
        table.insert(c, f)
      end
    end
    local g = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if g then
      for c, e in ipairs({"1", "2"}) do
        local h = g:FindFirstChild(e)
        if h then
          for c, e in ipairs(h:GetChildren()) do
            if e:IsA("Model") then
              f(e)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local function c(c)
        return string.match(c:lower(), "^scp%d*$") ~= nil
      end
      for e, g in ipairs(g:GetChildren()) do
        if g.Name ~= "1" and g.Name ~= "2" then
          if g:IsA("Model") and c(g.Name) then
            f(g)
          elseif g:IsA("Folder") or g:IsA("Model") then
            for e, g in ipairs(g:GetChildren()) do
              if g:IsA("Model") and c(g.Name) then
                f(g)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      for c, e in ipairs(g:GetChildren()) do
        if e:IsA("Model") and e ~= localPlayer.Character then
          local c = e:GetAttribute("Cured")
          if tonumber(c) == 3 then
            f(e)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    Gb = c
  end
  local Hb = nil
  local Ib = "Unknown Map"
  function getMapName()
    local c, e = pcall(function()
      return game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Darkness.Frame.MapInfo.MapTitle.Text
    end)
    if c and (e and e ~= "") then
      if e:upper() == "NOSTROMO" then
        return "Loading..."
      end
      return e
    end
    local f = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if not f then
      Hb = nil
      Ib = "Unknown Map"
      return Ib
    end
    local g = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("Model") or f:FindFirstChildOfClass("Folder") or f
    if g == Hb and Ib ~= "Unknown Map" then
      return Ib
    end
    Hb = g
    if f:FindFirstChild("HooksMeat", true) then
      Ib = "BLOODBATH! Club"
      return Ib
    end
    if f:FindFirstChild("Rooftop", true) then
      Ib = "Mercy Hospital Rooftop"
      return Ib
    end
    if f:FindFirstChild("inviswallasylum", true) then
      Ib = "Mount Massive Asylum"
      return Ib
    end
    if f:FindFirstChild("Tesla", true) then
      Ib = "Site 68"
      return Ib
    end
    if f:FindFirstChild("Breakwater", true) then
      Ib = "The Bay Harbor"
      return Ib
    end
    if f:FindFirstChild("RockVar0", true) then
      Ib = "Woodview Cabin"
      return Ib
    end
    local h = f:FindFirstChild("Model", true)
    if h then
      local c = h:GetPivot().Position
      if (c - Vector3.new(-811.4, 212.8, -7774.5)).Magnitude < 100 then
        Ib = "Firelink Shrine"
        return Ib
      end
      if (c - Vector3.new(1114.67, -16.92, -12.99)).Magnitude < 100 then
        Ib = "Valdelobos Village"
        return Ib
      end
    end
    Ib = "Unknown Map"
    return Ib
  end
  function applyBlockInteractions()
    pcall(function()
      local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      c = c and c:FindFirstChild("Window")
      c = c and c:FindFirstChild("VaultEvent")
      if c then
        for e, f in ipairs(cachedVaults) do
          if f and f.Parent then
            for e, f in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do
              if f.Name == "VaultTrigger" then
                c:FireServer(f, true)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    pcall(function()
      local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      c = c and c:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
      c = c and c:FindFirstChild("PalletSlideEvent")
      if c then
        for e, f in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
          if f and f.Parent then
            for e, f in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do
              if f.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or f.Name:find("Slide") then
                c:FireServer(f, true)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  function releaseBlockInteractions()
    _G.VD_ReleasingBlockInteractions = true
    pcall(function()
      local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      c = c and c:FindFirstChild("Window")
      c = c and c:FindFirstChild("VaultCompleteEvent")
      if c then
        local e = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
        local f = e or workspace
        for e, f in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do
          if f.Name == "VaultTrigger" then
            c:FireServer(f, false)
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    _G.VD_ReleasingBlockInteractions = false
    pcall(function()
      local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      c = c and c:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
      c = c and c:FindFirstChild("PalletSlideCompleteEvent")
      if c then
        for e, f in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
          if f and f.Parent then
            for e, f in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do
              if f.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or f.Name:find("Slide") then
                c:FireServer(f)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end

    local c = false
    function scanMapObjects()
      if c then
        return
      end
      c = true
      task.spawn(function()
        local e, f, g, h, i, j, k = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
        local l = {}
        pcall(updateSCPCache)
        pcall(function()
          Q = setmetatable({}, {["__mode"] = "k"})
          R = setmetatable({}, {["__mode"] = "kv"})
          if originalCanCollide then
            for c, e in pairs(originalCanCollide) do
              if not c or not c.Parent then
                originalCanCollide[c] = nil
              end
            end
          end
        end)
        local m = Players:GetPlayers()
        local n = {}
        for c, e in ipairs(m) do
          if e.Character then
            n[e.Character] = true
          end
        end
        local o = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
        local p = o and o:GetDescendants() or workspace:GetDescendants()
        for c, m in ipairs(p) do
          if c % 300 == 0 then
            task.wait()
          end
          local p = m.Name
          if (p == "Generator" or p:lower():find("generator")) and m:IsA("Model") then
            table.insert(e, m)
          elseif m:IsA("Model") and (m.Parent and m.Parent.Name == "Pallets" or m.Name == "Pallet" or m:FindFirstChild("Intact")) then
            table.insert(g, m)
          elseif m.Name == "BearTrap" or CollectionService and CollectionService:HasTag(m, "BearTrap") then
            table.insert(k, m)
          elseif p == "Window" or p:lower():find("window") or p == "Vault" or p:lower():find("vault") then
            local c = m:FindFirstChild("bottom") or m:FindFirstChild("Bottom")
            local e = m:FindFirstChild("inviswall") or m:FindFirstChild("Inviswall")
            local f = m:FindFirstChild("vaulttrigger") or m:FindFirstChild("VaultTrigger")
            if not (c and (e and f)) then
              for g, h in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do
                local i = h.Name:lower()
                if i == "bottom" then
                  c = true
                elseif i == "inviswall" then
                  e = true
                elseif i == "vaulttrigger" then
                  f = true
                end
              end
            end
            if c and (e and f) then
              table.insert(h, m)
            end
          elseif p == "BloodEffect" and m:IsA("BasePart") then
            table.insert(i, m)
          elseif p == "Hook" or p == "HookPoint" then
            local c = false
            local e = m
            while e and (e ~= workspace and e ~= o) do
              if n[e] then
                c = true
                break
              end
              e = e.Parent
            end
            if not c then
              local c = nil
              if m:IsA("BasePart") then
                c = m
              elseif m:IsA("Model") or m:IsA("Folder") then
                c = m:FindFirstChild("HookPoint") or m:IsA("Model") and m.PrimaryPart or m:FindFirstChild("Handle") or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
              end
              if c and not l[c] then
                l[c] = true
                table.insert(f, c)
              end
            end
          elseif (p == "ExitLever" or m:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true) or m:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")) and not (p:lower():find("spot") or p:lower():find("spawn") or p:lower():find("marker") or p:lower():find("point")) then
            local c = m.Name == "ExitLever" and m or m:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true) or m:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
            if c and not table.find(j, c) then
              table.insert(j, c)
            end
          end
        end
        cachedGenerators = e
        cachedHooks = f
        cachedPallets = g
        cachedVaults = h
        cachedBloodEffects = i
        if o then
          for c, e in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
            local f = e.Name:lower()
            local g = f:find("spot") or f:find("spawn") or f:find("marker") or f:find("point")
            if not g then
              local c = e.Name == "ExitLever" and e or e:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true) or e:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
              if c and not table.find(j, c) then
                table.insert(j, c)
              end
            end
          end
        end
        local q = {}
        local r = o and o:FindFirstChild("Pumpkins")
        if r then
          for c, e in ipairs(r:GetChildren()) do
            if not e:IsA("Folder") then
              local c = e:IsA("Model") and e or e:IsA("BasePart") and e
              if c and not table.find(q, c) then
                table.insert(q, c)
              end
            else
              for c, e in ipairs(e:GetChildren()) do
                local f = e:IsA("Model") and e or e:IsA("BasePart") and e
                if f and not table.find(q, f) then
                  table.insert(q, f)
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
        for c, e in ipairs(o:GetDescendants()) do
          if e.Name ~= "Pumpkins" and (e.Name:lower():find("pumpkin") and not e:IsA("Folder")) then
            local c = e:IsA("Model") and e or e:IsA("BasePart") and e
            if c and not table.find(q, c) then
              table.insert(q, c)
            end
          end
        end
        cachedPumpkins = q
        cachedGates = j
        cachedBearTraps = k
        if refreshTPMenu then
          pcall(refreshTPMenu)
        end
        c = false
      end)
    end
  end

    local h = v.ESPTextColorMode == "Custom" and v.ESPTextColor or nil
    for i, j in pairs(ActiveESP.Players) do
      j.LastESPStyle = nil
      j.LastHighlightColor = nil
      j.LastNameColor = nil
      if j.Billboard then
        j.Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, c, 0)

        j.InfoLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = g

          j.InfoLabel.TextColor3 = h

      end

    for f, i in pairs({

      for f, i in pairs(i) do
        i.LastESPStyle = nil
        i.LastHighlightColor = nil

          i.NameLabel.Font = e
          i.NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = g
          if h then

          end

  function createPlayerESP(c)
    if ActiveESP.Players[c] then
      return
    end
    local e = Instance.new("Highlight")
    e.FillTransparency = v.ESPFillTransparency or .6
    e.OutlineTransparency = v.ESPOutlineTransparency or .1
    e.Enabled = false
    e.Parent = highlightParent
    local f = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    f.AlwaysOnTop = true
    f.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.5 + (v.ESPPositionY or 0), 0)
    f.Enabled = false
    f.Parent = billboardParent
    local g = Instance.new("Frame")
    g.Name = "Container"
    g.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    g.BorderSizePixel = 0
    g.Parent = f
    local h = Instance.new("UICorner")
    h.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    h.Parent = g
    local i = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    i.Thickness = 1
    i.Transparency = 1
    i.Parent = g
    local j = Enum.Font[v.ESPFont] or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    local k = v.ESPFont == "GothamBold" and Enum.Font.Ubuntu or j
    local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    l.TextColor3 = v.ESPTextColorMode == "Custom" and v.ESPTextColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    l.Font = j
    l.TextStrokeColor3 = v.ESPTextOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    l.TextStrokeTransparency = .4
    l.Parent = g
    local m = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    m.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    m.TextColor3 = v.ESPTextColorMode == "Custom" and v.ESPTextColor or Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    m.Font = k
    m.TextStrokeColor3 = v.ESPTextOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    m.TextStrokeTransparency = .5
    m.Parent = g
    ActiveESP.Players[c] = {
      ["Highlight"] = e,
      ["Billboard"] = f,
      ["Container"] = g,
      ["ContainerStroke"] = i,
      ["NameLabel"] = l,
      ["InfoLabel"] = m,
      ["Tracer"] = nil,
      ["CurrentCharacter"] = nil,
      ["LastAuraEnabled"] = nil,
      ["LastHighlightColor"] = nil,
      ["LastBillboardEnabled"] = nil,
      ["LastNameText"] = nil,
      ["LastNameColor"] = nil,
      ["LastInfoText"] = nil,
      ["LastHookedProgressVal"] = nil,
      ["LastHookedChangeTime"] = 0,
      ["LastESPStyle"] = nil,
      ["LastIsMobile"] = nil
    }
  end
  local function Jb(c, e)
    local f = c.Tracer
    if not f then
      return
    end
    pcall(function()
      if type(f) == "table" then
        if not f.Remove then
          for c, f in pairs(f) do
            f.Visible = e
          end
        else
          f.Visible = e
        end
      else
        f.Visible = e
      end
    end)
  end
  function removePlayerESP(c)
    local e = ActiveESP.Players[c]
    if e then
      if e.Highlight then
        pcall(function()
          e.Highlight:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      if e.Billboard then
        pcall(function()
          e.Billboard:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      if e.Tracer then
        pcall(function()
          if type(e.Tracer) == "table" then
            if e.Tracer.Remove then
              e.Tracer:Remove()
            else
              for a, b in pairs(e.Tracer) do
                pcall(function()
                  b:Remove()
                end)
              end
            end
          else
            e.Tracer:Destroy()
          end
        end)
        e.Tracer = nil
      end
      ActiveESP.Players[c] = nil
    end
  end
  local Kb = false
  function updatePlayersESP()
    if isSpectating() then
      if not Kb then
        for c, e in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          local f = ActiveESP.Players[e]
          if f then
            if f.LastAuraEnabled ~= false then
              f.Highlight.Enabled = false
              f.LastAuraEnabled = false
            end
            if f.LastBillboardEnabled ~= false then
              f.Billboard.Enabled = false
              f.LastBillboardEnabled = false
            end
            if f.Tracer then
              f.Tracer.Visible = false
            end
            f.CurrentCharacter = nil
          end
        end
        Kb = true
      end
      return
    end
    local c = v.MeESP and v.MeESP.Enabled
    if not v.MasterESP or not v.KillerESP.Enabled and (not v.SurvivorESP.Enabled and not c) then
      if not Kb then
        for c, e in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          local f = ActiveESP.Players[e]
          if f then
            if f.LastAuraEnabled ~= false then
              f.Highlight.Enabled = false
              f.LastAuraEnabled = false
            end
            if f.LastBillboardEnabled ~= false then
              f.Billboard.Enabled = false
              f.LastBillboardEnabled = false
            end
            if f.Tracer then
              f.Tracer.Visible = false
            end
            f.CurrentCharacter = nil
          end
        end
        Kb = true
      end
      return
    end
    Kb = false
    local e = v.ESPStyle or "Standard"
    local f = {}
    local g = {}
    for c, e in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      table.insert(f, {["entity"] = e, ["char"] = e.Character, ["isBot"] = false})
      if e.Character then
        g[e.Character] = true
      end
    end
    for c, e in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
      if e:IsA("Model") and (e ~= localPlayer.Character and not g[e]) then
        local c = e:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local h = e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if c and h then
          local h = isSCPName and isSCPName(e.Name) or e:GetAttribute("Cured") == 3
          if not h and (c.Health > 0 or e:GetAttribute("Knocked") or e:GetAttribute("IsHooked")) then
            table.insert(f, {["entity"] = e, ["char"] = e, ["isBot"] = true})
            g[e] = true
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for c, e in ipairs({"Survivors", "Killers", "Bots"}) do
      local h = workspace:FindFirstChild(e)
      if h then
        for c, e in ipairs(h:GetChildren()) do
          if e:IsA("Model") and (e ~= localPlayer.Character and not g[e]) then
            local c = e:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local h = e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if c and h then
              local h = isSCPName and isSCPName(e.Name) or e:GetAttribute("Cured") == 3
              if not h and (c.Health > 0 or e:GetAttribute("Knocked") or e:GetAttribute("IsHooked")) then
                table.insert(f, {["entity"] = e, ["char"] = e, ["isBot"] = true})
                g[e] = true
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for c, f in ipairs(f) do
      local g = f.entity
      local h = f.isBot
      local i = f.char
      local j = not h and g == localPlayer
      if j and not (v.MeESP and v.MeESP.Enabled) then
        local c = ActiveESP.Players[localPlayer]
        if c then
          if c.Highlight then
            c.Highlight.Enabled = false
          end
          if c.Billboard then
            c.Billboard.Enabled = false
          end
          if c.Tracer then
            c.Tracer.Visible = false
          end
          c.LastAuraEnabled = false
          c.LastBillboardEnabled = false
          c.CurrentCharacter = nil
        end
        continue
      end
      createPlayerESP(g)
      local k = ActiveESP.Players[g]
      if not k then
        continue
      end
      local l = i and i:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local n = k.IsKiller
      local o = k.IsSurvivor
      local p = false
      if j then
        n = false
        o = false
        k.IsKiller = false
        k.IsSurvivor = false
      elseif h then
        local c = i.Parent and i.Parent.Name
        if c == "Killers" or i:FindFirstChild("StunEvent") or i:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or i:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true or i.Name == "Veil" then
          n = true
          o = false
        else
          o = true
          n = false
        end
        k.IsKiller = n
        k.IsSurvivor = o
      elseif n == nil or k.CurrentCharacter ~= i then
        local c = g.Team
        n = c and c.Name == "Killer"
        o = c and c.Name == "Survivors"
        if not c then
          local c = g.Name:lower()
          if c:find("killer") then
            n = true
          elseif c:find("survivor") then
            o = true
          end
        end
        if i then
          local c = i.Parent and i.Parent.Name
          if c == "Killers" or i:FindFirstChild("StunEvent") then
            n = true
            o = false
          elseif i.Name == "Veil" or i.Parent and i.Parent.Name == "Veil" then
            n = true
            o = false
          end
          local e = i:GetAttribute("Cured")
          if e == 3 then
            p = true
            n = true
            o = false
          end
        end
        if n == nil then
          n = false
        end
        if o == nil then
          o = false
        end
        k.IsKiller = n
        k.IsSurvivor = o
      else
        if i then
          local c = i:GetAttribute("Cured")
          if c == 3 then
            p = true
            n = true
            o = false
          end
        end
      end
      local q = false
      local r = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
      local s = false
      local t = false
      if i then
        local c = ob(i, "Knocked")
        if c == true or tostring(c):lower() == "true" or c == 1 then
          s = true
        end
        local e = ob(i, "IsHooked") == true or i:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
        if e then
          t = true
        else
          local c = ob(i, "HookedProgress")
          if c and tonumber(c) then
            local e = tonumber(c)
            if k.LastHookedProgressVal == nil then
              k.LastHookedProgressVal = e
              k.LastHookedChangeTime = 0
            elseif k.LastHookedProgressVal ~= e then
              k.LastHookedProgressVal = e
              k.LastHookedChangeTime = os.clock()
            end
            if os.clock() - (k.LastHookedChangeTime or 0) < 2 then
              t = true
            end
          else
            k.LastHookedProgressVal = nil
          end

  end
  },
    ["Pumpkins"] = {
    ["espList"] = function()
    return ActiveESP.Pumpkins
  end,
    ["isEnabled"] = function()
    return v.PumpkinsESP and v.PumpkinsESP.Enabled
  end,
    ["showAura"] = function()
    return v.PumpkinsESP and v.PumpkinsESP.Aura
  end,
    ["shouldSkip"] = function(c)
    return not c or not c.Parent
  end,
    ["getText"] = function(c, e)
    local f = v.PumpkinsESP and (v.PumpkinsESP.NoText and "") or "Pumpkin"
    if v.PumpkinsESP and v.PumpkinsESP.ShowDistance then
      return f == "" and string.format("[%dm]", e) or string.format("Pumpkin [%dm]", e)
    end
    return f
  end
  }
  }
