  function getModelTargetPart(c)
    if c:IsA("Model") then
      local e = c:FindFirstChild("Intact")
      if e then
        if e:IsA("BasePart") then
          return e
        end
        if e:IsA("Model") then
          return e.PrimaryPart or e:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        end
      end
      return c.PrimaryPart or c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    end
    if c:IsA("BasePart") then
      return c
    end
    return nil
  end
  function getVaultHighlightPart(c)
    local e = c:FindFirstChild("Bottom")
    if not e or not e:IsA("BasePart") then
      local e = getModelTargetPart(c)
      if e and e:IsA("BasePart") then
        return e
      end
      if c:IsA("BasePart") then
        return c
      end
      return c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or c
    end
    local f = nil
    local g = math.huge
    for c, h in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
      if h:IsA("BasePart") and (h ~= e and h.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart") then
        if h.Transparency < 1 then
          local c = (h.Position - e.Position).Magnitude
          if c < g then
            g = c
            f = h
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return f or e
  end
  function disableMapESPData(c)
    c.CurrentAlpha = 0
    if c.LastAuraEnabled ~= false then
      if c.Highlight and c.Highlight:IsA("Highlight") then
        c.Highlight.Enabled = false
      elseif c.Highlight and c.Highlight:IsA("BoxHandleAdornment") then
        c.Highlight.Visible = false
      end
      if c.PuddleHighlight and c.PuddleHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then
        c.PuddleHighlight.Enabled = false
      end
      c.LastAuraEnabled = false
    end
    if c.LastBillboardEnabled ~= false then
      c.Billboard.Enabled = false
      c.LastBillboardEnabled = false
    end
  end
  function createModelESP(c, e)
    local f = Lb[e]
    if not f then
      return
    end
    local g = f.espList()
    if g[c] then
      return
    end
    local h = getESPColor(e)
    local i
    if e == "Vault" then
      i = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
      i.AlwaysOnTop = true
      i.ZIndex = 5
      i.Transparency = v.ESPFillTransparency or .6
      i.Color3 = v.ESPFillColorMode == "Custom" and v.ESPFillColor or h
      i.Visible = false
      i.Parent = highlightParent
    else
      i = Instance.new("Highlight")
      i.FillTransparency = v.ESPFillTransparency or .6
      i.OutlineTransparency = v.ESPOutlineTransparency or .1
      i.FillColor = v.ESPFillColorMode == "Custom" and v.ESPFillColor or h
      i.OutlineColor = v.ESPOutlineColorMode == "Custom" and v.ESPOutlineColor or h
      i.Enabled = false
      i.Parent = highlightParent
    end
    local j = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    j.AlwaysOnTop = true
    j.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.5 + (v.ESPPositionY or 0), 0)
    j.Enabled = false
    j.Parent = billboardParent
    local k = Instance.new("Frame")
    k.Name = "Container"
    k.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    k.BorderSizePixel = 0
    k.Parent = j
    local l = Instance.new("UICorner")
    l.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    l.Parent = k
    local m = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    m.Thickness = 1
    m.Transparency = 1
    m.Parent = k
    local n = Enum.Font[v.ESPFont] or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    local o = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    o.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    o.TextColor3 = v.ESPTextColorMode == "Custom" and v.ESPTextColor or h
    o.Font = n
    o.TextStrokeColor3 = v.ESPTextOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    o.TextStrokeTransparency = .4
    o.Parent = k
    local p = getModelTargetPart(c)
    local q = c
    local r = nil
    local s = nil
    if e == "Gate" then
      local e = getGatePartSafe(c)
      local f = c.Name == "ExitLever" and c or c:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true) or c:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
      if e then
        p = e
        q = f and (f:IsA("Model") and f) or e
      end
    elseif e == "BearTrap" then
      if c:IsA("Folder") then
        q = p or c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model") or c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
      end
    elseif e == "Pumpkins" then
      if c:IsA("BasePart") and (c.Parent and (c.Parent:IsA("Model") and (c.Parent ~= workspace and c.Parent.Name ~= "Pumpkins"))) then
        q = c.Parent
      end
    elseif e == "Vault" then
      q = getVaultHighlightPart(c)
    elseif e == "Hook" then
      local e = c
      local f = nil
      local g = nil
      while e and e ~= workspace do
        if e.Name == "Hook" then
          f = e
          break
        end
        e = e.Parent
      end
      if not f then
        if c.Parent and (c.Parent.Name == "Hook" or c.Parent.Name == "Model") then
          f = c.Parent.Name == "Hook" and c.Parent or c.Parent.Parent
        end
      end
      if f then
        s = f:FindFirstChild("Cartoony Blood Puddle") or f:FindFirstChild("CartoonyBloodPuddle") or f:FindFirstChild("Blood Puddle") or f:FindFirstChild("BloodPuddle")
        if f:IsA("Model") then
          q = f
        else
          g = f:FindFirstChild("Model") or f:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
          q = g or c
        end
      else
        local e = c
        while e and e ~= workspace do
          if e.Name == "Model" and e:IsA("Model") then
            g = e
            break
          end
          e = e.Parent
        end
        if g then
          q = g
          if g.Parent then
            s = g.Parent:FindFirstChild("Cartoony Blood Puddle")
          end
        end
      end
      if s and (q ~= f or not (f and f:IsA("Model"))) then
        r = Instance.new("Highlight")
        r.FillTransparency = v.ESPFillTransparency or .6
        r.OutlineTransparency = v.ESPOutlineTransparency or .1
        r.FillColor = v.ESPFillColorMode == "Custom" and v.ESPFillColor or h
        r.OutlineColor = v.ESPOutlineColorMode == "Custom" and v.ESPOutlineColor or h
        r.Adornee = s
        r.Enabled = false
        r.Parent = highlightParent
      end
    end
    g[c] = {
      ["Highlight"] = i,
      ["PuddleHighlight"] = r,
      ["BloodPuddle"] = s,
      ["Billboard"] = j,
      ["Container"] = k,
      ["ContainerStroke"] = m,
      ["NameLabel"] = o,
      ["TargetPart"] = p,
      ["TargetAdornee"] = q,
      ["CachedPosition"] = p and p.Position or Vector3.new(),
      ["LastAdornee"] = nil,
      ["LastAuraEnabled"] = nil,
      ["LastHighlightColor"] = nil,
      ["LastBillboardAdornee"] = nil,
      ["LastBillboardEnabled"] = nil,
      ["LastText"] = nil,
      ["LastESPStyle"] = nil,
      ["LastIsMobile"] = nil
    }
  end
  function removeModelESP(c, e)
    local f = Lb[e]
    if not f then
      return
    end
    local g = f.espList()
    local h = g[c]
    if h then
      if h.Highlight then
        pcall(function()
          h.Highlight:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      if h.PuddleHighlight then
        pcall(function()
          h.PuddleHighlight:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      if h.Billboard then
        pcall(function()
          h.Billboard:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      g[c] = nil
    end
  end
  local Nb = {}
  function updateMapESP(c, e)
    local f = Lb[c]
    if not f then
      return
    end
    if not v.MasterESP or not f.isEnabled() then
      if not Nb[c] then
        local e = f.espList()
        for a, b in pairs(e) do
          disableMapESPData(b)
        end
        Nb[c] = true
      end
      return
    end
    Nb[c] = nil
    debug.profilebegin("Helper_UpdateMapESP_" .. tostring(c))
    local g = f.espList()
    local h = {}
    for c, e in pairs(g) do
      if not c or not c.Parent or not c:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        table.insert(h, c)
      end
    end
    for e, f in ipairs(h) do
      pcall(function()
        removeModelESP(f, c)
      end)
    end
    local i = getESPColor(c)
    local j = v.ESPStyle or "Standard"
    local k = P
    if not k then
      local c = localPlayer.Character
      k = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    for e, h in ipairs(e) do
      if not h or not h.Parent then
        continue
      end
      if f.shouldSkip(h) then
        removeModelESP(h, c)
        continue
      end
      createModelESP(h, c)
      local l = g[h]
      if not l then
        continue
      end
      local n = i
      local o = l.CachedPosition
      if c == "Hook" then
        local c = o
        if c then
          for e, f in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if f ~= localPlayer and f.Character then
              local e = f.Character
              local g = e:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
              if g then
                local f = e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if f and (f.Position - c).Magnitude <= 15 then
                  n = Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 20)
                  break
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      elseif c == "Pallet" then
        n = i
      end
      local p = l.TargetPart
      if not p or not p.Parent then
        if c == "Gate" then
          p = getGatePartSafe(h)
        else
          p = getModelTargetPart(h)
        end
        l.TargetPart = p
        if c == "Gate" and p then
          l.TargetAdornee = h:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true) and (h:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true):IsA("Model") and h:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)) or p
        end
      end
      local q = p and p.Position or o
      l.CachedPosition = q
      local r = k and (q and math.round((k.Position - q).Magnitude)) or math.huge
      local s = r <= v.ESPRange
      if p and s then
        local e = l.TargetAdornee
        if l.LastAdornee ~= e then
          l.Highlight.Adornee = e
          l.LastAdornee = e
          if c == "Vault" and (e and e:IsA("BasePart")) then
            l.Highlight.Size = e.Size
            l.Highlight.CFrame = CFrame.new()
          end
        end
        if l.PuddleHighlight and (l.BloodPuddle and l.PuddleHighlight.Adornee ~= l.BloodPuddle) then
          l.PuddleHighlight.Adornee = l.BloodPuddle
        end
        local g = f.showAura()
        local i = 1
        local k = false
        if v.ESPDistanceFade and v.ESPDistanceFadeMap then
          if c == "Generator" and v.ESPDistanceFadeGenerators then
            k = true
          elseif c == "Pallet" and v.ESPDistanceFadePallets then
            k = true
          elseif c == "Vault" and v.ESPDistanceFadeVaults then
            k = true
          elseif c == "Hook" and v.ESPDistanceFadeHooks then
            k = true
          elseif c == "Gate" and v.ESPDistanceFadeGates then
            k = true
          elseif c == "SCP" and v.ESPDistanceFadeSCPs then
            k = true
          elseif c == "BloodEffect" then
            k = true
          end
        end
        if k and r then
          if r >= v.ESPFadeMax then
            i = 0
          elseif r > v.ESPFadeStart then
            local c = v.ESPFadeMax - v.ESPFadeStart
            local e = r - v.ESPFadeStart
            i = 1 - e / c
          end
        end
        l.DistanceOpacityFactor = i
        l.LastAuraEnabled = g and i > .005
        local o = v.ESPFillColorMode == "Custom" and v.ESPFillColor or n
        local q = v.ESPOutlineColorMode == "Custom" and v.ESPOutlineColor or n
        if c == "Vault" then
          if l.Highlight.Color3 ~= o then
            l.Highlight.Color3 = o
          end
        else
          if l.Highlight.FillColor ~= o then
            l.Highlight.FillColor = o
          end
          if l.Highlight.OutlineColor ~= q then
            l.Highlight.OutlineColor = q
          end
        end
        if l.PuddleHighlight and l.PuddleHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then
          if l.PuddleHighlight.FillColor ~= o then
            l.PuddleHighlight.FillColor = o
          end
          if l.PuddleHighlight.OutlineColor ~= q then
            l.PuddleHighlight.OutlineColor = q
          end
        end
        local s = v.ESPTextOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        if l.NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 ~= s then
          l.NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = s
        end
        local t = Enum.Font[v.ESPFont] or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        if l.NameLabel.Font ~= t then
          l.NameLabel.Font = t
        end
        local u = 3.5 + (v.ESPPositionY or 0)
        if l.Billboard.StudsOffset.Y ~= u then
          l.Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, u, 0)
        end
        if l.LastESPStyle ~= j or l.LastIsMobile ~= m then
          l.LastESPStyle = j
          l.LastIsMobile = m
          local c = v.ESPTextSize
          if j == "Old" then
            l.Billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 45)
            l.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            l.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            l.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1
            l.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            l.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            l.NameLabel.TextSize = c or 14
          elseif j == "Standard" then
            l.Billboard.Size = m and UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 20) or UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 26)
            l.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            l.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            l.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1
            l.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            l.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            l.NameLabel.TextSize = c or (m and 9 or 11)
          elseif j == "Compact" then
            l.Billboard.Size = m and UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 16) or UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 20)
            l.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            l.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            l.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1
            l.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            l.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            l.NameLabel.TextSize = c or (m and 8 or 10)
          elseif j == "Minimal" then
            l.Billboard.Size = m and UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 16) or UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 20)
            l.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            l.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            l.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1
            l.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            l.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            l.NameLabel.TextSize = c or (m and 8 or 10)
          end
        end
        if j == "Aura Only" then
          if l.LastBillboardEnabled ~= false then
            l.Billboard.Enabled = false
            l.LastBillboardEnabled = false
          end
        else
          if l.LastBillboardEnabled ~= true then
            l.Billboard.Enabled = true
            l.LastBillboardEnabled = true
          end
          if l.LastBillboardAdornee ~= p then
            l.Billboard.Adornee = p
            l.LastBillboardAdornee = p
          end
          local e = ""
          if j == "Old" or j == "Standard" then
            e = f.getText(h, r)
          elseif j == "Compact" then
            if c == "Generator" then
              local c = getGeneratorProgress(h)
              local f, g, i = getGeneratorAnalytics(h)
              local j = ""
              if v.GeneratorESP.ShowProgress then
                j = string.format(" %d%%", c)
                if v.GeneratorESP.ShowRepairSpeed and math.abs(f) > .05 then
                  if f > 0 then
                    j = j .. string.format(" (+%.1f%%/s)", f)
                  else
                    j = j .. string.format(" (%.1f%%/s)", f)
                  end
                end
                if v.GeneratorESP.ShowETA and i ~= "" then
                  j = j .. string.format(" [%s]", i)
                end
                if v.GeneratorESP.ShowRepairingCount then
                  local c = h:GetAttribute("PlayersRepairingCount") or 0
                  j = j .. string.format(" (%dp)", c)
                end
              elseif v.GeneratorESP.ShowRepairingCount then
                local c = h:GetAttribute("PlayersRepairingCount") or 0
                j = string.format(" (%dp)", c)
              end
              local k = v.GeneratorESP.NoText and "" or "Gen"
              if v.GeneratorESP.ShowDistance then
                if k == "" then
                  e = string.format("[%dm]%s", r, j)
                else
                  e = string.format("Gen [%dm]%s", r, j)
                end
              else
                e = k .. j
              end
            else
              local f = false
              if c == "BloodEffect" then
                f = v.BloodESP.NoText
              elseif c == "SCP" then
                f = v.SCPESP.NoText
              else
                local e = v[c .. "ESP"]
                f = e and e.NoText
              end
              local g = ""
              if not f then
                if c == "SCP" then
                  g = h.Name:upper()
                else
                  local e = {
                    ["Hook"] = "Hook",
                    ["Pallet"] = "Pallet",
                    ["Vault"] = "Vault",
                    ["BloodEffect"] = "Blood",
                    ["Gate"] = "Gate"
                  }
                  g = e[c] or c
                end
              end
              local i = false
              if c == "BloodEffect" then
                i = v.BloodESP.ShowDistance
              elseif c == "SCP" then
                i = v.SCPESP.ShowDistance
              else
                local e = v[c .. "ESP"]
                i = e and e.ShowDistance
              end
              local j = ""
              if c == "Gate" and (v.GateESP and v.GateESP.ShowProgress) then
                local c = getGateProgress(h)
                j = string.format(" [%d%%]", c)
              end
              if i then
                if g == "" then
                  e = string.format("[%dm]%s", r, j)
                else
                  e = string.format("%s [%dm]%s", g, r, j)
                end
              else
                e = g .. j
              end
            end
          elseif j == "Minimal" then
            if c == "Generator" then
              local c = getGeneratorProgress(h)
              local f = ""
              if v.GeneratorESP.ShowProgress then
                f = string.format(" %d%%", c)
                if v.GeneratorESP.ShowRepairingCount then
                  local c = h:GetAttribute("PlayersRepairingCount") or 0
                  f = f .. string.format(" (%dp)", c)
                end
              elseif v.GeneratorESP.ShowRepairingCount then
                local c = h:GetAttribute("PlayersRepairingCount") or 0
                f = string.format(" (%dp)", c)
              end
              if v.GeneratorESP.ShowDistance then
                e = string.format("[%dm]%s", r, f)
              else
                local c = v.GeneratorESP.NoText and "" or "Gen"
                e = c .. f
              end
            else
              local f = false
              if c == "BloodEffect" then
                f = v.BloodESP.NoText
              elseif c == "SCP" then
                f = v.SCPESP.NoText
              else
                local e = v[c .. "ESP"]
                f = e and e.NoText
              end
              local g = ""
              if not f then
                if c == "SCP" then
                  g = h.Name:upper():sub(1, 3)
                else
                  local e = {
                    ["Hook"] = "Hoo",
                    ["Pallet"] = "Pal",
                    ["Vault"] = "Vau",
                    ["BloodEffect"] = "Blo",
                    ["Gate"] = "Gat"
                  }
                  g = e[c] or c:sub(1, 3)
                end
              end
              local i = false
              if c == "BloodEffect" then
                i = v.BloodESP.ShowDistance
              elseif c == "SCP" then
                i = v.SCPESP.ShowDistance
              else
                local e = v[c .. "ESP"]
                i = e and e.ShowDistance
              end
              local j = ""
              if c == "Gate" and (v.GateESP and v.GateESP.ShowProgress) then
                local c = getGateProgress(h)
                j = string.format(" %d%%", c)
              end
              if i then
                e = string.format("[%dm]%s", r, j)
              else
                e = g .. j
              end
            end
          end
          if l.LastText ~= e then
            l.NameLabel.Text = e
            l.LastText = e
          end
          local g = v.ESPTextColorMode == "Custom" and v.ESPTextColor or n
          if l.NameLabel.TextColor3 ~= g then
            l.NameLabel.TextColor3 = g
          end
        end
      else
        disableMapESPData(l)
      end
    end
    debug.profileend()
  end
  function manageHighlights()
    local c = {}
    for e, f in pairs(ActiveESP.Players) do
      if f.Highlight and f.LastAuraEnabled then
        table.insert(c, {
          ["data"] = f,
          ["priority"] = 1,
          ["dist"] = getDistance(e, f.Billboard and f.Billboard.Adornee)
        })
      else
        f.TargetHighlightVisible = false
      end
    end
    local e = {
      ActiveESP.SCPs,
      ActiveESP.Generators,
      ActiveESP.Hooks,
      ActiveESP.Pallets,
      ActiveESP.Vaults,
      ActiveESP.BloodEffects,
      ActiveESP.Gates,
      ActiveESP.BearTraps,
      ActiveESP.Pumpkins
    }
    for e, f in ipairs(e) do
      local g = 4
      if e == 1 then
        g = 2
      elseif e == 2 or e == 7 or e == 8 then
        g = 3
      end
      for e, f in pairs(f) do
        if f.Highlight and f.LastAuraEnabled then
          table.insert(c, {["data"] = f, ["priority"] = g, ["dist"] = getDistance(e, f.LastBillboardAdornee)})
        else
          f.TargetHighlightVisible = false
        end
      end
    end
    table.sort(c, function(c, e)
      if c.priority ~= e.priority then
        return c.priority < e.priority
      end
      return c.dist < e.dist
    end)
    local f = 28
    for c, e in ipairs(c) do
      local g = c <= f
      e.data.TargetHighlightVisible = g
      if (v.ESPFadeDuration or .2) <= .01 then
        if e.data.Highlight:IsA("Highlight") then
          if e.data.Highlight.Enabled ~= g then
            e.data.Highlight.Enabled = g
          end
        elseif e.data.Highlight:IsA("BoxHandleAdornment") then
          if e.data.Highlight.Visible ~= g then
            e.data.Highlight.Visible = g
          end
        end
        if e.data.PuddleHighlight and e.data.PuddleHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then
          if e.data.PuddleHighlight.Enabled ~= g then
            e.data.PuddleHighlight.Enabled = g
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local Ob = nil
  function updateESPFadeTransitions(c)
    if not v.MasterESP then
      return
    end
    local e = v.PerformanceMode
    local f = e and 0 or (v.ESPFadeDuration or .2)
    local g = e or f <= .01
    local h = v.ESPFillTransparency or .6
    local i = v.ESPOutlineTransparency or .1
    local function j(e, j)
      if not e or not e.Highlight then
        return
      end
      local k = 0
      if e.TargetHighlightVisible ~= false and e.LastAuraEnabled then
        k = e.DistanceOpacityFactor or 1
      end
      if e.CurrentAlpha == nil then
        e.CurrentAlpha = k
      elseif g then
        e.CurrentAlpha = k
      else
        local g = c / f
        if e.CurrentAlpha < k then
          e.CurrentAlpha = math.min(k, e.CurrentAlpha + g)
        elseif e.CurrentAlpha > k then
          e.CurrentAlpha = math.max(k, e.CurrentAlpha - g)
        end
      end
      local l = e.CurrentAlpha
      local m = l > .005
      if e.LastFadeAlpha == l and (e.LastFadeFill == h and (e.LastFadeOutline == i and e.LastFadeVis == m)) then
        return
      end
      e.LastFadeAlpha = l
      e.LastFadeFill = h
      e.LastFadeOutline = i
      e.LastFadeVis = m
      if j then
        if e.Highlight:IsA("BoxHandleAdornment") then
          if e.Highlight.Visible ~= m then
            e.Highlight.Visible = m
          end
          if m then
            e.Highlight.Transparency = 1 - (1 - h) * l
          end
        end
      else
        if e.Highlight:IsA("Highlight") then
          if e.Highlight.Enabled ~= m then
            e.Highlight.Enabled = m
          end
          if m then
            e.Highlight.FillTransparency = 1 - (1 - h) * l
            e.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 1 - (1 - i) * l
          end
        end
        if e.PuddleHighlight and e.PuddleHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then
          if e.PuddleHighlight.Enabled ~= m then
            e.PuddleHighlight.Enabled = m
          end
          if m then
            e.PuddleHighlight.FillTransparency = 1 - (1 - h) * l
            e.PuddleHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 1 - (1 - i) * l
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for a, b in pairs(ActiveESP.Players) do
      j(b, false)
    end
    if not Ob then
      Ob = {
        ActiveESP.Generators,
        ActiveESP.Hooks,
        ActiveESP.Pallets,
        ActiveESP.BloodEffects,
        ActiveESP.Gates,
        ActiveESP.SCPs,
        ActiveESP.BearTraps,
        ActiveESP.Pumpkins
      }
    end
    for c, e in ipairs(Ob) do
      for a, b in pairs(e) do
        j(b, false)
      end
    end
    for a, b in pairs(ActiveESP.Vaults) do
      j(b, true)
    end
  end

  function applyTheme(e)
    currentThemeName = e or "Default"
    local f = themes[currentThemeName] or themes.Default
    local g = UI.Bg
    local h = UI.Sidebar
    local i = UI.Card
    local j = UI.Elevated
    local k = UI.Stroke
    local l = UI.StrokeDim
    local m = UI.Accent
    local n = UI.AccentCyan
    local o = UI.AccentGreen
    local p = UI.AccentRed
    UI.Bg = f.Bg
    UI.Sidebar = f.Sidebar
    UI.Card = f.Card
    UI.Elevated = f.Elevated
    UI.Stroke = f.Stroke
    UI.StrokeDim = f.StrokeDim
    UI.Accent = f.Accent
    UI.AccentCyan = f.AccentCyan
    UI.AccentGreen = f.AccentGreen
    UI.AccentRed = f.AccentRed
    if not mainFrame then
      return
    end
    mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Bg
    local r = v.CustomBackground and (v.CustomBackground.Enabled and (q() and (c and (c.CustomBackground or c["Custom Background"]))))
    mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = r and 1 or f.BgTrans
    _G.VD_MainStroke = mainFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if _G.VD_MainStroke then
      _G.VD_MainStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
      _G.VD_MainStroke.Thickness = 1
    end
    local s = mainFrame:FindFirstChild("Sidebar")
    if s then
      s.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Sidebar
      s.BackgroundTransparency = r and .85 or f.BgTrans
      local c = s:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
      if c then
        c.Color = UI.StrokeDim
      end
    end
    for c, e in ipairs(screenGui:GetDescendants()) do
      if e:IsA("GuiObject") then
        if e.Name == "VD_CustomBg" or e.Name == "VD_BgOverlay" or Pb and e == Pb or Qb and e == Qb then
          if e.Name == "VD_CustomBg" or Pb and e == Pb then
            pcall(function()
              e.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            end)
          end
          continue
        end
        local c = e.Name
        local f = c:lower()
        local q = c == "LogoImage" or f:find("logo") ~= nil or c == "TitleLogo" or (c == "HomeHeaderAvatar" or c == "WelcomeBackAvatar" or f:find("avatar") ~= nil or f:find("portrait") ~= nil or f:find("survivor") ~= nil) or e:IsA("ImageLabel") and (e.Image and (e.Image:find("rbxthumb://") ~= nil or e.Image:find("roblox.com") ~= nil or e.Image:find("dbd_hud_") ~= nil or e.Image:find("VD_Logo") ~= nil))
        if q then
          if e:IsA("ImageLabel") or e:IsA("ImageButton") then
            e.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
          elseif e:IsA("TextLabel") and c == "TitleLogo" then
            e.TextColor3 = UI.Text
          end
          local f = e:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
          if f then
            f.Color = UI.Accent
          end
          continue
        end
        if e.BackgroundColor3 == g then
          e.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Bg
        elseif e.BackgroundColor3 == h then
          e.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Sidebar
        elseif e.BackgroundColor3 == i then
          e.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
        elseif e.BackgroundColor3 == j then
          e.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
        elseif e.BackgroundColor3 == m then
          e.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Accent
        elseif e.BackgroundColor3 == n then
          e.BackgroundColor3 = UI.AccentCyan
        elseif e.BackgroundColor3 == o then
          e.BackgroundColor3 = UI.AccentGreen
        elseif e.BackgroundColor3 == p then
          e.BackgroundColor3 = UI.AccentRed
        elseif e.BackgroundColor3 == k then
          e.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Stroke
        elseif e.BackgroundColor3 == l then
          e.BackgroundColor3 = UI.StrokeDim
        end
        if e:IsA("ImageLabel") or e:IsA("ImageButton") then
          local f = c == "TabIcon" or c == "Icon" or c == "SearchIcon" or c:find("Chevron") ~= nil or c:find("Check") ~= nil or e.Parent and (e.Parent.Name:find("TabBtn") ~= nil or e.Parent.Name:find("Toggle") ~= nil or e.Parent.Name:find("Selector") ~= nil or e.Parent.Name:find("Slider") ~= nil)
          if f then
            if e.ImageColor3 == m then
              e.ImageColor3 = UI.Accent
            elseif e.ImageColor3 == n then
              e.ImageColor3 = UI.AccentCyan
            elseif e.ImageColor3 == k then
              e.ImageColor3 = UI.Stroke
            elseif e.ImageColor3 == l then
              e.ImageColor3 = UI.StrokeDim
            end
          end
        end
        if e:IsA("TextLabel") or e:IsA("TextBox") or e:IsA("TextButton") then
          local f = e:GetAttribute("ThemeAccentText") == true or c == "PopupTitle" or c == "GetKeyBtn" or e.Parent and e.Parent.Name == "HeaderBanner" or e.Parent and e.Parent.Name:find("MobileFloating_") ~= nil
          if f then
            if e.TextColor3 == m then
              e.TextColor3 = UI.Accent
            elseif e.TextColor3 == n then
              e.TextColor3 = UI.AccentCyan
            elseif e.TextColor3 == o then
              e.TextColor3 = UI.AccentGreen
            end
          elseif e.TextColor3 == n then
            e.TextColor3 = UI.AccentCyan
          elseif e.TextColor3 == o then
            e.TextColor3 = UI.AccentGreen
          end
        end
        local r = e:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if r then
          if r.Color == k then
            r.Color = UI.Stroke
          elseif r.Color == l then
            r.Color = UI.StrokeDim
          elseif r.Color == m then
            r.Color = UI.Accent
          end
        end
        if e.Name == "SectionLine" then
          e.BackgroundColor3 = UI.StrokeDim
        end
      end
    end
    if searchBarContainer then
      searchBarContainer.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    end
    if searchStroke then
      searchStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
    end
    if searchIconLbl then
      pcall(function()
        if searchIconLbl:IsA("ImageLabel") then
          searchIconLbl.ImageColor3 = UI.TextSub
        else
          searchIconLbl.TextColor3 = UI.Accent
        end
      end)
    end
    if searchBox then
      searchBox.TextColor3 = UI.Text
      searchBox.PlaceholderColor3 = UI.Muted
    end
    if clearSearchBtn then
      clearSearchBtn.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
    end
    if searchBox and (searchBox.Text ~= "" and updateSearchResults) then
      local c = searchBox.Text:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", ""):lower()
      if #c > 0 then
        pcall(updateSearchResults, c)
      end
    end
    if Rb then
      pcall(Rb)
    elseif _G.VD_ApplyCustomBg then
      pcall(_G.VD_ApplyCustomBg)
    end
  end
  local Sb = {}
  local function Tb(c)
    if not c or c == "" then
      return nil
    end
    local e = tostring(c):lower():gsub("%s+", "")
    if e == "togglespeedboost" or e == "speedboost" then
      return v.SpeedBoostEnabled == true
    elseif e == "noturnspeedloss" or e == "preserveturnspeed" then
      return v.NoTurnSpeedLoss == true
    elseif e == "automoonwalk" or e == "moonwalk" then
      return v.AutoMoonwalk == true
    elseif e == "noclipvaultspallets" or e == "noclip" then
      return v.NoclipVaultsPallets == true
    elseif e == "autofleekiller" or e == "autoflee" then
      return v.AutoFleeKiller == true
    elseif e == "alwaysfastvault" or e == "fastvault" then
      return v.AlwaysFastVault == true
    elseif e == "fakevault" then
      return v.FakeVault == true
    elseif e == "instantheal" then
      return v.InstantHeal == true
    elseif e == "autoparry" then
      return v.AutoParry == true
    elseif e == "frenzyparry" then
      return v.FrenzyParry == true
    elseif e == "revolverautofarm" then
      return v.RevolverAutofarm == true
    elseif e == "revolveraimbot" or e == "aimbot" then
      return (v.RevolverAimbot and v.RevolverAimbot.Enabled) == true
    elseif e == "flowstateperk" or e == "flowstate" then
      return v.FlowstatePerk == true
    elseif e == "simulatequickrecovery" or e == "quickrecovery" then
      return v.SimulateQuickRecovery == true
    elseif e == "simulateperfectlanding" or e == "perfectlanding" then
      return v.SimulatePerfectLanding == true
    elseif e == "activefeaturesoverlay" or e == "activefeatures" then
      return v.ShowActiveFeatures == true
    elseif e == "spectatorlist" or e == "spectators" then
      return v.ShowSpectatorList == true
    elseif e == "nofog" then
      return v.NoFog == true
    elseif e == "dofremoval" or e == "removedof" then
      return v.RemoveDOF == true
    elseif e == "fullbright" then
      return v.FullBright == true
    elseif e == "noskillchecks" then
      return v.NoSkillChecks == true
    elseif e == "rainbowcharacter" or e == "rainbow" then
      return v.RainbowCharacter == true
    elseif e == "fakelag" then
      return v.FakeLag == true
    elseif e == "desync" then
      return v.Desync == true
    elseif e == "blockvaultpalletinteraction" or e == "blockvaults" or e == "blockpallets" then
      return v.BlockVaultPalletInteraction == true
    elseif v[c] ~= nil and type(v[c]) == "boolean" then
      return v[c] == true
    end
    for c, f in pairs(v) do
      if type(f) == "boolean" then
        local g = c:lower():gsub("%s+", "")
        if g == e then
          return f == true
        end
      elseif type(f) == "table" and f.Enabled ~= nil then
        local g = c:lower():gsub("%s+", "")
        if g == e or g .. "esp" == e or g .. "track" == e then
          return f.Enabled == true
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  function createOrUpdateMobileFloatingButton(c, e)
    if not m then
      return
    end
    local f = guiParent or localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if not f then
      return
    end
    local g = f:FindFirstChild("VD_MobileHUD")
    if not g or not g.Parent then
      if g then
        pcall(function()
          g:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
      g.Name = "VD_MobileHUD"
      g.ResetOnSpawn = false
      g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
      g.DisplayOrder = 99997
      pcall(function()
        g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
      end)
      g.Parent = f
    end
    local h = mobileFloatingButtons[c]
    local i = Sb[c]
    if not i and (v.MobileButtonPositions and v.MobileButtonPositions[c]) then
      local e = v.MobileButtonPositions[c]
      if e and (e.XScale and e.YScale) then
        i = UDim2.new(e.XScale, e.XOffset or 0, e.YScale, e.YOffset or 0)
        Sb[c] = i
      end
    end
    if not i then
      local c = 0
      for a in pairs(mobileFloatingButtons) do
        c = c + 1
      end
      local e = .22 + c * .12
      if e > .75 then
        e = .22
      end
      i = UDim2.new(.85, -20, e, 0)
    end
    local j = Tb(c)
    local k = UI.Bg
    local l = 0.25
    local n = UI.Accent
    local o = UI.Stroke
    local p = 1
    if j == true then
      k = Color3.fromRGB(18, 48, 28)
      l = .2
      n = Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128)
      o = Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94)
      p = 1.4
    elseif j == false then
      k = Color3.fromRGB(42, 16, 20)
      l = .35
      n = Color3.fromRGB(248, 113, 113)
      o = Color3.fromRGB(225, 29, 72)
      p = 1
    end
    local q = h
    if not q or not q.Parent then
      q = Instance.new("TextButton")
      q.Name = "MobileFloating_" .. c
      q.Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42)
      q.Position = i
      q.ZIndex = 998
      q.Parent = g
      Instance.new("UICorner", q).CornerRadius = UDim.new(.5, 0)
      local e = Instance.new("UIStroke", q)
      e.Thickness = p
      local f, h = nil, nil
      local j = false
      local k = nil
      registerConnection(q.InputBegan:Connect(function(e)
        if e.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or e.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
          f = e.Position
          h = q.Position
          j = false
          local g
          g = e.Changed:Connect(function()
            if e.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
              f = nil
              k = nil
              if g then
                g:Disconnect()
              end
              if j then
                Sb[c] = q.Position
                if not v.MobileButtonPositions then
                  v.MobileButtonPositions = {}
                end
                v.MobileButtonPositions[c] = {
                  ["XScale"] = q.Position.X.Scale,
                  ["XOffset"] = q.Position.X.Offset,
                  ["YScale"] = q.Position.Y.Scale,
                  ["YOffset"] = q.Position.Y.Offset
                }
                pcall(saveSettings)
              else
                local e = K[c]
                if e then
                  TweenService:Create(q, TweenInfo.new(.1), {["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 38)}):Play()
                  task.delay(.1, function()
                    if q and q.Parent then
                      TweenService:Create(q, TweenInfo.new(.1), {["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42)}):Play()
                    end
                  end)
                  e()
                  task.delay(.05, function()
                    if ib then
                      pcall(ib)
                    end
                  end)
                end
              end
            end
          end)
        end
      end))
      registerConnection(q.InputChanged:Connect(function(c)
        if c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
          k = c
        end
      end))
      registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(c)
        if c == k and f then
          local e = c.Position - f
          if e.Magnitude > 5 then
            j = true
          end
          q.Position = UDim2.new(h.X.Scale, h.X.Offset + e.X, h.Y.Scale, h.Y.Offset + e.Y)
        end
      end))
      mobileFloatingButtons[c] = q
    end
    q.Text = e:upper()
    q.BackgroundColor3 = k
    q.BackgroundTransparency = l
    q.TextColor3 = n
    local r = q:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if r then
      r.Color = o
      r.Thickness = p
    end
  end

  function cleanupParryUI()
    pcall(function()
      local c = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
      if not c then
        return
      end
      for e, f in ipairs({"Survivor", "Survivor-con"}) do
        local g = c:FindFirstChild(f)
        if g then
          local c = g:FindFirstChild("bottom left") or g:FindFirstChild("BottomLeft") or g
          local e = c:FindFirstChild("Gen") or g:FindFirstChild("Gen", true)
          local f = e and e:FindFirstChild("ItemFrame")
          if f then
            local c = f:FindFirstChild("Gui")
            if c then
              local e = c:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel")
              if e then
                pcall(function()
                  e:Destroy()
                end)
              end
            end
            local e = f:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel")
            if e then
              pcall(function()
                e:Destroy()
              end)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local e = c:FindFirstChild("Survivor-mob")
      local f = e and e:FindFirstChild("Controls")
      if f then
        local c = f:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel")
        if c then
          pcall(function()
            c:Destroy()
          end)
        end
        local e = f:FindFirstChild("Gui-mob")
        if e and e:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel") then
          pcall(function()
            e.ParryCooldownLabel:Destroy()
          end)
        end
        local g = f:FindFirstChild("action")
        if g and g:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel") then
          pcall(function()
            g.ParryCooldownLabel:Destroy()
          end)
        end
      end
    end)
  end

        o = math.max(1.2, 3 - n * .4)
      end

        if not c then
          return ""

        local e = tostring(c)
        e = e:gsub("", ""):gsub("", ""):gsub("\226\154\161", ""):gsub("\226\143\187", ""):gsub("\240\159\145\165", ""):gsub("\240\159\147\169", ""):gsub("\226\154\148\239\184\143", ""):gsub("\226\154\148", ""):gsub("\226\150\182", ""):gsub("\226\151\144", ""):gsub("\240\159\147\132", ""):gsub("\226\151\142", "")
        e = e:gsub("[%z\001-\127\194-\244][\128-\191]*", function(c)
          local e = string.byte(c, 1)
          if e >= 240 then
            return ""
          end
          return c
        end)
        e = e:gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        return e
      end

    function clearAllNotifications()
      table.clear(c)
      for c = #e, 1, -1 do
        local f = e[c]
        if f and f.frame then
          pcall(function()
            f.frame:Destroy()
          end)

      end
      table.clear(e)
    end

        clearAllNotifications()

      end

  function showStartupCapabilityReport()
    local c = getUnavailableFeatures()
    if #c == 0 then
      showNotification("Compatibility Check", "All features supported on " .. l() .. ".", "success")
      return
    end
    local e = table.concat(c, ", ")
    if #e > 90 then
      e = e:sub(1, 87) .. "..."
    end
    showNotification("Compatibility Warning", #c .. " feature group(s) may not work: " .. e, "warning")
  end

      local e = c.Position - _G.VD_MinimapDragStart
      _G.VD_MinimapCard.Position = UDim2.new(_G.VD_MinimapStartPos.X.Scale, _G.VD_MinimapStartPos.X.Offset + e.X, _G.VD_MinimapStartPos.Y.Scale, _G.VD_MinimapStartPos.Y.Offset + e.Y)
    end
  end)
  _G.VD_MinimapCard.InputEnded:Connect(function(c)
    if c == _G.VD_MinimapDragInput then
      _G.VD_IsDraggingMinimap = false
      _G.VD_MinimapDragInput = nil
    end
  end)

  local function ac()
    pcall(function()
      if m or UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
        return
      end
      if Xb then
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Vb
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = Wb
      else
        local c = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") ~= nil
        if c then
          UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
          UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
        else
          UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
          UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
        end
      end
    end)
  end

  function findEmoteByName(c)
    if not c then
      return nil
    end
    for e, f in ipairs(allEmotesList or {}) do
      if f.name == c or f.name:lower() == c:lower() then
        return f
      end
    end
    for e, f in ipairs(v.UserCustomEmotes or {}) do
      if f.name == c or f.name:lower() == c:lower() then
        return f
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  function getFullEmoteList()
    local c = {}
    for e, f in ipairs(allEmotesList or {}) do
      table.insert(c, f)
    end
    for e, f in ipairs(v.UserCustomEmotes or {}) do
      table.insert(c, f)
    end
    return c
  end

  tabButtons = {}
  tabContainers = {}
  tabHeaderTitles = {}
  activeTab = nil
  function switchTab(c)
    if activeTab == c and (not searchContainer or not searchContainer.Visible) then
      if tabContainers and (tabContainers[c] and not tabContainers[c].Visible) then
        tabContainers[c].Visible = true
        tabContainers[c].GroupTransparency = 0
      end
      return
    end
    if searchContainer then
      searchContainer.Visible = false
    end
    if searchBox and searchBox.Text ~= "" then
      searchBox.Text = ""
      if clearSearchBtn then
        clearSearchBtn.Visible = false
      end
    end
    for e, f in pairs(tabButtons) do
      local g = f:FindFirstChild("Icon")
      local h = f:FindFirstChild("ActiveIndicator")
      local i = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
      if e == c then
        TweenService:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(.18), {["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 26), ["BackgroundTransparency"] = .1}):Play()
        if i then
          TweenService:Create(i, TweenInfo.new(.18), {["Transparency"] = 0, ["Color"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)}):Play()
        end
        if g then
          TweenService:Create(g, TweenInfo.new(.18), {["ImageColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), ["ImageTransparency"] = 0}):Play()
        end
        if h then
          TweenService:Create(h, TweenInfo.new(.18), {["BackgroundTransparency"] = 0, ["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, 3, .7, 0)}):Play()
        end
      else
        TweenService:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(.18), {["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(15, 16, 21), ["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1}):Play()
        if i then
          TweenService:Create(i, TweenInfo.new(.18), {["Transparency"] = 1}):Play()
        end
        if g then
          TweenService:Create(g, TweenInfo.new(.18), {["ImageColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), ["ImageTransparency"] = .35}):Play()
        end
        if h then
          TweenService:Create(h, TweenInfo.new(.18), {["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1, ["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, 0, .7, 0)}):Play()
        end
      end
    end
    for e, f in pairs(tabContainers) do
      if e == c then
        f.Visible = true
        f.GroupTransparency = 1
        TweenService:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(.2), {["GroupTransparency"] = 0}):Play()
      else
        f.Visible = false
      end
    end
    activeTab = c
    if c == "Teleport" or c == "TP" then
      if scanMapObjects then
        pcall(scanMapObjects)
      end
      if refreshTPMenu then
        pcall(refreshTPMenu)
      end
    end
  end
  local function ec(c)
    if not c then
      return ""
    end
    return tostring(c):gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):gsub("%s*%+", ""):gsub("%s*%b()", ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
  end
  function resolveTabNameFromInstance(c)
    local e = c
    while e and (e ~= contentFolder and (e ~= screenGui and e ~= game)) do
      if tabByScroll and tabByScroll[e] then
        return tabByScroll[e]
      end
      if tabContainers then
        for a, b in pairs(tabContainers) do
          if e == b then
            return a
          end
        end
      end
      if groupInfoByContent and (groupInfoByContent[e] and groupInfoByContent[e].parentTab) then
        return groupInfoByContent[e].parentTab
      end
      e = e.Parent
    end
    return nil
  end
  function registerSearchableFeature(c)
    if not c or not c.name or c.name == "" then
      return
    end
    local e = ec(c.name)
    if e == "" or e:lower() == "trigger" then
      return
    end
    local f = nil
    if c.container then
      f = resolveTabNameFromInstance(c.container)
    end
    if not f and c.parent then
      f = resolveTabNameFromInstance(c.parent)
    end
    local g = c.tabName or f or currentBuildingTabName or "Home"
    local h = c.sectionName or currentBuildingSectionName or "General"
    local i = {
      ["name"] = e,
      ["rawLabel"] = c.name,
      ["tabName"] = g,
      ["sectionName"] = h,
      ["controlType"] = c.controlType or "Toggle",
      ["container"] = c.container,
      ["parent"] = c.parent,
      ["parentGroup"] = c.parentGroup,
      ["isPremium"] = c.isPremium or B(c.name),
      ["keybindName"] = c.keybindName,
      ["controlRef"] = c.controlRef,
      ["callback"] = c.callback,
      ["description"] = c.description or ""
    }
    table.insert(searchableFeatures, i)
    return i
  end
  function jumpToFeature(c)
    if not c then
      return
    end
    if searchBox then
      searchBox.Text = ""
      searchBox:ReleaseFocus()
    end
    if clearSearchBtn then
      clearSearchBtn.Visible = false
    end
    if searchContainer then
      searchContainer.Visible = false
    end
    local e = c.container or c.parentGroup and c.parentGroup.container
    local f = nil
    if e then
      f = resolveTabNameFromInstance(e)
    end
    if not f and c.parent then
      f = resolveTabNameFromInstance(c.parent)
    end
    if not f then
      f = c.tabName
    end
    local g = {
      ["dashboard"] = "Home",
      ["home"] = "Home",
      ["esp"] = "ESP",
      ["farm"] = "Farm",
      ["autofarm"] = "Farm",
      ["self"] = "Self",
      ["modifiers"] = "Self",
      ["combat"] = "Combat",
      ["tp"] = "Teleport",
      ["teleport"] = "Teleport",
      ["teleports"] = "Teleport",
      ["visual"] = "Visuals",
      ["visuals"] = "Visuals",
      ["config"] = "Config",
      ["configs"] = "Config",
      ["community"] = "Community"
    }
    if f then
      local c = tostring(f):lower():gsub("%s+", "")
      if g[c] then
        f = g[c]
      end
    end
    if not (f and (tabContainers and tabContainers[f])) then
      for a, b in pairs(tabContainers or {}) do
        if a:lower() == tostring(f):lower() then
          f = a
          break
        end
      end
    end
    if not (f and (tabContainers and tabContainers[f])) then
      f = activeTab or "Home"
    end
    if activeTab == f then
      if tabContainers and tabContainers[f] then
        tabContainers[f].Visible = true
        tabContainers[f].GroupTransparency = 0
      end
    else
      switchTab(f)
    end
    if e then
      local c = e
      while c and (c ~= contentFolder and (c ~= screenGui and c ~= game)) do
        if groupInfoByContent and (groupInfoByContent[c] and (groupInfoByContent[c].groupObj and groupInfoByContent[c].groupObj.toggleExpand)) then
          pcall(function()
            groupInfoByContent[c].groupObj.toggleExpand(true)
          end)
        end
        c = c.Parent
      end
    end
    if c.parentGroup and c.parentGroup.toggleExpand then
      pcall(function()
        c.parentGroup.toggleExpand(true)
      end)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
      task.wait(.12)
      local g = tabScrollByName and (tabScrollByName[f] or tabScrollByName[c.tabName])
      if g and (e and e:IsDescendantOf(g)) then
        pcall(function()
          local c = g.AbsolutePosition.Y
          local f = e.AbsolutePosition.Y
          local h = g.CanvasPosition.Y
          local i = h + (f - c) - 50
          g.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, i))
        end)
      end
      if e and (e.Parent and e.Parent:IsA("ScrollingFrame")) then
        local c = e.Parent
        pcall(function()
          local f = c.AbsolutePosition.Y
          local g = e.AbsolutePosition.Y
          local h = c.CanvasPosition.Y
          local i = h + (g - f) - 20
          c.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, i))
        end)
      end
      if e then
        pcall(function()

  function updateSearchResults(c)
    for c, e in ipairs(renderedResultCards) do

      end
    end
    renderedResultCards = {}

      if searchSubLbl then

      end
      return
    end
    local e = {}
    local f = {}
    for g, h in ipairs(searchableFeatures) do
      local i = h.name:lower()
      local j = (h.sectionName or ""):lower()
      local k = (h.tabName or ""):lower()
      local l = (h.keybindName or ""):lower()
      local m = (h.description or ""):lower()
      local n = nil
      if i == c then
        n = 1
      elseif i:sub(1, #c) == c then
        n = 2
      elseif i:find(c, 1, true) then
        n = 3
      elseif j:find(c, 1, true) then
        n = 4
      elseif k:find(c, 1, true) then
        n = 5
      elseif l:find(c, 1, true) or m:find(c, 1, true) then
        n = 6
      end
      if n and not f[h.name .. ":" .. (h.tabName or "")] then
        f[h.name .. ":" .. (h.tabName or "")] = true
        table.insert(e, {["feat"] = h, ["score"] = n})
      end
    end
    table.sort(e, function(c, e)
      if c.score ~= e.score then
        return c.score < e.score
      end
      return c.feat.name < e.feat.name
    end)
    if searchSubLbl then
      searchSubLbl.Text = string.format("Found %d feature(s) matching \"%s\"", #e, c)
    end

  local fc = {}
  function resolveIcon(c, e)
    if fc[c] then
      return fc[c]
    end
    local f = t or syn and syn.getcustomasset
    if f and (writefile and (isfile and readfile)) then
      local e = "VD_Icons"
      if not isfolder or not isfolder(e) then
        pcall(makefolder, e)
      end
      local g = e .. "/" .. c .. ".png"
      if isfile(g) then
        local a, b = pcall(f, g)
        if a and b then
          fc[c] = b
          return b
        end
      else
        task.spawn(function()
          pcall(function()
            local e = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/latte-soft/lucide-roblox/master/icons/compiled/48px/" .. c .. ".png"
            local f = game:HttpGet(e)
            if f and #f > 50 then
              writefile(g, f)
            end
          end)
        end)
      end
    end
    fc[c] = e
    return e
  end

  toggleInProgress = false
  function toggleUI(e)
    if not mainFrame then
      return
    end
    if x then
      return
    end
    if toggleInProgress then
      return
    end
    local f = e ~= nil and e or not mainFrame.Visible
    if Ub then
      Ub.Visible = m or UserInputService.TouchEnabled
    end
    mainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
    local g = themes[currentThemeName] or themes.Default
    local h = localPlayer:GetMouse()
    if f then
      Zb()
      toggleInProgress = true
      Yb = true
      mainFrame.Visible = true
      pcall(function()
        local c = mainFrame:FindFirstChild("ModalButton")
        if c then
          c.Modal = true
        end
        h.Icon = "rbxassetid://26140499"
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
      end)
      mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, UI.MainW * .85, 0, UI.MainH * .85)
      mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(.5, -(UI.MainW * .85) / 2, .5, -(UI.MainH * .85) / 2)
      mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      local e = TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        ["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, UI.MainW, 0, UI.MainH),
        ["Position"] = UDim2.new(.5, -UI.MainW / 2, .5, -UI.MainH / 2)
      })
      local f = v.CustomBackground and (v.CustomBackground.Enabled and (q() and (c and ((c.CustomBackground or c["Custom Background"]) and (Pb and Pb.Visible)))))
      local i = f and 1 or g.BgTrans
      local j = TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {["BackgroundTransparency"] = i})
      e:Play()
      j:Play()
      e.Completed:Connect(function()
        toggleInProgress = false
      end)
    else
      toggleInProgress = true
      Yb = false
      pcall(function()
        local c = mainFrame:FindFirstChild("ModalButton")
        if c then
          c.Modal = false
        end
        ac()
      end)
      local c = TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
        ["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, UI.MainW * .85, 0, UI.MainH * .85),

      })

      c:Play()
      e:Play()
      c.Completed:Connect(function()
        mainFrame.Visible = false
        toggleInProgress = false
      end)
    end
  end
  local function gc(c)
    if not c or c == "" or c == "None" then
      return "None"
    end
    local e = tostring(c)
    local f = false
    if e:sub(1, 5):lower() == "hold " then
      f = true
      e = e:sub(6)
    end
    local g = e:gsub("Enum%.KeyCode%.", "")
    if f then
      return "HOLD " .. g
    end
    return g
  end

          if f == "Escape" or f == "Backspace" or f == "Delete" then
            n()
            v.Keybinds[e] = "None"
            pcall(saveSettings)
            j(true)
            if _G.VD_RefreshHotkeys then
              pcall(_G.VD_RefreshHotkeys)
            end
            return
          end
          if not i then
            i = f
            k = tick()
            g.Text = i:upper()
            l = task.spawn(function()
              task.wait(.4)
              if i == f and isBindingKey then
                g.Text = "HOLD " .. i:upper()
                TweenService:Create(h, TweenInfo.new(.15), {["Color"] = UI.AccentPink or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 120), ["Thickness"] = 1.4}):Play()
                g.TextColor3 = UI.AccentPink or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 120)
              end
            end)
          end
        end
      end)
      f = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(c)
        local f = c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2 or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3 or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4
        local g = c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or f
        local h = c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
        if (g or h) and i then
          local f = g and c.KeyCode.Name or c.UserInputType.Name
          if f == i then
            local c = tick() - k
            n()
            if c >= .4 then
              v.Keybinds[e] = "Hold " .. i
              showNotification("Keybind Set", e .. " bound to HOLD " .. i, "success")
            else
              v.Keybinds[e] = i
              showNotification("Keybind Set", e .. " bound to " .. i, "success")
            end
            pcall(saveSettings)
            j(true)
            if _G.VD_RefreshHotkeys then
              pcall(_G.VD_RefreshHotkeys)
            end
          end
        end
      end)
    end)
    j(false)
    return g
  end

  function createSlider(c, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l)
    local m = nil
    local n = ""
    if type(k) == "number" then
      m = k
      if type(l) == "string" then
        n = l
      end
    elseif type(k) == "string" then
      n = k
    elseif type(l) == "string" then
      n = l
    end
    local o = B(e)
    local p = e
    local r = Instance.new("Frame")
    r.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
    r.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    r.BackgroundTransparency = .5
    r.BorderSizePixel = 0
    r.Parent = c
    Instance.new("UICorner", r).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", r)
    s.Color = UI.StrokeDim
    s.Thickness = .9
    local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t.RichText = true
    t.Size = UDim2.new(.6, 0, 0, 18)
    t.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 4)
    t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    t.Text = p
    t.TextColor3 = UI.Text
    t.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    t.TextSize = 12
    t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    t.Parent = r
    local function u(c)
      local e = tonumber(c) or 0
      if type(m) == "number" and (m > 0 and m < .1) then
        if g then
          return string.format("%.2f / %.2f%s", e, g, n)
        end
        return string.format("%.2f%s", e, n)
      end
      if g then
        return tostring(math.round(e * 100) / 100) .. " / " .. tostring(g) .. n
      end
      return tostring(math.round(e * 100) / 100) .. n
    end
    local v = h
    local w = Instance.new("TextBox")
    w.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 18)
    w.Position = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 4)
    w.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    w.Text = u(h)
    w.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
    w.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    w.TextSize = 11
    w.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    w.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    w.Parent = r
    local x = Instance.new("TextButton")
    x.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 3)
    x.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 26)
    x.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 43)
    x.BorderSizePixel = 0
    x.Text = ""
    x.AutoButtonColor = false
    x.Parent = r
    Instance.new("UICorner", x).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local y = Instance.new("Frame")
    y.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    y.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Text
    y.BorderSizePixel = 0
    y.Parent = x
    Instance.new("UICorner", y).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local z = Instance.new("Frame")
    z.Size = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 9)
    z.Position = UDim2.new(0, -4, .5, -4)
    z.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    z.BorderSizePixel = 0
    z.Parent = x
    Instance.new("UICorner", z).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local function A(c, e)
      v = c
      local h = math.clamp((c - f) / (g - f), 0, 1)
      y.Size = UDim2.new(h, 0, 1, 0)
      z.Position = UDim2.new(h, -4, .5, -4)
      if not w:IsFocused() then
        w.Text = u(c)
      end
      if e and i then
        pcall(i, c)
      end
    end
    w.FocusLost:Connect(function()
      if not q() and o then
        showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
        w.Text = u(v)
        return
      end
      local c = w.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", "")
      local e = tonumber(c)
      if e then
        e = math.clamp(e, f, g)
        A(e, true)
      else
        w.Text = u(v)
      end
    end)
    local function C(c)
      local e = x.AbsoluteSize.X
      if e <= 0 then
        e = 180
      end
      local h = math.clamp(c.Position.X - x.AbsolutePosition.X, 0, e)
      local j = h / e
      local k = f + (g - f) * j
      if type(m) == "number" and m > 0 then
        k = math.round(k / m) * m
      else
        k = math.round(k)
      end
      v = k
      y.Size = UDim2.new(j, 0, 1, 0)
      z.Position = UDim2.new(j, -4, .5, -4)
      if not w:IsFocused() then
        w.Text = u(k)
      end
      i(k)
    end
    local D = math.clamp((h - f) / (g - f), 0, 1)
    y.Size = UDim2.new(D, 0, 1, 0)
    z.Position = UDim2.new(D, -4, 0.5, -4)
    local E = false
    x.InputBegan:Connect(function(c)
      if c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        if not q() and o then
          showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
          return
        end
        E = true
        C(c)
      end
    end)
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(c)
      if E and (c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        C(c)
      end
    end))
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(c)
      if c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        E = false
      end
    end))
    local F = {["setValue"] = A, ["container"] = r}
    registerSearchableFeature({
      ["name"] = e,
      ["parent"] = c,
      ["controlType"] = "Slider",
      ["container"] = r,
      ["isPremium"] = o,
      ["controlRef"] = F,
      ["callback"] = i
    })
    return F
  end

  function setRevolverAutofarm(c)
    if c and not q("RevolverAutofarm") then
      showNotification("Premium Feature +", "Unlock the Premium version to use this feature!", "warning")
      if controlRegistry.RevolverAutofarm and controlRegistry.RevolverAutofarm.setValue then
        pcall(function()
          controlRegistry.RevolverAutofarm.setValue(false)
        end)
      end
      return
    end
    v.RevolverAutofarm = c
    if c then
      if not v.InstantHeal then
        instantHealWasDisabledBeforeRevolver = true
        v.InstantHeal = true
        if controlRegistry.InstantHeal and controlRegistry.InstantHeal.setValue then
          pcall(function()
            controlRegistry.InstantHeal.setValue(true)
          end)
        end
      else
        instantHealWasDisabledBeforeRevolver = false
      end
    else
      if instantHealWasDisabledBeforeRevolver then
        v.InstantHeal = false
        if controlRegistry.InstantHeal and controlRegistry.InstantHeal.setValue then
          pcall(function()
            controlRegistry.InstantHeal.setValue(false)
          end)
        end
        instantHealWasDisabledBeforeRevolver = false
      end
    end
    if controlRegistry.RevolverAutofarm and controlRegistry.RevolverAutofarm.setValue then
      pcall(function()
        controlRegistry.RevolverAutofarm.setValue(c)
      end)
    end
    pcall(saveSettings)
  end

        local g = _G.VD_SKYBOX_PRESETS[e.Preset]
        if e.Preset == "Custom Textures" or not g then
          local c = e.CustomBk and e.CustomBk ~= "" and e.CustomBk or "rbxassetid://159454299"
          f.SkyboxBk = e.CustomBk and e.CustomBk ~= "" and e.CustomBk or c
          f.SkyboxDn = e.CustomDn and e.CustomDn ~= "" and e.CustomDn or c
          f.SkyboxFt = e.CustomFt and e.CustomFt ~= "" and e.CustomFt or c
          f.SkyboxLf = e.CustomLf and e.CustomLf ~= "" and e.CustomLf or c
          f.SkyboxRt = e.CustomRt and e.CustomRt ~= "" and e.CustomRt or c
          f.SkyboxUp = e.CustomUp and e.CustomUp ~= "" and e.CustomUp or c
        else
          f.SkyboxBk = g.Bk
          f.SkyboxDn = g.Dn
          f.SkyboxFt = g.Ft
          f.SkyboxLf = g.Lf
          f.SkyboxRt = g.Rt

        end
        f.CelestialBodiesShown = e.CelestialBodies ~= false
      end)
    end
    local function e(c)
      if not c then
        return nil
      end
      c = tostring(c):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
      if c == "" then
        return nil
      end
      local e = tonumber(c)
      if e and e > 0 then
        return e
      end
      local f, g = pcall(function()
        return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(c)
      end)
      if f and g then
        return g
      end
      return nil
    end
    _G.VD_GetTargetPlayers = function(c)
      c = c or v and (v.PlayerCustomizer and v.PlayerCustomizer.SelectedTarget) or "LocalPlayer (Self)"
      local e = {}
      if c == "LocalPlayer (Self)" or c == "Self" then
        if localPlayer then
          table.insert(e, localPlayer)
        end
      elseif c == "All Players" then
        for c, f in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          table.insert(e, f)
        end
      elseif c == "Killer" then
        for c, f in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          local g = ActiveESP and (ActiveESP.Players and ActiveESP.Players[f])
          local h = g and g.IsKiller or f.Team and f.Team.Name == "Killer"
          if h then
            table.insert(e, f)
          end
        end
      elseif c == "Survivors" then
        for c, f in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          local g = ActiveESP and (ActiveESP.Players and ActiveESP.Players[f])
          local h = g and g.IsSurvivor or f.Team and f.Team.Name == "Survivors"
          if h and f ~= localPlayer then
            table.insert(e, f)
          end
        end
      else
        for f, g in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          if g.Name == c or g.DisplayName == c or tostring(g.UserId) == c then
            table.insert(e, g)
            break
          end
        end
      end
      return e
    end
    _G.VD_GetLobbyPlayerOptions = function()
      local c = {"LocalPlayer (Self)", "All Players", "Killer", "Survivors"}
      local e = {"LocalPlayer (Self)", "All Players", "Killer", "Survivors"}
      for f, g in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if g ~= localPlayer then
          local f = string.format("%s (@%s)", g.DisplayName or g.Name, g.Name)
          table.insert(c, f)
          table.insert(e, g.Name)
        end
      end
      return c, e
    end
    _G.VD_UpdateCustomParticles = function()
      pcall(function()
        local c = v.CustomParticles
        if not c or not c.Enabled then
          for c, e in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if e.Character then
              for c, e in ipairs(e.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if e.Name == "VD_CustomParticleEmitter" or e.Name == "VD_CustomParticleAttachment" then
                  pcall(function()
                    e:Destroy()
                  end)
                end
              end
            end
          end
          return
        end
        local e = _G.VD_GetTargetPlayers(c.Target)
        local f = {}
        for a, b in ipairs(e) do
          f[b] = true
        end
        for c, e in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          if not f[e] and e.Character then
            for c, e in ipairs(e.Character:GetDescendants()) do
              if e.Name == "VD_CustomParticleEmitter" or e.Name == "VD_CustomParticleAttachment" then
                pcall(function()
                  e:Destroy()
                end)
              end
            end
          end
        end
        local g = _G.VD_PARTICLE_PRESETS.Hellfire
        local h = c.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        local i = c.Rate or 25
        local j = c.Size or 1
        for e, f in ipairs(e) do
          local k = f.Character
          if k then
            local e = k:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or k:FindFirstChild("Torso") or k:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
            if e then
              local f = e:FindFirstChild("VD_CustomParticleAttachment")
              if not f then
                f = Instance.new("Attachment")
                f.Name = "VD_CustomParticleAttachment"
                f.Parent = e
              end
              local k = f:FindFirstChild("VD_CustomParticleEmitter")
              if not k then
                k = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                k.Name = "VD_CustomParticleEmitter"
                k.Parent = f
              end
              k.Texture = g.Texture
              k.Rate = i
              k.Size = NumberSequence.new(j * .5, j)
              k.Lifetime = g.Lifetime or NumberRange.new(1, 2)
              k.Speed = g.Speed or NumberRange.new(2, 6)
              k.SpreadAngle = g.SpreadAngle or Vector2.new(180, 180)
              k.Acceleration = g.Acceleration or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
              k.LightEmission = g.LightEmission or .8
              k.LightInfluence = g.LightInfluence or 0
              if g.Rotation then
                k.Rotation = g.Rotation
              end
              if g.RotSpeed then
                k.RotSpeed = g.RotSpeed
              end
              if g.Transparency then
                k.Transparency = g.Transparency
              else
                k.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                  NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
                  NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.8, .1),
                  NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
                })
              end
              if not c.Rainbow then
                k.Color = ColorSequence.new(h)
              end
              k.Enabled = true
            end
          end
        end
      end)
    end

              end)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    _G.VD_ApplySkinToTarget = function(c, f)
      local i = f or v and (v.PlayerCustomizer and v.PlayerCustomizer.SkinTarget) or v and v.SkinChangerTarget
      if not i or i == "" then
        pcall(function()
          showNotification("Skin Changer", "Please enter a valid Username or User ID!", "warning")
        end)
        return false
      end
      local j = _G.VD_GetTargetPlayers(c)
      if #j == 0 then
        showNotification("Skin Changer", "No target players found!", "warning")
        return false
      end
      task.spawn(function()
        local c = e(i)
        if not c then
          showNotification("Skin Changer", "Utente non trovato: " .. tostring(i), "warning")
          return
        end
        local f = 0
        for e, i in ipairs(j) do
          _G.VD_SpoofedSkins[i.UserId] = c
          _G.VD_SpoofedSkins[i.Name] = c
          local j = i.Character
          if j then
            local a, b = pcall(function()
              return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceAsync(c)
            end)
            if a and b then
              h(b, j)
              pcall(function()
                b:Destroy()
              end)
              f = f + 1
            else
              local a, b = pcall(function()
                return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceInfoAsync(c)
              end)
              if a and b then
                g(b, j)
                f = f + 1
              end
            end
          end
        end
        showNotification("Skin Changer", string.format("Skin applied to %d player(s)! (ID: %s)", f, tostring(c)), "success")
      end)
      return true
    end

  do
    local c = nil
    function stopCustomEmote()
      if c then
        pcall(function()
          c:Disconnect()
        end)
        c = nil
      end
      if currentEmoteTrack then
        pcall(function()
          currentEmoteTrack:Stop(.2)
        end)
        currentEmoteTrack = nil
      end
      if currentEmoteSound then
        pcall(function()
          currentEmoteSound:Stop()
          currentEmoteSound:Destroy()
        end)
        currentEmoteSound = nil
      end
      pcall(function()
        local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local e = c and c:FindFirstChild("EmoteHandler")
        if e then
          e:FireServer("StopEmote")
        end
      end)
    end
    function playCustomEmote(e, f)
      stopCustomEmote()
      local g = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
      local h = g and g:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local i = h and (h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or h)
      if not i then
        showNotification("Animation Player", "Character Animator not found!", "error")
        return
      end
      local j = tostring(e):match("%d+") or tostring(e)
      local k = Instance.new("Animation")
      k.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. j
      local l, m = pcall(function()
        return i:LoadAnimation(k)
      end)
      if not l or not m then
        showNotification("Animation Player", "Failed to load emote: " .. tostring(f), "error")
        return
      end
      currentEmoteTrack = m
      m.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
      m:Play(.2)
      pcall(function()
        local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local e = c and c:FindFirstChild("EmoteHandler")
        if e then
          e:FireServer(f)
        end
      end)
      showNotification("Animation Player", f, "info")
      if not (v.WalkWhileEmoting == true) then
        c = registerConnection(h:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MoveDirection"):Connect(function()
          if h.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 and currentEmoteTrack == m then
            stopCustomEmote()
          end
        end))
      end
      m.Stopped:Connect(function()
        if currentEmoteTrack == m then
          stopCustomEmote()
        end
      end)
    end
  end

          end)
        end
        if not g then
          local c = openurl or syn and syn.openurl or fluxus and fluxus.openurl
          if c then
            pcall(function()
              c(e)
              g = true
            end)
          end
        end
        pcall(function()
          setclipboard(e)
        end)
        showNotification(g and "Discordrpc" or "Link Copied", g and "Opening invite in Discord App!" or "Discord link copied to clipboard!", "success")
      end)
      createButton(tabHome, "Join Telegram Community", "Join", function()
        local c = "https://t.me/gethypnosis"
        local e = false
        if setclipboard then
          pcall(function()
            setclipboard(c)
            e = true
          end)
        elseif toclipboard then
          pcall(function()
            toclipboard(c)
            e = true
          end)
        end
        local f = openurl or syn and syn.openurl or fluxus and fluxus.openurl
        if f then
          pcall(f, c)
        end
        showNotification("Telegram", "Link: t.me/gethypnosis copied to clipboard!", "success")
      end)
    end

        local e = localPlayer.Character
        local f = e and e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not f then
          showNotification("Escape Failed", "Character root part not found!", "error")
          return false
        end
        if c and type(c.InstantEscape) == "function" then
          c.InstantEscape(f, showNotification)
          return true
        else
          local c = nil
          local e = math.huge
          for g, h in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if h:IsA("BasePart") and (h.Name == "Fininshline" or h.Name == "Finishline" or h.Name:lower():find("finishline") or h.Name:lower():find("fininshline")) then
              local g = (h.Position - f.Position).Magnitude
              if g < e then
                e = g
                c = h
              end
            end
          end
          if c then
            if _G.VD_StopAllInteractions then
              pcall(_G.VD_StopAllInteractions)
              task.wait(.15)
            end
            if v.AutoFarmPathfinding and _G.VD_SmartWalkTo then
              _G.VD_SmartWalkTo(c.Position, 3)
            else
              safeSegmentedTeleport(f, c.CFrame)
            end
            showNotification("Instant Escape", "Teleported to escape line!", "success")
            return true
          else
            showNotification("Instant Escape", "Finish Line not found!", "error")
            return false
          end
        end
