        local c = localPlayer.Character

        if not e or not f or f.Health <= 0 then

        if F then

            e.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

            local c = nil

            for c, e in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
              if e:IsA("Model") and (e.Name == "Generator" or e.Name:find("Generator")) then
                table.insert(f, e)
              end
            end
            for e, f in ipairs(f) do
              local g = f:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or f:FindFirstChild("Engine") or f:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
              if g then
                c = f
                break
              end
            end
            local g = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local h = g:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local i = h and h:FindFirstChild("Generator")
            local j = i and i:FindFirstChild("RepairEvent") or g:FindFirstChild("RepairEvent", true)
            if c then
              local f = c:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or c:FindFirstChild("Engine") or c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
              if f then
                e.CFrame = f.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                e.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                task.wait(.2)
              end
              local g = nil
              for c, e in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
                if e.Name:lower():find("point") then
                  g = e
                  break
                end
              end
              if j and g then
                local c = game:GetService("HttpService")
                local e = "FEB67C57-1E59-4609-B765-6304242AC088"
                pcall(function()
                  e = c:GenerateGUID(false)
                end)
                local f = localPlayer.Character
                pcall(function()
                  j:FireServer(g, true, nil, e, f)
                end)
                task.wait(.25)
                pcall(function()
                  j:FireServer(g, false, nil, e, f)
                end)
                task.wait(.2)
              end
            end
            local function k()
              local c = localPlayer.Character
              local e = nil
              if c then
                e = c:GetAttribute("anticampCharge") or c:GetAttribute("AntiCampCharge") or c:GetAttribute("AnticampCharge") or c:GetAttribute("antiCampCharge")
              end
              if e == nil then
                e = localPlayer:GetAttribute("anticampCharge") or localPlayer:GetAttribute("AntiCampCharge") or localPlayer:GetAttribute("AnticampCharge") or localPlayer:GetAttribute("antiCampCharge")
              end
              if e == nil and c then
                local f = c:FindFirstChild("anticampCharge", true) or c:FindFirstChild("AntiCampCharge", true)
                if f and f:IsA("ValueObject") then
                  e = f.Value
                end
              end
              return tonumber(e) or 0
            end
            local l = tick()
            local m = 60
            local n = -1
            while F and tick() - l < m do
              local c = k()
              if c >= 100 then
                break
              end
              local f = math.floor(c)
              if f % 25 == 0 and (f ~= n and f > 0) then
                n = f
                showNotification("Auto Unhook", string.format("Charging Anti-Camp: %d%%", f), "info")
              end
              local g = nil
              if T then
                local c = T()
                if c and #c > 0 then
                  for c, e in ipairs(c) do
                    local f = e and (e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or e:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
                    if f then
                      g = f
                      break
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
              if not g then
                for c, e in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                  if e ~= localPlayer and e.Character then
                    local c = e.Character
                    local f = e:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or e:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true or c:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or c:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
                    if not f and e.Team then
                      local c = e.Team.Name:lower()
                      if c:find("killer") or c:find("slasher") or c:find("monster") then
                        f = true
                      end
                    end
                    if f then
                      g = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or c:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                      if g then
                        break
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
              if g and (e and e.Parent) then
                e.CFrame = CFrame.new(g.Position - Vector3.new(0, 16, 0))
                e.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
              end
              task.wait(.06)
            end
            if e and (e.Parent and G) then
              e.CFrame = G
              e.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
              task.wait(.2)
            end
            local o = nil
            pcall(function()
              local c = h and h:FindFirstChild("Carry")
              o = c and c:FindFirstChild("SelfUnHookEvent")
              if not o then
                o = g:FindFirstChild("SelfUnHookEvent", true)
              end
            end)
            if o then
              o:FireServer()
              showNotification("Auto Unhook", "Self-Unhook event executed successfully!", "success")
            else
              showNotification("Auto Unhook", "SelfUnHookEvent not found in Remotes!", "error")
            end
          end)
          F = false
          if not c then
            showNotification("Auto Unhook", "Error: " .. tostring(f), "error")
          end
        end)
      end

      local function Q()
        local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not c then
          return nil
        end
        local e = RaycastParams.new()
        e.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
        local f = {}
        for c, e in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
          if e and e.Parent then
            table.insert(f, e)
          end
        end
        e.FilterDescendantsInstances = f
        local g = c.CFrame.Position
        local h = c.CFrame.LookVector * 500
        local i = workspace:Raycast(g, h, e)
        if i and i.Instance then
          local c = i.Instance
          local e = c
          while e and e ~= workspace do
            if table.find(cachedPallets, e) then
              return e
            end
            e = e.Parent
          end
        end
        return nil
      end
      local function R()
        if not v.RemoteDropPallet then
          if z then
            pcall(function()
              z:Destroy()
            end)
            z = nil
          end
          return
        end
        local c = Q()
        if c then
          local e = v.RemoteDropPalletColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
          if not z or z.Parent == nil then
            pcall(function()
              if z then
                z:Destroy()
              end
            end)
            z = Instance.new("Highlight")
            z.Name = "VD_PalletTargetHighlight"
            z.FillColor = e
            z.FillTransparency = .6
            z.OutlineColor = e
            z.OutlineTransparency = 0
          else
            z.FillColor = e
            z.OutlineColor = e
          end
          if z.Adornee ~= c then
            z.Adornee = c
            z.Parent = c
          end
        else
          if z then
            z.Adornee = nil
            z.Parent = nil
          end
        end
      end
      local function S()
        if not v.RemoteDropPallet then
          return
        end
        local c = Q()
        if not c then
          showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "No pallet targeted!", "warning")
          return
        end
        local e = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local f = e and e:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
        local g = f and f:FindFirstChild("PalletDropEvent")
        if not g then
          showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "PalletDropEvent remote not found!", "error")
          return
        end
        local h = localPlayer.Character
        local i = h and h:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not i then
          showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "Character root not found!", "error")
          return
        end
        local j = c:FindFirstChild("Intact")
        if not j then
          showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "Pallet already dropped or broken!", "warning")
          return
        end
        local k = j:GetChildren()
        local l = k[8] and (k[8]:IsA("BasePart") and k[8]) or j:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or k[1] and (k[1]:IsA("BasePart") and k[1]) or c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or c:IsA("Model") and c.PrimaryPart
        if not l then
          showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "No valid pallet part found!", "error")
          return
        end
        local m = l.Position
        local n = (i.Position - m).Magnitude
        local o = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
        local p = false
        if n <= 14 then
          pcall(function()
            _G.VD_LastRemoteDropTime = tick()
            g:FireServer(l, m, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), o, h)
            p = true
          end)
        else
          local c = i.CFrame
          local e = m + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
          safeSegmentedTeleport(i, e)
          task.wait(.05)
          pcall(function()
            _G.VD_LastRemoteDropTime = tick()
            g:FireServer(l, m, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), o, h)
            p = true
          end)
          task.wait(.08)
          safeSegmentedTeleport(i, c)
        end
        if p then
          showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "Pallet dropped remotely!", "success")
        else
          showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "Failed to drop pallet (already dropped?)", "warning")
        end
      end
      task.spawn(function()

      do
        local c = false
        local e = false
        local f = false
        local function g()
          local c = {}
          local e = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") or workspace
          for e, f in ipairs(e:GetDescendants()) do
            if (f.Name == "VaultTrigger" or f.Name == "VaultPoint") and f:IsA("BasePart") then
              table.insert(c, f)
            end
          end
          for e, f in ipairs(cachedVaults) do
            if f and f.Parent then
              for e, f in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do
                if (f.Name == "VaultTrigger" or f.Name == "VaultPoint") and (f:IsA("BasePart") and not table.find(c, f)) then
                  table.insert(c, f)
                end
              end
            end
          end
          return c
        end
        local function h()
          local c = {}
          for e, f in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
            if f and f.Parent then
              for e, f in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do
                if f.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or f.Name:find("Slide") then
                  table.insert(c, f)
                end
              end
            end
          end
          local e = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") or workspace
          local f = e:FindFirstChild("resources")
          local g = f and f:FindFirstChild("Pallets")
          if g then
            for e, f in ipairs(g:GetChildren()) do
              for e, f in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do
                if (f.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or f.Name:find("Slide")) and not table.find(c, f) then
                  table.insert(c, f)
                end
              end
            end
          end
          if getnilinstances then
            pcall(function()
              for e, f in ipairs(getnilinstances()) do
                if f and ((f.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or f.Name:find("PalletPointSlide")) and not table.find(c, f)) then
                  table.insert(c, f)
                end
              end
            end)
          end
          return c
        end
        local function i(c)
          local e = g()
          local f, h = nil, math.huge
          for e, g in ipairs(e) do
            if g and g.Parent then
              local e = (c - g.Position).Magnitude
              if e < h then
                h = e
                f = g
              end
            end
          end
          return f, h
        end
        local function j(c)
          local e = h()
          local f, g = nil, math.huge
          for e, h in ipairs(e) do
            if h and h.Parent then
              local e = h:IsA("BasePart") and h.Position or h.Parent and (h.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and h.Parent.Position)
              if e then
                local i = (c - e).Magnitude
                if i < g then
                  g = i
                  f = h
                end
              end
            end
          end
          if not f then
            for e, h in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
              if h and h.Parent then
                local e = h:IsA("Model") and h.PrimaryPart or h:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                if e then
                  local i = (c - e.Position).Magnitude
                  if i < g then
                    g = i
                    f = h:FindFirstChild("PalletPointSlide", true) or e
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
          return f, g
        end
        local function k()
          if f then
            return
          end
          f = true
          task.spawn(function()
            local g = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local h = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local k = h:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local l = k and k:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
            local m = k and k:FindFirstChild("Window")
            local n = l and l:FindFirstChild("PalletSlideEvent")
            local o = m and m:FindFirstChild("VaultEvent")
            while (c or e) and activeLoop do
              local f = localPlayer.Character
              local h = f and f:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              if h then
                local k = h.Position
                if c and n then
                  local c = j(k)
                  if c and c.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                      n:FireServer(c, true, g:GenerateGUID(false), f)
                    end)
                  end
                end
                if e and o then
                  local c = i(k)

      createSection(tabCombat, "Killers", UI.Accent)
      local n = createCollapsibleGroup(tabCombat, "GENERAL", UI.Accent)
      local o = nil
      local p = nil
      local r = nil
      local s = 0
      local t = false
      local u = nil
      local function w()
        local c = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
        if not c or not c:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or not c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
          t = false
          return false
        end
        if r and (r.character == c and r.state) then
          t = true
          return true
        end
        local e = tick()
        if c == u and e - s < .5 then
          return t
        end
        s = e
        u = c
        local f = localPlayer.Team
        if f then
          local c = f.Name:lower()
          if c == "survivors" or c:find("survivor") or c:find("spectat") or c:find("lobby") then
            t = false
            return false
          end
          if c == "killer" or c == "killers" or c:find("killer") or c:find("slasher") then
            t = true
            return true
          end
        end
        if c:GetAttribute("Killer") == true or c:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or localPlayer:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or c:FindFirstChild("Machete") or c:FindFirstChild("Knife") or c:FindFirstChild("Weapon") then
          t = true
          return true
        end
        local g = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if g then
          for c, e in ipairs(g:GetChildren()) do
            if e:IsA("ScreenGui") then
              local c = e.Name:lower()
              if not c:find("survivor") and (string.find(c, "killer") or string.find(c, "slasher") or string.find(c, "stalker") or string.find(c, "hidden") or string.find(c, "abyss") or string.find(c, "cure") or string.find(c, "veil")) then
                t = true
                return true
              end
            end
          end
        end
        t = false
        return false
      end
      local function x()
        local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local e = c:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        if not e then
          return nil
        end
        local f = e:FindFirstChild("Killers")
        if f then
          local c = f:FindFirstChild("Attack") or f:FindFirstChild("BasicAttack") or f:FindFirstChild("Slash")
          if c and c:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            return c
          end
        end
        local g = e:FindFirstChild("Attacks")
        if g then
          local c = g:FindFirstChild("BasicAttack") or g:FindFirstChild("Attack")
          if c and c:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            return c
          end
        end
        local h = e:FindFirstChild("BasicAttack") or e:FindFirstChild("Attack")
        if h and h:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
          return h
        end
        return nil
      end
      local y = 0
      local z = false
      local function A()
        if not q() then
          return
        end
        if not (v.GeneralKiller and v.GeneralKiller.DoubleTap) then
          return
        end
        if z then
          return
        end
        if not w() then
          return
        end
        local c = tick()
        if c - y < .35 then
          return
        end
        y = c
        z = true
        task.spawn(function()
          task.wait(.05)
          pcall(function()
            if not w() then
              return
            end
            local c = x()
            if c and c:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
              c:FireServer(false)
            end
          end)
          task.wait(.25)
          z = false
        end)
      end
      task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
          local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
          local e = c:WaitForChild("Remotes", 5) and (c.Remotes:WaitForChild("Killers", 5) and c.Remotes.Killers:WaitForChild("SlowAttack", 5))
          if e and e:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            registerConnection(e.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
              if v.GeneralKiller and v.GeneralKiller.DoubleTap then
                A()
              end
            end))
          end
        end)
      end)
      local B = 0
      local C = false
      local D = 0
      local E = nil
      local function F(c, e, f, g)
        if not c or type(c) ~= "table" then
          return
        end
        if rawget(c, "_origMaxHold") == nil and c.maxHold ~= math.huge then
          rawset(c, "_origMaxHold", c.maxHold)
        end
        local h = rawget(c, "_origMaxHold") or .6
        if e then
          if f == "Custom" or f == "Custom Duration" then
            c.maxHold = g
          else
            c.maxHold = math.huge
          end
        else
          c.maxHold = h
        end
      end
      local function G(c)
        if not c then
          return
        end
        if rawget(c, "_origCustom") == nil and rawget(c, "_cdHooked") == nil then
          rawset(c, "_origCustom", rawget(c, "custom"))
        end
        local e = rawget(c, "_origCustom")
        local f = v.GeneralKiller or {}
        if q() and f.AttackCooldown then
          rawset(c, "_cdHooked", true)
          c.custom = function(c, f, g, h)
            if c then
              r = c
            end
            local i = v.GeneralKiller or {}
            if not q() or not i.AttackCooldown or c and (c.state and c.state.isTrueStunned) then
              if e then
                return e(c, f, g, h)
              end
              return
            end
            local j = f or "Nothing"
            if j == "Parried" then
              if e then
                return e(c, f, g, h)
              end
              return
            end
            if not c.afterAttackPlaying then
              c.afterAttackPlaying = true
              c.state.isStunned = true
              c.state.canUpdateSpeed = false
              if c.humanoid then
                c.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
              end
              local e = 16
              if c.character then
                e = (c.character:GetAttribute("Speed") or 16) * (c.character:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1)
              end
              if c.humanoid then
                c.humanoid.WalkSpeed = e * .1535
              end
              pcall(function()
                if j == "Nothing" then
                  if c.stopAllAnimations then
                    c.stopAllAnimations()
                  end
                  c.state.isAttacking = false
                else
                  if c.stopAllAnimations then
                    c.stopAllAnimations()
                  end
                  c.state.isAttacking = false
                  if j == "WallHitStun" and c.playAnimation then
                    c.playAnimation("wallhitvm", true)
                  elseif j == "WipeMachete" and c.playAnimation then
                    c.playAnimation("wipevm", true)
                  end
                  local e = c.animations and c.animations[j]
                  if e then
                    e:Play()
                    e:AdjustSpeed(g or 1.5)
                  end
                end
              end)
              local f = tonumber(i.AttackCooldownTime) or .1
              if f > 0 then
                task.wait(f)
              end
              pcall(function()
                if c.stopAllAnimations then
                  c.stopAllAnimations()
                end
                c.state.isStunned = false
                c.state.isAttacking = false
                c.state.attackCount = 0
                if c.motherscript then
                  c.motherscript:SetAttribute("action", false)
                end
                if c.setAction then
                  c.setAction(false)
                end
                if c.character and (not c.state.isTrueStunned and c.humanoid) then
                  local e = (c.character:GetAttribute("Speed") or 16) * (c.character:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1)
                  c.humanoid.WalkSpeed = e
                  c.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
                end
                c.state.canUpdateSpeed = true
                c.afterAttackPlaying = false
              end)
            end
          end
        else
          if e then
            c.custom = e
          end
        end
      end
      local function H(c)
        local e = q()
        local f = v.GeneralKiller or {}
        local g = e and (f.InfiniteLunge or v.Hidden and v.Hidden.InfiniteLunge)
        local h = f.LungeMode or "Infinite"
        local i = tonumber(f.LungeDuration) or 2
        if o then
          F(o, g, h, i)
        end
        if p then
          G(p)
        end
        if r and type(r.afterAttack) == "table" then
          G(r.afterAttack)
        end
        if not e or not (g or f.AttackCooldown) or not w() then
          return
        end
        local j = tick()
        if C or not c and j - B < 2.5 then
          return
        end
        B = j
        C = true
        local k = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
        if getgc and k then
          pcall(function()
            local c = getgc(true)
            if not c then
              return
            end
            for c, e in ipairs(c) do
              if type(e) == "table" then
                if rawget(e, "maxHold") ~= nil and rawget(e, "lungeThreshold") ~= nil then
                  o = e
                  F(e, g, h, i)
                end
                if rawget(e, "character") == k and (rawget(e, "state") ~= nil and (rawget(e, "humanoid") ~= nil and (rawget(e, "playAnimation") ~= nil or rawget(e, "playAnimationNoStop") ~= nil))) then
                  r = e
                  if e.humanoid and e.humanoid.JumpPower ~= 0 then
                    e.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
                  end
                  if type(e.afterAttack) == "table" then
                    p = e.afterAttack
                    G(e.afterAttack)
                  end
                end
                if rawget(e, "parriedVmTrack") ~= nil or rawget(e, "onTrackPlay") ~= nil and (rawget(e, "custom") ~= nil or rawget(e, "_origCustom") ~= nil) then
                  p = e
                  G(e)
                end
              end
            end
            table.clear(c)
          end)
        end
        C = false
      end
      registerConnection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
        r = nil
        o = nil
        p = nil
        t = false
        u = nil
        lastAttackStateTime = 0
        D = 0
        E = c
        for e, f in ipairs({1.2, 3}) do
          task.delay(f, function()
            if localPlayer and (localPlayer.Character == c and w()) then
              pcall(H, true)
            end
          end)
        end
      end))
      task.spawn(function()
        while activeLoop do
          task.wait(2.5)
          local c = v.GeneralKiller
          local e = q() and (c and (c.AttackCooldown or c.InfiniteLunge or v.Hidden and v.Hidden.InfiniteLunge))
          if e and (localPlayer and localPlayer.Character) then
            local c = localPlayer.Character
            if c ~= E then
              E = c
              D = 0
            end
            local e = false
            if not r or r.character ~= c or not r.state then
              e = true
            elseif not o or not p then
              e = true
            end
            if e and (D < 3 and w()) then
              D = D + 1
              pcall(H, true)
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      local I = 0
      registerConnection(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local c = tick()
        local e = q()
        local f = v.GeneralKiller or {}
        local g = e and (f.InfiniteLunge or v.Hidden and v.Hidden.InfiniteLunge)
        local h = f.LungeMode or "Infinite"
        if g and ((h == "Infinite" or h == "infinite") and (localPlayer and localPlayer.Character)) then
          local c = localPlayer.Character
          if c:GetAttribute("lungeboost") ~= 999999 then
            pcall(function()
              c:SetAttribute("lungeboost", 999999)
            end)
          end
        elseif localPlayer and localPlayer.Character then
          local c = localPlayer.Character
          if c:GetAttribute("lungeboost") == 999999 then
            pcall(function()
              c:SetAttribute("lungeboost", 1)
            end)
          end
        end
        local i = r
        if i and (i.state and w()) then
          if i.humanoid and i.humanoid.JumpPower ~= 0 then
            i.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
          end
          if v.GeneralKiller and (v.GeneralKiller.AttackCooldown and (not i.state.isTrueStunned and not i.holdingAttack)) then
            local e = i.afterAttackPlaying or i.state.isAttacking and (i.state.isStunned and not i.state.isLunging)
            if e then
              local e = tonumber(v.GeneralKiller.AttackCooldownTime) or .1
              local f = 16
              if i.character then
                f = (i.character:GetAttribute("Speed") or 16) * (i.character:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1)
              end
              if I == 0 then
                I = c
                if i.humanoid then
                  i.humanoid.WalkSpeed = f * .1535
                end
              elseif c - I >= e then
                pcall(function()
                  if i.stopAllAnimations then
                    pcall(i.stopAllAnimations)
                  end
                  i.state.isStunned = false
                  i.state.canUpdateSpeed = true
                  i.state.isAttacking = false
                  i.state.isLunging = false
                  i.state.attackCount = 0
                  i.afterAttackPlaying = false
                  if i.motherscript then
                    pcall(function()
                      i.motherscript:SetAttribute("action", false)
                    end)
                  end
                  if i.setAction then
                    pcall(i.setAction, false)
                  end
                  if i.character and (not i.state.isTrueStunned and i.humanoid) then
                    i.humanoid.WalkSpeed = f
                    i.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
                  end
                end)

        local function g()
          local c = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
          if not c then
            return nil
          end
          local e = localPlayer:GetAttribute("platform")
          if e == "PC" then
            return c:FindFirstChild("Hidden")
          elseif e == "Mobile" then
            return c:FindFirstChild("Hidden-mob")
          elseif e == "Console" then
            return c:FindFirstChild("Hidden-con")
          end
          return c:FindFirstChild("Hidden") or c:FindFirstChild("Hidden-mob") or c:FindFirstChild("Hidden-con")
        end
        local function h()
          local c = g()
          if c then
            for c, f in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
              if f:IsA("LocalScript") and not f:GetAttribute("VD_CustomHidden") then
                if f.Disabled == false then
                  e[f] = true
                  pcall(function()
                    f.Disabled = true
                  end)
                end
              end
            end
          end
          if localPlayer and localPlayer.Character then
            for c, f in ipairs(localPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
              if f:IsA("LocalScript") and (f.Name:lower():find("hidden") or f.Name:lower():find("leap") or f.Name:lower():find("m2") or f.Name:lower():find("killer")) then
                if f.Disabled == false then
                  e[f] = true
                  pcall(function()
                    f.Disabled = true
                  end)
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
        local function i()
          for c, e in pairs(e) do
            pcall(function()
              if c and c.Parent then
                c.Disabled = false
              end
            end)
          end
          table.clear(e)
        end
        local function j()
          _G.VD_HiddenActive = false
          c = nil
          lastAppliedHiddenChar = nil
          if _G.VD_HiddenConnections then
            for c, e in ipairs(_G.VD_HiddenConnections) do
              pcall(function()
                e:Disconnect()
              end)
            end
            table.clear(_G.VD_HiddenConnections)
          end
          i()
          pcall(function()
            if localPlayer and localPlayer.Character then
              localPlayer.Character:SetAttribute("nom1", false)
              local c = localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("CheckInterractable")
              if c then
                c:SetAttribute("action", false)
              end
            end
          end)
        end
        local k = nil
        _G.VD_ApplyHiddenNoCooldownLeap = function(e)

    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(c, e)
      if e or isBindingKey then
        return
      end
      local f = c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2 or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3 or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4
      local g = c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or f
      local h = c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
      if g or h then
        local e = g and c.KeyCode.Name or c.UserInputType.Name
        if e ~= "Unknown" and (e ~= "None" and v.Keybinds) then
          for c, f in pairs(v.Keybinds) do
            if f and f ~= "None" then
              local g = false
              local h = f
              if type(f) == "string" and f:sub(1, 5):lower() == "hold " then
                g = true
                h = f:sub(6)
              end
              local i = false
              if type(h) == "string" and h:find("+") then
                local c = {}
                for e in h:gmatch("[^+]+") do
                  table.insert(c, e)
                end
                if #c >= 2 then
                  local f = false
                  for a, b in ipairs(c) do
                    if b == e then
                      f = true
                      break
                    end
                  end
                  if f then
                    local f = true
                    for c, g in ipairs(c) do
                      if g ~= e then
                        local c = false
                        pcall(function()
                          if g == "MouseButton3" then
                            c = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3)
                          elseif Enum.KeyCode[g] then
                            c = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[g])
                          end
                        end)
                        if not c then
                          f = false
                          break
                        end
                      end
                    end
                    if f then
                      i = true
                    end
                  end
                end
              else
                if h == e then
                  i = true
                end
              end
              if i then
                if g and c ~= "ToggleUI" then
                  O[c] = true
                  if M[c] then
                    pcall(M[c], true)
                  elseif K[c] then
                    pcall(K[c])
                  end
                else
                  local a = K[c]
                  if a then
                    pcall(a)
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end))
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(c, e)
      if isBindingKey then
        return
      end
      local f = c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2 or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3 or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4
      local g = c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or f
      local h = c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
      if g or h then

        if e ~= "Unknown" and (e ~= "None" and v.Keybinds) then
          for c, f in pairs(v.Keybinds) do
            if O[c] and (f and f ~= "None") then
              local g = type(f) == "string" and f:sub(1, 5):lower() == "hold "
              local h = g and f:sub(6) or f
              local i = false
              if type(h) == "string" and h:find("+") then
                for a in h:gmatch("[^+]+") do
                  if a == e then
                    i = true
                    break
                  end
                end
              else
                if h == e then
                  i = true
                end
              end
              if i then
                O[c] = nil
                if M[c] then
                  pcall(M[c], false)
                elseif K[c] then
                  pcall(K[c])
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end))
  end

  local function mc()
    activeTPFilter = activeTPFilter or "All"
    do
      local function c(c, e)
        local f = localPlayer.Character
        local g = f and f:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not g then
          showNotification("Teleport", "Character root not found!", "error")
          return
        end
        local h = {}
        if c == "Generator" then
          local c = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
          local e = c and c:FindFirstChild("Gens")
          if e then
            for c, e in ipairs(e:GetChildren()) do
              if e.Name == "Generator" or string.find(e.Name:lower(), "generator") then
                table.insert(h, e)
              end
            end
          end
          for c, e in ipairs(cachedGenerators) do
            if e and (e.Parent and not table.find(h, e)) then
              table.insert(h, e)
            end
          end
          if #h == 0 then
            for c, e in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
              if e.Name == "Generator" then
                table.insert(h, e)
              end
            end
          end
        elseif c == "Hook" then
          for c, e in ipairs(cachedHooks) do
            if e and e.Parent then
              table.insert(h, e)
            end
          end
          if #h == 0 then
            for c, e in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
              if e.Name == "Hook" or e.Name:lower():find("hook") then
                table.insert(h, e)
              end
            end
          end
        elseif c == "Gate" then
          for c, e in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if e.Name == "Gate" or e.Name:lower():find("gate") or e.Name:lower():find("door") then
              table.insert(h, e)
            end
          end
        elseif c == "Pallet" then
          for c, e in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
            if e and e.Parent then
              table.insert(h, e)
            end
          end
          if #h == 0 then
            for c, e in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
              if e.Name == "Pallet" or e.Name:lower():find("pallet") then
                table.insert(h, e)
              end
            end
          end
        elseif c == "Vault" then
          for c, e in ipairs(cachedVaults) do
            if e and e.Parent then
              table.insert(h, e)
            end
          end
          if #h == 0 then
            for c, e in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
              if e.Name == "Vault" or e.Name:lower():find("vault") or e.Name == "Window" then
                table.insert(h, e)
              end
            end
          end
        elseif c == "Survivor" then
          for c, e in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
            if e ~= localPlayer and (e.Team and (e.Team.Name == "Survivors" and (e.Character and e.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")))) then
              table.insert(h, e.Character)
            end
          end
        elseif c == "Killer" then
          for c, e in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
            local f = false
            if e.Team and e.Team.Name == "Killer" then
              f = true
            elseif e.Name:lower():find("killer") then
              f = true
            end
            if f and (e.Character and e.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
              table.insert(h, e.Character)
            end
          end
        elseif c == "Pumpkin" or c == "Pumpkins" then
          for c, e in ipairs(cachedPumpkins or {}) do
            if e and e.Parent then
              table.insert(h, e)
            end
          end
          if #h == 0 then
            local c = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
            local e = c and c:FindFirstChild("Pumpkins")
            if e then
              for c, e in ipairs(e:GetChildren()) do
                table.insert(h, e)
              end
            end
          end
        end
        local i = nil
        local j = e and -1 or math.huge
        for c, f in ipairs(h) do
          local h = f:IsA("BasePart") and f or f:IsA("Model") and (f.PrimaryPart or f:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")) or f:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
          if h then
            local c = (h.Position - g.Position).Magnitude
            if e then
              if c > j then
                j = c
                i = h
              end
            else
              if c < j then
                j = c
                i = h
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if i then
          if _G.VD_StopAllInteractions then
            pcall(_G.VD_StopAllInteractions)
            task.wait(.15)
          end
          local f = i.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
          if v.PathfindingTP ~= false and _G.VD_SmartWalkTo then
            _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = true
            task.wait(.03)
            _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = false
            task.spawn(function()
              local c = _G.VD_SmartWalkTo(f, 3.5)
              if not c and ((i.Position - g.Position).Magnitude > 4 and not _G.VD_AbortPathfinding) then
                safeSegmentedTeleport(g, i.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
              end
            end)
            showNotification("Teleport", "Pathfinding to " .. (e and "furthest" or "nearest") .. " " .. c .. "...", "info")
          else
            safeSegmentedTeleport(g, i.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            showNotification("Teleport", "Teleported to " .. (e and "furthest" or "nearest") .. " " .. c .. "!", "success")
          end
        else
          showNotification("Teleport", "No " .. (e and "furthest" or "nearest") .. " " .. c .. " found!", "error")
        end
      end
      local function e(a)
        c(a, false)
      end
      local function f(e)
        c(e, true)
      end
      local g = createCollapsibleHeader(tabTP, "Nearest Teleports", UI.Accent)
      createButton(g.content, "TP To Nearest Generator", "TP", function()

      local function r()
        local c = listfiles or syn_io_listfiles or list_files
        local e = {}
        if c then
          local f, g = pcall(c, "")
          if not f or not g then
            f, g = pcall(c)
          end
          if f and type(g) == "table" then
            for c, f in ipairs(g) do
              local g = tostring(f):match("[^/\\]+$") or tostring(f)
              local h = g:lower()
              if not h:find("^dbd_hud_") and not h:find("dbd_hud_") then
                local c = g:match("%.([^%.]+)$")
                if c then
                  c = c:lower()
                  if c == "png" or c == "jpg" or c == "jpeg" or c == "webp" then
                    table.insert(e, g)
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
        return e
      end
      local function s(c)
        local e = {
          "CustomBg_AssetId",
          "CustomBg_LocalFile",
          "CustomBg_LocalBrowse",
          "CustomBg_Overlay",
          "CustomBg_ScaleType"
        }
        for e, f in ipairs(e) do
          local g = controlRegistry[f]
          local h = nil
          if typeof(g) == "Instance" and g:IsA("GuiObject") then
            h = g
          elseif type(g) == "table" then
            if typeof(g.container) == "Instance" then
              h = g.container
            end
          end
          if h then
            pcall(function()
              TweenService:Create(h, TweenInfo.new(.2), {["BackgroundTransparency"] = c and .8 or .95}):Play()
              for e, f in ipairs(h:GetDescendants()) do
                if f:IsA("TextLabel") then
                  TweenService:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(.2), {["TextTransparency"] = c and 0 or 0.5}):Play()
                end
              end
            end)
          end
        end
      end

      local function R(c)
        local e = mainFrame and mainFrame:FindFirstChild("TopRainbowBar")
        if not e then
          return
        end
        local f = Q[c]
        if f then
          e.BackgroundColor3 = f
          local c = f
          v.TopBarColor = {["r"] = c.R, ["g"] = c.G, ["b"] = c.B}
        else
          e.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Accent
          v.TopBarColor = nil
        end
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end
      local S = "auto"
      if v.TopBarColor and type(v.TopBarColor) == "table" then
        local c = Color3.new(v.TopBarColor.r, v.TopBarColor.g, v.TopBarColor.b)
        for e, f in pairs(Q) do
          if f and (math.abs(f.R - c.R) < .01 and (math.abs(f.G - c.G) < .01 and math.abs(f.B - c.B) < .01)) then
            S = e
            break
          end
        end
      end
      task.defer(function()
        R(S)
      end)

      X.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local c = V.Text
        if c == "" then
          showNotification("Import Config", "Paste a JSON config string first!", "warning")
          return
        end
        local e, f = pcall(function()
          return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(c)
        end)
        if not e or type(f) ~= "table" then
          showNotification("Import Config", "Invalid JSON! Check the format.", "error")
          return
        end
        local g = 0
        local h = pcall(function()
          deserializeTable(v, lb)
          deserializeTable(v, f)
          if not q() then
            D()
          end
        end)
        if h then
          for a, b in pairs(f) do
            g = g + 1
          end
        end
        pcall(saveSettings)
        if w then
          pcall(w)
        end
        showNotification("Import Config", "Imported " .. g .. " settings successfully!", "success")
        V.Text = ""
      end)
      createButton(tabConfig, "Get Config JSON (copies to clipboard)", "Copy", function()

            local c = serializeTable(v)
            return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(c)
          end)
          if c and (e and #e > 0) then
            local c = false
            pcall(function()
              if setclipboard then
                setclipboard(e)
                c = true
              elseif Clipboard and Clipboard.set then
                Clipboard.set(e)
                c = true
              end
            end)
            if V then
              V.Text = e
            end
            if c then
              showNotification("Get Config JSON", "Config JSON copied to clipboard!", "success")
            else
              showNotification("Get Config JSON", "Config JSON generated! (Copied to text box above)", "success")
            end
          else
            showNotification("Get Config JSON", "Failed to encode settings!", "error")
          end
        end)
      end, UI.Accent, "GetConfigJson")

      local function fb()
        local c = v.Keybinds or {}
        local e = {}
        local f = {}
        for c, g in pairs(c) do
          if g and (g ~= "None" and g ~= "") then
            local h = db[c]
            local i = h and h.name or c
            local j = h and h.short or i
            local k = h and h.check or function()
              if N and N[c] then
                return N[c]() == true
              end
              if v[c] ~= nil then
                return v[c] == true
              end
              return false
            end
            table.insert(e, {["key"] = c, ["val"] = g, ["name"] = i, ["short"] = j, ["check"] = k})
            f[i] = true
          end
        end
        for c, g in ipairs(eb) do
          if g.check() and not f[g.name] then
            table.insert(e, {
              ["key"] = g.name,
              ["val"] = "",
              ["name"] = g.name,
              ["short"] = g.short or g.name,
              ["check"] = g.check
            })
            f[g.name] = true
          end
        end
        table.sort(e, function(c, e)
          return c.name:lower() < e.name:lower()
        end)
        return e
      end

        local c = h("/rest/v1/config_interactions?username=eq." .. httpService:UrlEncode(localPlayer.Name), "GET")
        if c and (c.StatusCode == 200 or c.status == 200) then
          local e, f = pcall(function()
            return httpService:JSONDecode(c.Body)
          end)
          if e and type(f) == "table" then
            g.likes = {}
            g.loads = {}
            for c, e in ipairs(f) do
              if e.interaction_type == "like" then
                g.likes[e.config_name] = true
              elseif e.interaction_type == "load" then
                g.loads[e.config_name] = true
              end
            end
          end
        end

      task.wait(.05)
      e = e + 1
      if e >= 2 then
        e = 0
        f = not f
      end
      pcall(function()
        if e % 4 == 0 then
          local c = v.KillerStainColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
          for e, f in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
            local g = f.Character
            local h = g and g:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local i = h and h:FindFirstChild("RedSurfaceLight")
            if i and i:IsA("Light") then
              if i.Color ~= c then
                i.Color = c
              end
            end
          end
        end
        local g = localPlayer.Character
        local h = g and g:FindFirstChild("Flashlight")
        if h then
          local e = h:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpotLight") or h:FindFirstChild("SpotLight", true)
          if e then
            if e ~= _G.VD_LastHookedLight then
              if _G.VD_LightChangedConn then
                pcall(function()
                  _G.VD_LightChangedConn:Disconnect()
                end)
              end
              _G.VD_LastHookedLight = e
              _G.VD_FlashlightOnState = e.Enabled
              _G.VD_LightChangedConn = e:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
                if _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled then
                  return
                end
                _G.VD_FlashlightOnState = e.Enabled
              end)
              registerConnection(_G.VD_LightChangedConn)
            end
            local g = v.FlashlightColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            if v.FlashlightEffect == "Rainbow" then
              c = (c + .008) % 1
              g = Color3.fromHSV(c, 1, 1)
            end
            for c, e in ipairs(h:GetDescendants()) do
              if e:IsA("Light") then
                e.Color = g
                if _G.VD_FlashlightOnState then
                  if v.FlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                    _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = true
                    e.Enabled = true
                    _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = false
                    e.Range = 250
                    e.Brightness = 15
                  elseif v.FlashlightEffect == "Strobe" then
                    _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = true
                    e.Enabled = f
                    _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = false
                  else
                    if _G.VD_LastFlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                      e.Range = 51
                      e.Brightness = 1
                    end
                  end
                else
                  _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = true
                  e.Enabled = false
                  _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = false
                  if _G.VD_LastFlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                    e.Range = 51
                    e.Brightness = 1
                  end
                end
              elseif e:IsA("Beam") then
                e.Color = ColorSequence.new(g)
                if _G.VD_FlashlightOnState then
                  if v.FlashlightEffect == "Strobe" then
                    e.Enabled = f
                  elseif v.FlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                    e.Enabled = true
                  end
                else
                  e.Enabled = false
                end
              elseif e:IsA("BasePart") then
                local c = e.Name:lower()
                if c:find("beam") or c:find("light") or c:find("cone") or e.Transparency > 0 and e.Transparency < 1 then
                  e.Color = g
                  if _G.VD_FlashlightOnState then
                    if v.FlashlightEffect == "Strobe" then
                      e.Transparency = f and .5 or 1
                    elseif v.FlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                      e.Transparency = .4
                    end
                  else
                    e.Transparency = 1
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
          _G.VD_LastFlashlightEffect = v.FlashlightEffect
        end
      end)
    end
  end)

  function teleportToInstance(c)
    if not localPlayer or not localPlayer.Character or not localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
      return
    end
    local e
    if c:IsA("Model") then
      e = c.PrimaryPart or c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    elseif c:IsA("BasePart") then
      e = c
    end
    if e then
      if _G.VD_StopAllInteractions then
        pcall(_G.VD_StopAllInteractions)
        task.wait(.15)
      end
      local c = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if c then
        local f = e.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
        if v.PathfindingTP ~= false and _G.VD_SmartWalkTo then
          _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = true
          task.wait(.03)
          _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = false
          task.spawn(function()
            local g = _G.VD_SmartWalkTo(f, 3.5)
            if not g and ((e.Position - c.Position).Magnitude > 4 and not _G.VD_AbortPathfinding) then
              safeSegmentedTeleport(c, e.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            end
          end)
          showNotification("Teleport", "Pathfinding to map object...", "info")
        else
          safeSegmentedTeleport(c, e.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
          showNotification("Teleport", "Teleported to object!", "success")
        end
      end
    end
  end
  function clearTPRows()
    for c, e in pairs(qc) do
      if e.row then
        e.row:Destroy()
      end
      qc[c] = nil
    end
  end
  function createTPRow(c)
    if not tpScroll then
      return
    end
    local e = c.instance
    local f = pc[c.label] or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    local g = Instance.new("TextButton")
    g.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
    g.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    g.BorderSizePixel = 0
    g.Text = ""
    g.AutoButtonColor = false
    g.Parent = tpScroll
    local h = Instance.new("UICorner")
    h.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    h.Parent = g
    local i = Instance.new("Frame")
    i.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -6)
    i.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 3)
    i.BackgroundColor3 = f
    i.BorderSizePixel = 0
    i.Parent = g
    Instance.new("UICorner", i).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 1.5)
    local j = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    j.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
    j.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    j.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    j.Text = string.format("%s  [%dm]", c.label, c.dist)
    j.TextColor3 = f
    j.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    j.TextSize = 11
    j.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    j.Parent = g
    g.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
      TweenService:Create(g, TweenInfo.new(.1), {["BackgroundColor3"] = UI.HoverCard}):Play()
    end)
    g.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
      TweenService:Create(g, TweenInfo.new(.1), {["BackgroundColor3"] = UI.Card}):Play()
    end)
    g.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      if e and e.Parent then
        teleportToInstance(e)
      end
    end)
    qc[e] = {["row"] = g, ["label"] = j, ["typeLabel"] = c.label}
  end
  function collectTPEntries()
    local c = {}
    local e = {}
    local function f(f, g)
      if f and (f.Parent and not e[f]) then
        e[f] = true
        table.insert(c, {["instance"] = f, ["label"] = g})
      end
    end
    local g = activeTPFilter or "All"
    if g == "All" or g == "Generator" then
      for c, e in ipairs(cachedGenerators or {}) do
        if not isGeneratorCompleted(e) then
          f(e, "Generator")
        end
      end
      if #c == 0 and (g == "Generator" or g == "All") then
        local c = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
        local e = c and c:FindFirstChild("Gens")
        if e then
          for c, e in ipairs(e:GetChildren()) do
            if (e.Name == "Generator" or string.find(e.Name:lower(), "generator")) and not isGeneratorCompleted(e) then
              f(e, "Generator")
            end
          end
        end
        for c, e in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
          if (e.Name == "Generator" or e.Name:lower():find("generator")) and (e:IsA("Model") and not isGeneratorCompleted(e)) then
            f(e, "Generator")
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if g == "All" or g == "Hook" then
      for c, e in ipairs(cachedHooks or {}) do
        f(e, "Hook")
      end
      if #c == 0 and (g == "Hook" or g == "All") then
        for c, e in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
          if e.Name == "Hook" or e.Name == "HookPoint" or e.Name:lower():find("hook") then
            local c = e:IsA("BasePart") and e or e:FindFirstChild("HookPoint") or e:IsA("Model") and e.PrimaryPart or e:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if c then
              f(c, "Hook")
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if g == "All" or g == "Pallet" then
      for c, e in ipairs(cachedPallets or {}) do
        f(e, "Pallet")
      end
      if #c == 0 and (g == "Pallet" or g == "All") then
        for c, e in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
          if e.Name == "Pallet" or e.Name:lower():find("pallet") then
            f(e, "Pallet")
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if g == "All" or g == "Vault" then
      for c, e in ipairs(cachedVaults or {}) do
        f(e, "Vault")
      end
      if #c == 0 and (g == "Vault" or g == "All") then
        for c, e in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
          if e.Name == "Vault" or e.Name:lower():find("vault") or e.Name == "Window" or e.Name:lower():find("window") then
            f(e, "Vault")
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if g == "All" or g == "Gate" then
      for c, e in ipairs(cachedGates or {}) do
        f(e, "Gate")
      end
      if #c == 0 and (g == "Gate" or g == "All") then
        for c, e in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
          if e.Name == "Gate" or e.Name:lower():find("gate") or e.Name:lower():find("door") then
            f(e, "Gate")
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if g == "All" or g == "Pumpkin" then
      for c, e in ipairs(cachedPumpkins or {}) do
        f(e, "Pumpkin")
      end
      if #c == 0 and (g == "Pumpkin" or g == "All") then
        local c = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
        local e = c and c:FindFirstChild("Pumpkins")
        if e then
          for c, e in ipairs(e:GetChildren()) do
            f(e, "Pumpkin")
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for c, e in ipairs(c) do
      e.dist = getDistance(e.instance)
    end
    table.sort(c, function(c, e)
      return c.dist < e.dist
    end)
    return c
  end
  refreshTPMenu = function()
    if not tpScroll then
      return
    end
    local c = collectTPEntries()
    clearTPRows()
    if #c == 0 then
      if tpEmptyLabel then
        tpEmptyLabel.Visible = true
      end
      return
    end
    if tpEmptyLabel then
      tpEmptyLabel.Visible = false
    end
    for a, b in ipairs(c) do
      createTPRow(b)
    end
  end
  function updateTPMenuDistances()
    for c, e in pairs(qc) do
      if not c.Parent then
        if e.row then
          e.row:Destroy()
        end
        qc[c] = nil
      else
        local f = getDistance(c)
        local g = string.format("%s  [%dm]", e.typeLabel, f)
        if e.label.Text ~= g then
          e.label.Text = g
        end
      end
    end
  end
  function makeDraggable(c, e)
    local f, g, h, i
    local function j(e)
      local f = e.Position - h
      c.Position = UDim2.new(i.X.Scale, i.X.Offset + f.X, i.Y.Scale, i.Y.Offset + f.Y)
    end
    e.InputBegan:Connect(function(e)
      if e.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or e.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        f = true
        h = e.Position
        i = c.Position
        e.Changed:Connect(function()
          if e.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
            f = false
          end
        end)
      end
    end)
    e.InputChanged:Connect(function(c)
      if c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        g = c
      end
    end)
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(a)
      if a == g and f then
        j(a)
      end
    end))
  end
  makeDraggable(mainFrame, titleBar)
  function makeResizable(c, e)
    local f = false
    local g = nil
    local h = nil
    local i = nil
    e.InputBegan:Connect(function(e)
      if e.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or e.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        f = true
        g = e.Position
        h = c.Size
        e.Changed:Connect(function()
          if e.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
            f = false
          end
        end)
      end
    end)
    e.InputChanged:Connect(function(c)
      if c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        i = c
      end
    end)
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(e)
      if e == i and f then
        local f = e.Position - g
        local i = math.clamp(h.X.Offset + f.X, 420, 1000)
        local j = math.clamp(h.Y.Offset + f.Y, 260, 800)
        c.Size = UDim2.new(0, i, 0, j)
        UI.MainW = i
        UI.MainH = j
      end
    end))
  end

  function doCleanup()
    activeLoop = false
    pcall(function()
      local c = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
      if c then
        local e = {}
        local f = {}
        for c, g in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
          if g:IsA("GuiObject") and g.Name:find("^Survivor%d+$") then
            local c = g.Parent
            if c and not f[c] then
              f[c] = true
              table.insert(e, c)
            end
          end
        end
        for c, e in ipairs(e) do
          if e:GetAttribute("OrigVisible") ~= nil then
            e.Visible = e:GetAttribute("OrigVisible")
            e:SetAttribute("OrigVisible", nil)
          end
          for c, e in ipairs(e:GetChildren()) do
            if e:IsA("GuiObject") and e.Name:find("^Survivor%d+$") then
              if e:GetAttribute("OrigVisible") ~= nil then
                e.Visible = e:GetAttribute("OrigVisible")
                e:SetAttribute("OrigVisible", nil)
              end
            end
          end
          e:SetAttribute("CachedOverlayPos", nil)
          e:SetAttribute("CachedOverlaySize", nil)
          local f = e:FindFirstChild("ViolenceDistrictOverlay")
          if f then
            f:Destroy()
          end
        end
        for c, e in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
          if e:IsA("ImageLabel") and e:GetAttribute("DBDHud_OrigImage") ~= nil then
            e.Image = e:GetAttribute("DBDHud_OrigImage")
            e:SetAttribute("DBDHud_OrigImage", nil)
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    pcall(function()
      if _G.VD_DBD and _G.VD_DBD.restoreSounds then
        _G.VD_DBD.restoreSounds()
      end
    end)

      if z then
        z:Destroy()

                    if c == nil then
                      c = e:IsA("BasePart") and e or (e:IsA("Model") and e.PrimaryPart or e:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or false)
                      R[e] = c
                    end
                    if c then
                      local e = (c.Position - g.Position).Magnitude
                      if e <= 20 then
                        f = true
                        break
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
              if not f and cachedPallets then
                for c, e in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
                  if e and e.Parent then
                    local c = R[e]
                    if c == nil then
                      local f = e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                      if f and (f:FindFirstChild("inviswall") or f:FindFirstChild("inviswall1")) then
                        c = e:IsA("Model") and e.PrimaryPart or f or e:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or false
                      else
                        c = false
                      end
                      R[e] = c
                    end
                    if c then
                      local e = (c.Position - g.Position).Magnitude
                      if e <= 18 then
                        f = true
                        break
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
            yc = f
          end
          if not f then
            h.AutoRotate = false
            local f
            if v.MoonwalkMovementBased and (q() and (c and (c.MovementMoonwalk and h.MoveDirection.Magnitude > .01))) then
              local c = h.MoveDirection:Dot(i.CFrame.LookVector)
              local e = h.MoveDirection:Dot(i.CFrame.RightVector)
              if math.abs(c) > math.abs(e) then
                f = math.atan2(h.MoveDirection.X, h.MoveDirection.Z)
              else
                local c = i.CFrame.LookVector
                f = math.atan2(c.X, c.Z)
              end
            else
              local c = i.CFrame.LookVector
              f = math.atan2(c.X, c.Z)
            end
            local j = 0
            if h.MoveDirection.Magnitude > .01 then
              local c = v.MoonwalkSwaySpeed or 14
              local e = v.MoonwalkSwayAmplitude or .28
              local f = v.MoonwalkShaking or .05
              local g = math.sin(tick() * c) * e
              local h = (math.random() - .5) * f
              j = g + h
            end
            local k, l, m = g.CFrame:ToOrientation()
            local n = f
            if v.ReverseMoonwalk then
              n = n + math.pi
            end
            local o = (n - l + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
            local p = e or .0166
            local r = math.clamp(p * 5.5, 0, 1)
            local s = l + o * r
            local t = 0
            if h.MoveDirection.Magnitude > .01 then
              local c = v.MoonwalkSwaySpeed or 14
              local e = 1.2 / c
              local f = tick()
              if f - zc >= e then
                zc = f
                Ac = -Ac
              end
              local g = Ac * (v.MoonwalkSwayAmplitude or .65)
              Bc = Bc + (g - Bc) * math.clamp(p * 18, 0, 1)
              local h = v.MoonwalkShaking or .05
              local i = (math.random() - 0.5) * h
              t = Bc + i
            else
              Bc = 0
            end
            local u = math.abs(o)
            local w = math.clamp(1 - u / (math.pi / 2), 0, 1)
            t = t * w
            local x = s + t
            g.CFrame = CFrame.new(g.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, x, 0)
          else
            h.AutoRotate = true
          end
        end
        debug.profileend()
      end)
    end
    debug.profileend()
  end))
  local function Cc()
    local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not c then
      return Vector3.zero
    end
    local e = 0
    local f = 0
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Up) then
      e = e + 1
    end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Down) then
      e = e - 1
    end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Right) then
      f = f + 1
    end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Left) then
      f = f - 1
    end
    if e == 0 and f == 0 then
      return Vector3.zero
    end
    local g = c.CFrame
    local h = Vector3.new(g.LookVector.X, 0, g.LookVector.Z)
    local i = Vector3.new(g.RightVector.X, 0, g.RightVector.Z)
    if h.Magnitude > 0 then
      h = h.Unit
    end
    if i.Magnitude > 0 then
      i = i.Unit
    end
    local j = h * e + i * f
    return j.Magnitude > 0 and j.Unit or Vector3.zero
  end
  registerConnection(RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(c)
    if not activeLoop then

  _G.VD_FovGroundRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
  _G.VD_FovGroundRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
