  local function Gc(c, e, f, g, h)
    _G.VD_FovGroundRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = g or {}
    local i = Vector3.new(c.X, f + .5, c.Z)
    local j
    if h then
      j = i + e
    else
      local c = workspace:Raycast(i, e, _G.VD_FovGroundRayParams)
      j = c and c.Position or i + e
    end
    local k = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(j.X, f + 3, j.Z), Vector3.new(0, -10, 0), _G.VD_FovGroundRayParams)
    if k then
      return Vector3.new(j.X, k.Position.Y + .08, j.Z)
    end
    return Vector3.new(j.X, f + .08, j.Z)
  end
  local function Hc(c, e, f, g)
    local h = Instance.new("Part")
    h.Size = Vector3.new(.1, .1, .1)
    h.Transparency = 1
    h.Anchored = true
    h.CanCollide = false
    h.CanQuery = false
    h.CanTouch = false
    h.Parent = c
    local i = Instance.new("Part")
    i.Size = Vector3.new(.1, .1, .1)
    i.Transparency = 1
    i.Anchored = true
    i.CanCollide = false
    i.CanQuery = false
    i.CanTouch = false
    i.Parent = c
    local j = Instance.new("Attachment", h)
    local k = Instance.new("Attachment", i)
    local l = Instance.new("Beam")
    l.Attachment0 = j
    l.Attachment1 = k
    l.Width0 = f or .18
    l.Width1 = f or .18
    l.FaceCamera = true
    l.Color = ColorSequence.new(e or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60))
    l.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(g or .25)
    l.Segments = 1
    l.Parent = h
    return {
      ["p0"] = h,
      ["p1"] = i,
      ["beam"] = l,
      ["update"] = function(c, e, f, g, j)
      h.Position = c
      i.Position = e
      if f then
        l.Color = ColorSequence.new(f)
      end
      if g then
        l.Width0 = g
        l.Width1 = g
      end
      if j then
        l.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(j)
      end
    end,
      ["destroy"] = function()
      pcall(function()
        h:Destroy()
      end)
      pcall(function()
        i:Destroy()
      end)
    end
    }
  end
  function updateKillerGroundFOV()
    local c = v.MasterESP and (v.KillerESP and (v.KillerESP.Enabled and v.KillerESP.GroundFOV))
    if not c then
      if _G.VD_KillerFovFolder then
        cleanupKillerGroundFOV()
      end
      return
    end
    local e = {}
    if T then
      e = T()
    end
    if #e == 0 then
      if _G.VD_KillerFovFolder then
        cleanupKillerGroundFOV()
      end
      return
    end
    if not _G.VD_KillerFovFolder or not _G.VD_KillerFovFolder.Parent then
      _G.VD_KillerFovFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
      _G.VD_KillerFovFolder.Name = "VD_KillerGroundFOV"
      _G.VD_KillerFovFolder.Parent = workspace
    end
    local f = v.KillerESP.GroundFOVColor or v.ESPColors and v.ESPColors.Killer or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
    local g = v.KillerESP.GroundFOVStyle or "Outline Cone"
    local h = v.KillerESP.GroundFOVDistance or 12
    local i = v.KillerESP.GroundFOVTransparency or 0.25
    local j = v.KillerESP.GroundFOVWidth or .18
    local k = math.rad(35)
    local l = 14
    local m = {}
    for c, e in ipairs(e) do
      if not e or not e.Parent then
        continue
      end
      local n = e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not n then
        continue
      end
      m[e] = true
      local o = _G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals[e]
      if not o or not o.beams then
        if o and o.leftLine then
          pcall(function()
            o.leftLine.destroy()
          end)
          pcall(function()
            o.rightLine.destroy()
          end)
          if o.arcLines then
            for c, e in ipairs(o.arcLines) do
              pcall(function()
                e.destroy()
              end)
            end
          end
        end
        o = {["beams"] = {}}
        _G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals[e] = o
      end
      local p = n.CFrame.LookVector
      local q = Vector3.new(p.X, 0, p.Z)
      if q.Magnitude < .001 then
        q = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
      else
        q = q.Unit
      end
      local r = math.atan2(q.Z, q.X)
      local s = {e}
      if localPlayer.Character then
        table.insert(s, localPlayer.Character)
      end
      local t = RaycastParams.new()
      t.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
      t.FilterDescendantsInstances = s
      t.IgnoreWater = true
      local u = workspace:Raycast(n.Position, Vector3.new(0, -15, 0), t)
      local w = u and u.Position.Y or n.Position.Y - 2.8
      local x = Vector3.new(n.Position.X, w + .08, n.Position.Z)
      local y = {}
      local function z(c, e, f, g, h, i)
        f = f or 6
        for j = 0, f - 1, 1 do
          if j % 2 == 0 then
            local k = c:Lerp(e, j / f)
            local l = c:Lerp(e, (j + 1) / f)
            table.insert(y, {k, l, g, h, i})
          end
        end
      end
      local A = v.KillerESP and v.KillerESP.GroundFOVThroughWalls == true
      local B = {}
      for c = 0, l, 1 do
        local e = c / l
        local f = r - k + e * k * 2
        local g = Vector3.new(math.cos(f), 0, math.sin(f)) * h
        local i = Gc(x, g, w, s, A)
        table.insert(B, i)
      end
      if g == "Dotted Arc" or g == "Dotted Cone" then
        z(x, B[1], 8, f, j, i)
        z(x, B[#B], 8, f, j, i)
        for c = 1, l, 1 do
          if c % 2 == 1 then
            table.insert(y, {B[c], B[c + 1], f, j, i})
          end
        end
      else
        table.insert(y, {x, B[1], f, j, i})
        table.insert(y, {x, B[#B], f, j, i})
        for c = 1, l, 1 do
          table.insert(y, {B[c], B[c + 1], f, j, i})
        end
      end
      for c, e in ipairs(y) do
        local f = o.beams[c]
        if not f then
          f = Hc(_G.VD_KillerFovFolder, e[3], e[4], e[5])
          o.beams[c] = f
        end
        f.update(e[1], e[2], e[3], e[4], e[5])
      end
      while #o.beams > #y do
        local c = table.remove(o.beams)
        if c then
          c.destroy()
        end
      end
    end
    for c, e in pairs(_G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals) do
      if not m[c] then
        if e.beams then
          for c, e in ipairs(e.beams) do
            e.destroy()
          end
        end
        if e.leftLine then
          e.leftLine.destroy()
        end
        if e.rightLine then
          e.rightLine.destroy()
        end
        if e.arcLines then
          for c, e in ipairs(e.arcLines) do
            e.destroy()
          end
        end
        _G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals[c] = nil
      end
    end
  end
  function updateParryESP()
    local c = v.AutoParry and (v.ParryRangeESP and v.MasterESP)
    local e = localPlayer.Character
    local f = e and e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not c or not f then
      if _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment then
        pcall(function()
          _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment:Destroy()
        end)
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment = nil
      end
      return
    end
    if not _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment or _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Parent == nil then
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Name = "VD_ParryRangeESP"
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Height = .05
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Transparency = .6
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.AlwaysOnTop = true
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.ZIndex = 10
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -3.1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
    end
    if _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Adornee ~= f then
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Adornee = f
    end
    if _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Parent ~= f then
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Parent = f
    end
    local g = v.ParryRange or 12
    if _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Radius ~= g then
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Radius = g
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.InnerRadius = g - .2
    end
    local h = false
    if T then
      local c = v.ParryRange or 16
      local e = T()
      for e, g in ipairs(e) do
        if g and g.Parent then
          local e = g:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if e then
            local g = (e.Position - f.Position).Magnitude
            if g <= c then
              h = true
              break
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if v.ParryRangeViewInRange and not h then
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Visible = false
    else
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Visible = true
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Transparency = .6
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
  end
  task.spawn(function()
    local c = nil
    local e = 0
    local f = {}
    local g = 0
    local h = false
    local i = 0
    local j = true
    local k = .05
    local l = true
    local m = false
    local n = true
    local o = true
    local p = true
    local r = false
    local s = false
    registerConnection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
      i = 0
      _G.VD_IsParrying = false
    end))
    local function t()
      local function c(c, f)
        if c == "ParryCooldown" or c == "ParryCD" or c == "ParryMissed" then
          if type(f) == "number" then
            i = tick() + f
          elseif c:lower():find("miss") and (f == true or f == 60) then
            i = e + 60
          end
        end
      end
      local f = localPlayer.AttributeChanged:Connect(c)
      registerConnection(f)
      local g = nil
      local h = nil
      local function j(f)
        if not f then
          return
        end
        if g then
          pcall(function()
            g:Disconnect()
          end)
          g = nil
        end
        if h then
          pcall(function()
            h:Disconnect()
          end)
          h = nil
        end
        local j = f.AttributeChanged:Connect(c)
        g = j
        registerConnection(j)
        local k = f.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
          if (c.Name:lower():find("cooldown") or c.Name:lower():find("parry")) and (not c:IsA("Tool") and (not c:IsA("Model") and not c.Name:lower():find("dagger"))) then
            task.wait(.01)
            local f = nil
            if c:IsA("ValueBase") and type(c.Value) == "number" then
              f = c.Value
            else
              local e = c:GetAttribute("Value") or c:GetAttribute("Duration") or c:GetAttribute("Cooldown")
              if type(e) == "number" then
                f = e
              end
            end
            if f then
              i = e + f
            elseif c.Name:lower():find("miss") then
              i = e + 60
            end
          end
        end)
        h = k
        registerConnection(k)
      end
      if localPlayer.Character then
        task.spawn(j, localPlayer.Character)
      end
      local k = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(j)
      registerConnection(k)
    end
    local function u(c)
      return string.match(tostring(c), "%d+") or ""
    end
    local w, x, y, z, A, B, C

      if e then
        table.insert(f, e)

      for c, e in ipairs(f) do

          return f

          local f = e.Name:lower()
          if string.find(f, "parry") or string.find(f, "dagger") then
            return e
          end
        end
      end
      return nil
    end

      if w() ~= nil then

      end
      return false
    end

      local c = localPlayer.Character
      if c then
        local e = c:FindFirstChild("Parrying Dagger") or c:FindFirstChild("Parry Dagger")
        if e then
          return true
        end
        for c, e in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
          local f = e.Name:lower()
          if string.find(f, "parry") or string.find(f, "dagger") then
            return true
          end
        end
      end
      return false
    end
    function y()
      local c = w()
      if c and c.Parent ~= localPlayer.Character then
        local e = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        pcall(function()
          c.Parent = localPlayer.Character

            task.spawn(function()

        task.wait(.01)
      end
    end
    local function D()
      local c, e = pcall(function()
        local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local e = c:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local f = e and e:FindFirstChild("Items")
        local g = f and (f:FindFirstChild("Parrying Dagger") or f:FindFirstChild("Parry Dagger"))
        if g then
          return g:FindFirstChild("parry") or g:FindFirstChild("Parry")
        end
      end)
      if c and e then
        return e
      end
      local f = w()
      if f then
        for c, e in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do
          if e.Name == "parry" or e.Name == "Parry" then
            return e
          end
        end
        for c, e in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do
          if e:IsA("RemoteEvent") or e:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
            return e
          end
        end
      end
      local g = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
      for c, e in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
        if e.Name == "parry" and (e:IsA("RemoteEvent") or e:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then
          return e
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
    local E = nil
    local F = false
    local G = nil
    local H = 0
    local function I()
      if G and (G.tool and G.tool.Parent) then
        return G
      end
      if _G.VD_ActiveParryClient and (_G.VD_ActiveParryClient.tool and _G.VD_ActiveParryClient.tool.Parent) then
        G = _G.VD_ActiveParryClient
        return G
      end
      if not x() then
        return nil
      end
      local c = os.clock()
      if c - H < 3 then
        return nil
      end
      H = c
      local e, f = pcall(function()
        local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local e = c:FindFirstChild("Modules")
        local f = e and e:FindFirstChild("Items")
        local g = f and f:FindFirstChild("ParryingDagger")
        return g and (g:FindFirstChild("ParryClient") and require(g.ParryClient))
      end)
      if e and type(f) == "table" then
        if not f._VD_Hooked then
          f._VD_Hooked = true
          local c = f.new
          if type(c) == "function" then
            f.new = function(...)
              local e = c(...)
              _G.VD_ActiveParryClient = e
              G = e
              return e
            end
          end
        end
        if typeof(getgc) == "function" then
          for c, e in ipairs(getgc(true)) do
            if type(e) == "table" then
              local c = getmetatable(e)
              if c == f or type(e.Parry) == "function" and (rawget(e, "parryEvent") or rawget(e, "daggerFolder") or rawget(e, "tool")) then
                _G.VD_ActiveParryClient = e
                G = e
                return e
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return _G.VD_ActiveParryClient
    end
    local function J()
      if E then
        return
      end
      local c = w()
      local e = nil
      if c then
        e = c:FindFirstChild("parryResult") or c:FindFirstChild("ParryResult")
      end
      if not e then
        local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local f = c:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        if f then
          local c = f:FindFirstChild("Items")
          if c then
            local f = c:FindFirstChild("Parrying Dagger") or c:FindFirstChild("Parry Dagger")
            if f then
              e = f:FindFirstChild("parryResult") or f:FindFirstChild("ParryResult")
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if not e then
        local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        e = c:FindFirstChild("parryResult", true) or c:FindFirstChild("ParryResult", true)
      end
      if e and e:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        E = e.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(c, e, f, g, h)
          if h and (localPlayer.Character and h ~= localPlayer.Character) then
            return
          end
          if g == true then
            F = false
            i = 0
            return
          end
          if f == true then
            F = true
            i = math.huge
            return
          end
          F = false
          local j = tonumber(e)
          if j and j > 0 then
            i = tick() + j
          else
            i = 0
          end
        end)
        registerConnection(E)
      end
    end
    local function K()
      if c and (c.Parent and c:IsDescendantOf(game)) then
        return c
      end
      local e = D()
      if e then
        c = e
        pcall(J)
        if not h then
          h = true
        end
        return c
      end
      return nil
    end
    task.defer(K)
    S = function()
      local c = {}
      for e, f in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if f == localPlayer then
          continue
        end
        local g = false
        if f:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or f:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true then
          g = true
        elseif f.Character and (f.Character:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or f.Character:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true) then
          g = true
        end
        if not g then
          local c = f.Team
          if c then
            local e = c.Name:lower()
            if e:find("killer") or e:find("slasher") or e:find("hunter") or e:find("monster") then
              g = true
            elseif not e:find("survivor") and (not e:find("lobby") and not e:find("spectat")) then
              g = true
            end
          else
            local c = f.Name:lower()
            if c:find("killer") or c:find("slasher") or c:find("hunter") then
              g = true
            end
          end
        end
        if g and (f.Character and f.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
          table.insert(c, f)
        end
      end
      return c
    end
    T = function()
      local c = {}
      local e = S()
      for e, f in ipairs(e) do
        if f.Character then
          table.insert(c, f.Character)
        end
      end
      local f = workspace:FindFirstChild("Killers")
      if f then
        for e, f in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do
          if f:IsA("Model") and (f:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and f:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
            if not table.find(c, f) then
              table.insert(c, f)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if Gb then
        for e, f in ipairs(Gb) do
          if f and f.Parent then
            if not table.find(c, f) then
              table.insert(c, f)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      for e, f in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if f:IsA("Model") and f ~= localPlayer.Character then
          local e = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby") or workspace:FindFirstChild("lobby")
          if e and f:IsDescendantOf(e) then
            continue
          end
          local g = f.Name:lower()
          if g:find("display") or g:find("statue") or g:find("showcase") or g:find("dummy") or g:find("shop") or g:find("pedestal") then
            continue
          end
          if string.find(g, "zombie") or string.find(g, "slasher") or string.find(g, "monster") or string.find(g, "killer") or string.find(g, "veil") or string.find(g, "stalker") or string.find(g, "masked") or string.find(g, "abysswalker") then
            local e = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local g = f:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if e and (e.Health > 0 and (g and not g.Anchored)) then
              if not table.find(c, f) then
                table.insert(c, f)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return c
    end
    local function L(c)
      if not c then
        return false
      end
      local e = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(c)
      if e then
        if e == localPlayer then
          return false
        end
        if e:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or e:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true then
          return true
        end
        if c:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or c:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true then
          return true
        end
        local f = e.Team
        if f then
          local c = f.Name:lower()
          if c:find("killer") or c:find("slasher") or c:find("hunter") or c:find("monster") then
            return true
          elseif not c:find("survivor") and (not c:find("lobby") and not c:find("spectat")) then
            return true
          end
        else
          local c = e.Name:lower()
          if c:find("killer") or c:find("slasher") or c:find("hunter") then
            return true
          end
        end
      else
        if Gb and table.find(Gb, c) then
          return true
        end
        if c:IsA("Model") and c ~= localPlayer.Character then
          local e = c.Name:lower()
          if string.find(e, "zombie") or string.find(e, "slasher") or string.find(e, "monster") or string.find(e, "killer") or string.find(e, "veil") or string.find(e, "stalker") or string.find(e, "masked") or string.find(e, "abysswalker") then
            if c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
              return true
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return false
    end
    A = function()
      return false
    end
    local function M(c)
      if not c then
        return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
      end
      local e, f = pcall(function()
        return c.AssemblyLinearVelocity or c.Velocity or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
      end)
      return e and f or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end
    B = function(c, e)
      local f = (e.Position - c.Position).Unit
      local g = c.CFrame.LookVector
      local h = g:Dot(f)
      if h > -0.1 then
        return true
      end
      local i = M(c)
      if i.Magnitude > 3 then
        local c = i.Unit
        local e = c:Dot(f) > .3
        if e then
          return true
        end
      end
      return false
    end
    local function N(c, e)
      local f = c and c.Animation
      if not f then
        return false
      end
      local g = u(f.AnimationId)
      if g ~= "" and Fb[g] then
        return true
      end
      if e and e.Parent then
        local c = e:FindFirstChild("Animations")
        if c then
          if f:IsDescendantOf(c) then
            return true
          end
          if g ~= "" then
            for c, e in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
              if e:IsA("Animation") and u(e.AnimationId) == g then
                return true
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return false
    end
    local function O(a)
      return nil
    end
    local function P()
      local c = 80
      pcall(function()
        local e = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing()
        if type(e) == "number" and e > 0 then
          c = e * 1000
        end
      end)
      return c
    end
    C = function(c, f, g)
      if not v.AutoParry then
        return
      end
      if _G.VD_IsDodgingStalker == true or tick() - (_G.VD_LastDodgeTime or 0) < 1.5 then
        return
      end
      if not x() then
        return
      end
      local h = localPlayer.Character
      if not h then
        return
      end
      local l = h:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true or localPlayer:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true or ob and ob(h, "Knocked") == true
      local n = h:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true or localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true or ob and ob(h, "IsHooked") == true
      local o = h:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true or localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true
      local p = localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsDead") == true or h:GetAttribute("IsDead") == true
      if l or n or o or p then
        return
      end
      local r = game:GetService("CollectionService")
      if r and r:HasTag(h, "Silenced") then
        return
      end
      local s = h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if s and (s.MaxHealth > 0 and s.Health < s.MaxHealth * .5) then
        return
      end
      local t = h:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if t and (r and (r:HasTag(t, "doing action") and not _G.VD_IsParrying)) then
        return
      end
      local u = h:FindFirstChild("CheckInterractable")
      if u then
        for a, b in ipairs({
          "isVaulting",
          "isSliding",
          "isDroppingPallet",
          "isRepairing",
          "isHealing",
          "isUnhooking",
          "isExiting"
        }) do
          if u:GetAttribute(b) then
            return
          end
        end
      end
      local z = false
      if v.FrenzyParry and q() then
        z = true
      end
      if z and g then
        local c = g:GetAttribute("Frenzy") == true
        if not c then
          local e = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(g)
          if e and e:GetAttribute("Frenzy") == true then
            c = true
          end
        end
        if c then
          return
        end

    local function K(c)
      local f = localPlayer.Character

      local j, k = pcall(function()
        i:ComputeAsync(h.Position, c)
      end)
      if j and i.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        local c = i:GetWaypoints()
        for c, f in ipairs(c) do
          if not v.AutoFarmSurvivor or e ~= "Escaping" then
            break

            g.Jump = true

          j = g.MoveToFinished:Connect(function(a)
            h = true

              j:Disconnect()
            end
          end)
          while not h and tick() - i < 1.2 do
            task.wait(.05)
          end
          if j then
            j:Disconnect()
          end
        end
      else
        g:MoveTo(c)
      end
    end

      return h <= i
    end
    local function O()

            i = true

            i = true
          end
        end
        if i then

          if f then
            if f:GetAttribute("vaultspeed") ~= nil or f:FindFirstChild("vaultspeed") ~= nil then
              c = c + 1
            end
          end
        end
      end

      local g = false
      if f > 25 then
        g = c <= 1
      else
        g = e <= 1
      end
      if g then
        return true
      end

        if e and (e.Parent and N(e)) then

          if f and (f.Parent and isGeneratorCompleted(f)) then
            e = e + 1
          end
        end

        local g = c >= 7 and 2 or 1

      end
      return false
    end

    local function kb(c, e, g)

              n = n - 50000
            end
          end
        end

      if f == c then

      if h == c then

      end

    local function lb(c)

      local g = nil

        local k, l = pcall(kb, i, c, f)
        if k and (l and l > h) then
          h = l
          g = i
        end
      end

    end
    local function mb()
      local c = {}
      local e = os.clock()
      for f, g in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if g == localPlayer then
          continue
        end
        local h = g.Character
        if h then
          local f = ob(h, "HookedProgress")
          local i = false
          if f and tonumber(f) then
            local c = tonumber(f)
            local h = k[g]
            if not h then
              k[g] = {["lastVal"] = c, ["lastChangeTime"] = 0}
            else
              if h.lastVal ~= c then
                h.lastVal = c
                h.lastChangeTime = e
              end
              if e - h.lastChangeTime < 3 then
                i = true
              end
            end
          else
            k[g] = nil
          end
          if i then
            table.insert(c, g)
          end
        end
      end
      return c
    end
    local function nb(c)
      local e = c.Character

        return nil

      if not f then
        return nil

    local function pb(c)
      if not (q() and v.AutoFarmUnhookSurvivors) then
        return nil, nil, nil
      end
      local e = os.clock()
      for f, g in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if g == localPlayer then
          continue
        end
        if Y(g) then
          continue
        end
        local h = g.Character
        if h then
          local f = false
          local i = nil
          local j = ob(h, "IsHooked")
          if j ~= nil then
            if j == true then
              f = true
              i = nb(g)
            end
          else
            local c = ob(h, "HookedProgress")
            if c and tonumber(c) then
              local h = tonumber(c)
              local j = k[g]
              if not j then
                k[g] = {
                  ["initialVal"] = h,
                  ["lastVal"] = h,
                  ["lastChangeTime"] = e,
                  ["firstSeenTime"] = e,
                  ["decreaseCount"] = 0
                }
              else
                if j.lastVal ~= h then
                  if h < j.lastVal then
                    j.decreaseCount = j.decreaseCount + 1
                  else
                    j.decreaseCount = 0
                    j.initialVal = h
                    j.firstSeenTime = e
                  end
                  j.lastVal = h
                  j.lastChangeTime = e
                end
                if e - j.firstSeenTime >= 1 and (j.decreaseCount >= 2 and h < j.initialVal) then
                  if e - j.lastChangeTime < 3 and (h > 0 and h < 100) then
                    i = nb(g)
                    if i then
                      f = true
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            else
              k[g] = nil
            end
          end
          if f and i then
            local e = h:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if e and (not c or (e.Position - c).Magnitude > 75) then
              return i, i, g
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return nil, nil, nil
    end

    local function Bb(c, e, f)
      local g = localPlayer.Character
      local h = g and g:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local i = g and g:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not h or not i or h.Health <= 0 then
        return false
      end
      if wb then
        Ab()
        task.wait(.05)
      end
      local j = typeof(c) == "CFrame" and c.Position or typeof(c) == "Vector3" and c or c and (c:IsA("BasePart") and c.Position)
      if not j then
        return false
      end
      local k = (j - i.Position).Magnitude
      if k <= (e or 3.2) then
        return true
      end
      local l = h.WalkSpeed
      local m = math.clamp(v.SafeWalkSpeed or 22, 16, 26)
      pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
      end)
      local n = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not i or not i.Parent or not h or h.Health <= 0 then
          return
        end
        pcall(function()
          if h.WalkSpeed < m then
            h.WalkSpeed = m
          end
          h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
        end)
      end)
      local o = 5
      local p = 0
      local q = false
      while p < o and not q do
        p = p + 1
        if _G.VD_AbortPathfinding or f and f() then
          q = false
          break
        end
        if not i or not i.Parent or h.Health <= 0 then
          break
        end
        local c = (j - i.Position).Magnitude
        if c <= (e or 3.2) then
          q = true
          break
        end
        local g = p == 1 and 2 or p == 2 and 2.5 or p == 3 and 3 or 3.5
        local k = p == 1 and 10 or p == 2 and 14 or 18
        local l = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
          ["AgentRadius"] = g,
          ["AgentHeight"] = 5,
          ["AgentCanJump"] = true,
          ["AgentJumpHeight"] = k,
          ["AgentMaxSlope"] = 45,
          ["WaypointSpacing"] = 3.5
        })
        local n = pcall(function()
          l:ComputeAsync(i.Position, j)
        end)
        local o = {}
        if n and l.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
          o = l:GetWaypoints()
        else
          if p >= 3 and safeSegmentedTeleport then
            safeSegmentedTeleport(i, j)
            q = (j - i.Position).Magnitude <= (e or 3.5)
            break
          end
          table.insert(o, {["Position"] = j, ["Action"] = Enum.PathWaypointAction.Walk})
        end
        local r = false
        local s = i.Position
        local t = tick()
        local u = 0
        local w = 0
        local x = 1
        local y = nil
        if n and l.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
          y = l.Blocked:Connect(function(a)
            if a >= x then
              r = true
            end
          end)
        end
        for c, g in ipairs(o) do
          x = c
          if _G.VD_AbortPathfinding or f and f() then
            q = false
            break
          end

  function queueTeleportScript()
    local c = queue_on_teleport or syn and syn.queue_on_teleport
    if not c then
      return
    end
    local e = false
    pcall(function()
      if readfile and (isfile and isfile("roblox_helper.lua")) then
        e = true
      end
    end)
    local f = ""
    if e then
      f = "            local success, content = pcall(function() return readfile(\"roblox_helper.lua\") end)\n            if success and content then\n                local fn = loadstring(content)\n                if fn then task.spawn(fn) end\n            end\n        "
    else
      f = "            local url = \"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lixxWW/ViolenceDistrict/refs/heads/main/ViolenceDistrict.lua\"\n            local success, content = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url, true) end)\n            if success and content and #content > 0 then\n                local fn = loadstring(content)\n                if fn then task.spawn(fn) end\n            end\n        "
    end
    pcall(c, f)
  end
  function getTimerSeconds()
    local c = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local e = c and c:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    local f = e and e:FindFirstChild("Spectator")
    local g = f and f:FindFirstChild("time")
    local h = g and g:FindFirstChild("TimerLabel")
    if h and h:IsA("TextLabel") then
      local c = h.Text
      if c then
        if string.find(c:lower(), "not enough players") then
          return -1, c
        end
        local e, f = string.match(c, "(%d+):(%d+)")
        if e and f then
          return tonumber(e) * 60 + tonumber(f), c
        end
      end
    end
    return nil, nil
  end
  function serverHop()
    pcall(queueTeleportScript)
    local c = game:GetService("TeleportService")
    local e = game:GetService("Players")
    local f = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local g = game.PlaceId
    local h = game.JobId
    local i = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. tostring(g) .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100"
    local j = "https://games.roproxy.com/v1/games/" .. tostring(g) .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100"
    local k = syn and syn.request or http and http.request or http_request or fluxus and fluxus.request or request
    local l, m = false, nil
    if k then
      local c, e = pcall(function()
        return k({
          ["Url"] = i,
          ["Method"] = "GET",
          ["Headers"] = {
          ["User-Agent"] = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
          ["Accept"] = "application/json"
        }
        })
      end)
      if c and (e and (e.Body and not string.find(e.Body, "<!DOCTYPE html>"))) then
        l = true
        m = e.Body
      else
      end
    end
    if not l then
      local c, e = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(i)
      end)
      if c and (e and not string.find(e, "<!DOCTYPE html>")) then
        l = true
        m = e
      else
      end
    end
    if not l and k then
      local c, e = pcall(function()
        return k({
          ["Url"] = j,
          ["Method"] = "GET",
          ["Headers"] = {
          ["User-Agent"] = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
          ["Accept"] = "application/json"
        }
        })
      end)
      if c and (e and (e.Body and not string.find(e.Body, "<!DOCTYPE html>"))) then
        l = true
        m = e.Body
      else
      end
    end
    if not l then
      local c, e = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(j)
      end)
      if c and (e and not string.find(e, "<!DOCTYPE html>")) then
        l = true
        m = e
      else
      end
    end
    if l and m then
      local i = nil
      pcall(function()
        i = f:JSONDecode(m)
      end)
      if i and i.data then
        local j = i.data
        if #j > 0 then
          local c = j[1]
          local e = "N/A"
          pcall(function()
            e = f:JSONEncode(c)
          end)
        end
        local k = {}
        for c, e in ipairs(j) do
          local f = tostring(e.id) == tostring(h)
          if e.playing and (e.maxPlayers and not f) then
            if e.playing >= 3 and e.playing < e.maxPlayers then
              table.insert(k, e)
            end
          end
        end
        if #k == 0 then
          for c, e in ipairs(j) do
            local f = tostring(e.id) == tostring(h)
            if e.playing and (e.playing < e.maxPlayers and not f) then
              table.insert(k, e)
            end
          end
        end
        if #k > 0 then
          table.sort(k, function(c, e)
            return (c.playing or 0) > (e.playing or 0)
          end)
          local f = math.min(5, #k)
          local h = k[math.random(1, f)]
          if h and h.id then
            local f = pcall(function()
              c:TeleportToPlaceInstance(g, h.id, e.LocalPlayer)
            end)
            if f then
              return
            end
          end
        end
      else
        if not i then
        else
        end
      end
    else
    end
    pcall(function()
      c:Teleport(g, e.LocalPlayer)
    end)
  end

                    local c = table.find(cachedPumpkins, h)
                    if c then
                      table.remove(cachedPumpkins, c)
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                      removeModelESP(h, "Pumpkins")
                    end)
                  end
                end
              end
            else
              _G.VD_CurrentFarmState = "ALL PUMPKINS CRUSHED"
              if _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus then
                pcall(function()
                  _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus("ALL PUMPKINS CRUSHED")
                end)
              end
            end
          else
            _G.VD_CurrentFarmState = "PUMPKIN (KILLER NEAR)"
            if _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus then
              pcall(function()
                _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus("PUMPKIN (KILLER NEAR)")
              end)
            end
            task.wait(0.5)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  _G.VD_KillerFarmState = _G.VD_KillerFarmState or {}
  _G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries or 0
  _G.VD_KillerFarmState.isHooking = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.isHooking or false
  _G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastHookRemoteTime = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastHookRemoteTime or 0
  _G.VD_KillerFarmState.hookedBlacklist = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.hookedBlacklist or {}
  _G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastGrabTime = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastGrabTime or 0
  task.spawn(function()
    local c = nil
    local function e()
      local c = localPlayer.Character
      local e = localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsCarrying") == true or c and c:GetAttribute("IsCarrying") == true
      if e then

        for e, f in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          if f ~= localPlayer then

            if f:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true or e and e:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true or ob and (e and ob(e, "IsCarried") == true) then
              c = true
              break
            end
          end
        end
        if not c then
          local c = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastGrabTime or 0
          if tick() - c > 4 then
            e = false
          end
        end
      end
      return e
    end
    local function f(c, e)
      local f = tick()
      local g = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.hookedBlacklist
      if g[c] and f < g[c] then
        return true
      elseif g[c] then
        g[c] = nil
      end

        if k then
          continue

        if l and m < 15 then
          return true
        end
        if not l and m < 8 then
          return true
        end
      end
      return false
    end

      local g = nil

                if not e then
                  q = true

              _G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries = 0

          _G.VD_KillerFarmState.isHooking = false

            c = e

                  pcall(function()
                    l:FireServer()
                  end)
                end
                if m then
                  pcall(function()
                    m:FireServer()
                  end)
                end
                _G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries = 0

                task.wait(.15)
                local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Carry"):WaitForChild("CarrySurvivorEvent", 2)
                if c then
                  pcall(function()
                    c:FireServer(g)
                  end)
                end
                task.wait(.2)
                local e = localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsCarrying") == true or l and l:GetAttribute("IsCarrying") == true
                if e then
                  _G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastGrabTime = tick()
                else
                  _G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries = (_G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries or 0) + 1
                  if (_G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries or 0) >= 3 then
                    _G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries = 0
                    task.wait(.5)
                  end
                end
              end
            else
              k("IDLE")
            end
          else
            local c, e = h()
            if #e > 0 and #c == 0 then
              local c = i(e)

                local e = (f.Position - c).Magnitude
                if e > 6 then
                  safeSegmentedTeleport(f, CFrame.new(c))
                end
                k("AWAY (ANTI-CAMP)")
              else
                k("IDLE")
              end
            else
              k("IDLE")
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      if not n and o then
        warn("[Killer Farm Error]: " .. tostring(o))
      end
      task.wait(f)
    end
  end)

  function updateMobileAimbotButton()
    local c = v.RevolverAimbot.Enabled
    if c and m then
      if not _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton or not _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton.Parent then
        if _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton then
          pcall(function()
            _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton:Destroy()
          end)
        end
        local c = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        c.Name = "VD_MobileAimbotGui"
        c.ResetOnSpawn = false
        c.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        pcall(function()
          c.Parent = guiParent
        end)
        if not c.Parent then
          c.Parent = billboardParent
        end
        local e = Instance.new("TextButton")
        e.Name = "AimbotButton"
        e.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 75)
        e.Position = UDim2.new(.8, -37, .55, -37)
        e.BackgroundColor3 = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive and Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        e.BackgroundTransparency = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive and .3 or .5
        e.Text = "AIM"
        e.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        e.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        e.TextSize = 16
        e.Parent = c
        local f = Instance.new("UICorner")
        f.CornerRadius = UDim.new(.5, 0)
        f.Parent = e
        local g = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        g.Thickness = 2
        g.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        g.Transparency = .3
        g.Parent = e
        local h = nil
        local i = nil
        local j = false
        local k = nil
        e.InputBegan:Connect(function(c)
          if c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            h = c.Position
            i = e.Position
            j = false
            local f
            f = c.Changed:Connect(function()
              if c.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                h = nil
                k = nil
                if f then
                  f:Disconnect()
                end
                if not j then
                  _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive = not _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive
                  if _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive then
                    e.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255)
                    e.BackgroundTransparency = .3
                  else
                    e.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                    e.BackgroundTransparency = .5
                  end
                end
              end
            end)
          end
        end)
        e.InputChanged:Connect(function(c)
          if c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            k = c
          end
        end)
        registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(c)
          if c == k and h then
            local f = c.Position - h
            if f.Magnitude > 5 then
              j = true
            end
            e.Position = UDim2.new(i.X.Scale, i.X.Offset + f.X, i.Y.Scale, i.Y.Offset + f.Y)
          end
        end))
        _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton = c
      else
        _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton.Enabled = true
        local c = _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton:FindFirstChild("AimbotButton")
        if c then
          c.BackgroundColor3 = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive and Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
          c.BackgroundTransparency = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive and .3 or 0.5
        end
      end
    else
      if _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton then
        _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton.Enabled = false
        _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive = false
      end
    end
  end
  local function Ic(c, e, f)
    if not c or #c == 0 then
      return nil
    end
    f = math.max(f or 150, 1)
    if e == "Furthest" then
      table.sort(c, function(c, e)
        if math.abs(c.dist - e.dist) > .01 then
          return c.dist > e.dist
        end
        return c.health < e.health
      end)
    elseif e == "Injured" then
      table.sort(c, function(c, e)
        if math.abs(c.health - e.health) > .01 then
          return c.health < e.health
        end
        return c.dist < e.dist
      end)
    elseif e == "Healed" then
      table.sort(c, function(c, e)
        if math.abs(c.health - e.health) > .01 then
          return c.health > e.health
        end
        return c.dist < e.dist
      end)
    elseif e == "NearestInjured" then
      table.sort(c, function(c, e)
        local g = c.dist / f
        local h = e.dist / f
        local i = math.max(c.maxHealth or 100, 1)
        local j = math.max(e.maxHealth or 100, 1)
        local k = math.clamp(c.health / i, 0, 1)
        local l = math.clamp(e.health / j, 0, 1)
        local m = .5 * g + .5 * k
        local n = 0.5 * h + 0.5 * l
        if math.abs(m - n) > .001 then
          return m < n
        end
        return c.dist < e.dist
      end)
    elseif e == "NearestHealed" then
      table.sort(c, function(c, e)
        local g = c.dist / f
        local h = e.dist / f
        local i = math.max(c.maxHealth or 100, 1)
        local j = math.max(e.maxHealth or 100, 1)
        local k = math.clamp(c.health / i, 0, 1)
        local l = math.clamp(e.health / j, 0, 1)
        local m = .5 * g + .5 * (1 - k)
        local n = .5 * h + .5 * (1 - l)
        if math.abs(m - n) > .001 then
          return m < n
        end
        return c.dist < e.dist
      end)
    elseif e == "FurthestInjured" then
      table.sort(c, function(c, e)
        local g = c.dist / f
        local h = e.dist / f
        local i = math.max(c.maxHealth or 100, 1)
        local j = math.max(e.maxHealth or 100, 1)
        local k = math.clamp(c.health / i, 0, 1)
        local l = math.clamp(e.health / j, 0, 1)
        local m = .5 * (1 - g) + .5 * k
        local n = .5 * (1 - h) + 0.5 * l
        if math.abs(m - n) > .001 then
          return m < n
        end
        return c.dist > e.dist
      end)
    elseif e == "FurthestHealed" then
      table.sort(c, function(c, e)
        local g = c.dist / f
        local h = e.dist / f
        local i = math.max(c.maxHealth or 100, 1)
        local j = math.max(e.maxHealth or 100, 1)
        local k = math.clamp(c.health / i, 0, 1)
        local l = math.clamp(e.health / j, 0, 1)
        local m = .5 * (1 - g) + 0.5 * (1 - k)
        local n = .5 * (1 - h) + .5 * (1 - l)
        if math.abs(m - n) > .001 then
          return m < n
        end
        return c.dist > e.dist
      end)
    else
      table.sort(c, function(c, e)
        if math.abs(c.dist - e.dist) > .01 then
          return c.dist < e.dist
        end
        return c.health < e.health
      end)
    end
    return c[1]
  end
  function getClosestPlayerToMouse()
    local c = v.RevolverAimbot or {}
    local e = c.Radius or 150
    local f = c.Priority or "Nearest"
    local g = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not g then
      return nil
    end
    local h = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    if m then
      h = Vector2.new(g.ViewportSize.X / 2, g.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    end
    local i = localPlayer.Team
    local j = {}
    for f, k in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if k == localPlayer then
        continue
      end
      if i and k.Team == i then
        continue
      end
      local l = k.Character
      local m = l and l:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local n = l and (l:FindFirstChild(c.TargetPart or "UpperTorso") or l:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
      if l and (m and (m.Health > 0 and n)) then
        local c, f = g:WorldToViewportPoint(n.Position)
        if f then
          local f = (Vector2.new(c.X, c.Y) - h).Magnitude
          if f <= e then
            table.insert(j, {
              ["root"] = n,
              ["dist"] = f,
              ["health"] = m.Health,
              ["maxHealth"] = math.max(m.MaxHealth, 1)
            })
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local k = Ic(j, f, e)
    return k and k.root or nil
  end
  function updateFOVCircle()
    local c = v.RevolverAimbot and (v.RevolverAimbot.Enabled and v.RevolverAimbot.ShowFOV)
    local e = v.RevolverAimbot and v.RevolverAimbot.Radius or 150
    local f = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not f then
      return
    end
    local g = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    if m then
      g = Vector2.new(f.ViewportSize.X / 2, f.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    end
    pcall(function()
      if not _G.VD_FovGui or not _G.VD_FovGui.Parent then
        if _G.VD_FovGui then
          pcall(function()
            _G.VD_FovGui:Destroy()
          end)
        end
        _G.VD_FovGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        _G.VD_FovGui.Name = "VD_AimbotFOVScreenGui"
        _G.VD_FovGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        _G.VD_FovGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        if m then
          _G.VD_FovGui.Parent = billboardParent
        else
          pcall(function()
            _G.VD_FovGui.Parent = guiParent
          end)
          if not _G.VD_FovGui.Parent then
            _G.VD_FovGui.Parent = billboardParent
          end
        end
        _G.VD_FovFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
        _G.VD_FovFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
        _G.VD_FovFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        _G.VD_FovFrame.Active = false
        _G.VD_FovFrame.Selectable = false
        _G.VD_FovFrame.Parent = _G.VD_FovGui
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner", _G.VD_FovFrame)
        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(.5, 0)
        local e = Instance.new("UIStroke", _G.VD_FovFrame)
        e.Thickness = 1.5
        e.Color = UI.Accent
        e.Transparency = .4
      end
      if c then
        _G.VD_FovFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, g.X, 0, g.Y)
        _G.VD_FovFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, e * 2, 0, e * 2)
        _G.VD_FovGui.Enabled = true
      else
        _G.VD_FovGui.Enabled = false
      end
    end)
  end
  local Jc = ""
  function updateCrosshair()
    local c = v.ShowCrosshair or v.RevolverAimbot and (v.RevolverAimbot.Enabled and v.RevolverAimbot.ShowCrosshair)
    local e = v.CrosshairStyle or v.RevolverAimbot and v.RevolverAimbot.CrosshairStyle or "Classic"
    local f = v.CrosshairColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
    local g = v.CrosshairSize or 10
    local h = g / 10
    local i = tostring(c) .. "_" .. tostring(e) .. "_" .. tostring(f:ToHex()) .. "_" .. tostring(g)
    if i == Jc and (_G.VD_CrosshairGui and _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent) then
      return
    end
    Jc = i
    pcall(function()
      if _G.VD_CrosshairGui then
        pcall(function()
          _G.VD_CrosshairGui:Destroy()
        end)
        _G.VD_CrosshairGui = nil
      end
      if not c then
        return
      end
      _G.VD_CrosshairGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
      _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Name = "VD_CrosshairScreenGui"
      _G.VD_CrosshairGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
      _G.VD_CrosshairGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
      if m then
        _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent = billboardParent
      else
        pcall(function()
          _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent = guiParent
        end)
        if not _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent then
          _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent = billboardParent
        end
      end
      local g = Instance.new("Frame")
      g.Name = "CenterContainer"
      g.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
      g.Position = UDim2.new(.5, 0, .5, 0)
      g.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
      g.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      g.Parent = _G.VD_CrosshairGui
      local i = e == "Tactical" or e == "Dot" or e == "Dot & Circle"
      local j = e == "Tactical" or e == "Circle" or e == "Dot & Circle"
      local k = e == "Tactical" or e == "Classic"
      if i then
        local c = math.max(2, math.round(3 * h))
        _G.VD_CenterDot = Instance.new("Frame")
        _G.VD_CenterDot.Name = "CenterDot"
        _G.VD_CenterDot.Size = UDim2.new(0, c, 0, c)
        _G.VD_CenterDot.Position = UDim2.new(0, -c / 2, 0, -c / 2)
        _G.VD_CenterDot.BackgroundColor3 = f
        _G.VD_CenterDot.BorderSizePixel = 0
        _G.VD_CenterDot.Parent = g
        local e = Instance.new("UICorner", _G.VD_CenterDot)
        e.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
        local i = Instance.new("UIStroke", _G.VD_CenterDot)
        i.Thickness = 1
        i.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
      end
      if j then
        local c = e == "Circle" and 12 or 14
        local i = math.max(6, math.round(c * h))
        local j = i + 2
        local k = Instance.new("Frame")
        k.Name = "GapCircle"
        k.Size = UDim2.new(0, i, 0, i)
        k.Position = UDim2.new(0, -i / 2, 0, -i / 2)
        k.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        k.Parent = g
        local l = Instance.new("UICorner", k)
        l.CornerRadius = UDim.new(.5, 0)
        local m = Instance.new("UIStroke", k)
        m.Thickness = math.max(1, 1.2 * h)
        m.Color = f
        local n = Instance.new("Frame")
        n.Name = "ShadowCircle"
        n.Size = UDim2.new(0, j, 0, j)
        n.Position = UDim2.new(0, -j / 2, 0, -j / 2)
        n.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        n.Parent = g
        local o = Instance.new("UICorner", n)
        o.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
        local p = Instance.new("UIStroke", n)
        p.Thickness = 1
        p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        p.Transparency = .5
      end
      if k then
        local c = math.max(1, math.round(1.5 * h))
        local i = c / 2
        local j = {}
        if e == "Tactical" then
          local e = math.max(2, math.round(4 * h))
          local f = math.max(4, math.round(9 * h))
          j = {
            {["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, c, 0, e), ["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, -i, 0, -(f + e))},
            {["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, c, 0, e), ["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, -i, 0, f)},
            {["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, e, 0, c), ["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, -(f + e), 0, -i)},
            {["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, e, 0, c), ["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, f, 0, -i)}
          }
        else
          local e = math.max(3, math.round(8 * h))
          local f = math.max(1, math.round(2 * h))
          j = {
            {["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, c, 0, e), ["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, -i, 0, -(f + e))},
            {["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, c, 0, e), ["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, -i, 0, f)},
            {["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, e, 0, c), ["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, -(f + e), 0, -i)},
            {["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, e, 0, c), ["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, f, 0, -i)}
          }
        end
        for c, e in ipairs(j) do
          local h = Instance.new("Frame")
          h.Size = e.Size
          h.Position = e.Position
          h.BackgroundColor3 = f
          h.BorderSizePixel = 0
          h.Parent = g
          local i = Instance.new("UIStroke", h)
          i.Thickness = 1
          i.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        end
      end
      _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Enabled = true
    end)
  end
  function runAimbot()
    local c = v.RevolverAimbot.Enabled
    if not c then
      updateFOVCircle()
      if m then
        updateMobileAimbotButton()
      end
      _G.VD_AimbotTarget = nil
      return
    end
    updateFOVCircle()
    if m then
      updateMobileAimbotButton()
    end
    local e = false
    if m then
      e = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive
    else
      local c = v.RevolverAimbot.Key or "MouseButton2"
      if c == "MouseButton2" then
        e = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2)
      elseif c == "MouseButton1" then
        e = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
      else
        pcall(function()
          e = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[c])
        end)
      end
    end
    if e then
      if not _G.VD_AimbotTarget or not _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Parent or not _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health <= 0 then
        _G.VD_AimbotTarget = getClosestPlayerToMouse()
      end
      if _G.VD_AimbotTarget then
        local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if c then
          local e = _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Position
          if v.RevolverAimbot.PredictionEnabled then
            local f = _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Parent
            local g = f and f:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if g then
              local f = (c.CFrame.Position - e).Magnitude
              local h = v.RevolverAimbot.BulletVelocity or 800
              local i = f / h
              local j = g.AssemblyLinearVelocity
              e = e + j * i
            end
          end
          e = e + c.CFrame.RightVector * ((v.RevolverAimbot.OffsetX or 0) / 10) + c.CFrame.UpVector * ((v.RevolverAimbot.OffsetY or 0) / 10)
          pcall(function()
            local c = localPlayer.Character
            local f = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if f then
              local c = Vector3.new(e.X, f.Position.Y, e.Z)
              f.CFrame = CFrame.new(f.Position, c)
            end
          end)
          local f = CFrame.new(c.CFrame.Position, e)
          local g = v.RevolverAimbot.Smoothness or .15
          if g <= 0 then
            c.CFrame = f
          else
            c.CFrame = c.CFrame:Lerp(f, g)
          end
        end
      end
    else
      _G.VD_AimbotTarget = nil
    end
  end
  RunService:BindToRenderStep("VD_Aimbot", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, runAimbot)
  do
    local e = 0
    local f = false
    local g = nil
    local function h()
      if localPlayer.Team then
        local c = localPlayer.Team.Name:lower()
        if c:find("killer") or c:find("slasher") or c:find("monster") then
          return false
        end
        if c:find("surv") then
          return true
        end
      end
      local c = localPlayer:GetAttribute("Role") or localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:GetAttribute("Role")
      if c == "Killer" or localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true or localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true then
        return false
      end
      local e = localPlayer.Character
      if e and e.Parent then
        local c = e.Parent.Name:lower()
        if c:find("killer") then
          return false
        end
        if c:find("surv") then
          return true
        end
      end
      if c == "Survivor" then
        return true
      end
      if e then
        local c = e.Name:lower()
        if c:find("veil") or c:find("myers") or c:find("stalker") or c:find("killer") or c:find("abyss") then
          return false
        end
      end
      return true
    end
    local function i()
      if not h() then
        return nil
      end
      local c = localPlayer.Character
      if c then
        for c, e in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
          if e:IsA("Tool") or e:IsA("Model") then
            local c = e.Name:lower()
            if c:find("twist") or c:find("fate") or c:find("revolver") or c:find("gun") or e:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or e:FindFirstChild("gun", true) then
              return e
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local e = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
      if e then
        for c, e in ipairs(e:GetChildren()) do
          if e:IsA("Tool") or e:IsA("Model") then
            local c = e.Name:lower()
            if c:find("twist") or c:find("fate") or c:find("revolver") or c:find("gun") or e:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or e:FindFirstChild("gun", true) then
              return e
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
    local function j(c)
      if not c then
        return nil
      end
      for e, f in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
        if f:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") and (f.Name:lower() == "gun" or f.Name:lower():find("twist")) then
          if f.Parent and (f.Parent ~= c and f.Parent.Name ~= "Right Arm") then
            return f.Parent
          end
        end
      end
      local e = c:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
      if e then
        for c, e in ipairs(e:GetChildren()) do
          if e:IsA("Model") then
            return e
          end
        end
        for c, e in ipairs(e:GetChildren()) do
          if e:IsA("BasePart") and e.Name ~= "Right Arm" then
            return e
          end
        end
      end
      for c, e in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
        if e:IsA("Model") and e.Name ~= "Right Arm" then
          return e
        end
      end
      local f = c:FindFirstChild("gun", true)
      if f and not f:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
        return f
      elseif f and (f:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") and f.Parent) then
        return f.Parent
      end
      return c:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart") or c
    end
    local function k()
      local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
      local e = c:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      local f = e and e:FindFirstChild("Items")
      if f then
        local c = f:FindFirstChild("Twist of Fate") or f:FindFirstChild("Revolver")
        local e = c and c:FindFirstChild("Fire")
        if e then
          return e
        end
        for c, e in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do
          local f = e.Name:lower()
          if f:find("twist") or f:find("fate") or f:find("revolver") then
            local c = e:FindFirstChild("Fire")
            if c then
              return c
            end
          end
        end
      end
      for c, e in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
        if e.Name == "Fire" and e.Parent then
          local c = e.Parent.Name:lower()
          if c:find("twist") or c:find("fate") or c:find("revolver") then
            return e
          end
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
    local function l(c)
      pcall(function()
        local e = localPlayer.Character
        local f = e and e:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if f then
          local c = Instance.new("Animation")
          c.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://124735239320776"
          local e = f:LoadAnimation(c)
          e:Play()
        end
        if c then
          local e = c:FindFirstChild("shoot", true)
          if e and e:IsA("Sound") then
            e:Play()
          end
        end
      end)
    end
    local function n()
      pcall(function()
        local c = localPlayer.Character
        local e = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if e and not g then
          local c = Instance.new("Animation")
          c.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://75029269564639"
          g = e:LoadAnimation(c)
          g:Play()
        end
        if c then
          c:SetAttribute("Aiming", true)
        end
        local f = i()
        local h = j(f)
        local k = h and h:FindFirstChild("equip", true)
        if k and k:IsA("Sound") then
          k:Play()
        end
      end)
    end
    local function o()
      pcall(function()
        if g then
          g:Stop()
          g = nil
        end
        local c = localPlayer.Character
        if c then
          c:SetAttribute("Aiming", false)
        end
      end)
    end
    local function p()
      if not (v.BypassToFRestrictions and (q("BypassToFRestrictions") and (c and c.BypassToFRestrictions))) then
        return
      end
      if not h() then
        return
      end
      if not f then
        return
      end
      local g = localPlayer.Character
      local m = g and g:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not m or m.Health <= 0 then
        return
      end
      local n = i()
      if not n then
        return
      end
      local o = j(n)
      if not o then
        return
      end
      local p = tick()
      if p - e < .35 then
        return
      end
      e = p
      local r = k()
      if not r then
        return
      end
      local s = workspace.CurrentCamera
      local t = s and s.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
      if v.RevolverSilentAim and (v.RevolverSilentAim.Enabled and q()) then
        pcall(function()
          local c = nil
          local e = math.huge
          local f = v.RevolverSilentAim.FOVRadius or 200
          local g = Vector2.new(s.ViewportSize.X / 2, s.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
          for h, i in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if i ~= localPlayer and i.Character then
              local h = i.Character
              local j = h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
              local k = h:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or h:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or h:FindFirstChild("Head")
              if j and (j.Health > 0 and k) then
                local j = i:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or i:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true or h:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or h:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
                local l = v.RevolverSilentAim.Target or "Both Teams"
                local m = false
                if l == "Both Teams" then
                  m = true
                elseif l == "Killer" and j then
                  m = true
                elseif l == "Survivors" and not j then
                  m = true
                end
                if m then
                  local i, j = s:WorldToViewportPoint(k.Position)
                  if j or i.Z > 0 then
                    local j = (Vector2.new(i.X, i.Y) - g).Magnitude
                    if j <= f and j < e then
                      e = j
                      c = h
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
          if c then
            local e = c:FindFirstChild("Head") or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if e then
              local c = s.CFrame.Position
              t = (e.Position - c).Unit
            end
          end
        end)
      end
      pcall(function()
        local c = (vector and vector.create or Vector3.new)(t.X, t.Y, t.Z)
        r:FireServer(o, c)
        l(o)
      end)
    end
    local r = nil
    local s = nil
    local t = nil
    local u = nil
    local w = false
    local function x()
      if not m then
        return false
      end
      local e = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
      if not e then
        return false
      end
      local g = e:FindFirstChild("Survivor-mob") or e:FindFirstChild("SurvivorMob")
      if not g then
        for c, e in ipairs(e:GetChildren()) do
          if e:IsA("ScreenGui") and (e.Name:lower():find("survivor") or e.Name:lower():find("mob")) then
            g = e
            break
          end
        end
      end
      if not g then
        return false
      end
      local j = g:FindFirstChild("Controls", true)
      local k = j and j:FindFirstChild("Gui-mob", true)
      if not k then
        k = g:FindFirstChild("Gui-mob", true)
      end
      local l = k and k:FindFirstChild("icon", true)
      local r = k and k:FindFirstChild("cancelaim", true) or g:FindFirstChild("cancelaim", true)
      local s = l or k
      if not s then
        return false
      end
      if u == s then
        return true
      end
      u = s
      pcall(function()
        if s:IsA("GuiObject") then
          s.Active = true
        end
        if s.Parent and s.Parent:IsA("GuiObject") then
          s.Parent.Active = true
        end
      end)
      local function t(e)
        if not e or not e:IsA("GuiObject") then
          return
        end
        e.InputBegan:Connect(function(e)
          if e.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or e.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            if not h() then
              return
            end
            if not (v.BypassToFRestrictions and (q("BypassToFRestrictions") and (c and c.BypassToFRestrictions))) then
              return
            end
            local g = i()
            if not g then
              return
            end
            w = false
            f = true
            n()
            if r then
              pcall(function()
                r.Visible = true
              end)
            end
            local j
            j = e.Changed:Connect(function()
              if e.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Change then
                if r and r.Visible then
                  local c = r.AbsolutePosition
                  local g = r.AbsoluteSize
                  local h, i = e.Position.X, e.Position.Y
                  if h >= c.X and (h <= c.X + g.X and (i >= c.Y and i <= c.Y + g.Y)) then
                    if not w then
                      w = true
                      f = false
                      o()
                    end
                  end
                end
              elseif e.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                if j then
                  j:Disconnect()
                end
                if w then
                  w = false
                  f = false
                  o()
                else
                  if f then
                    p()
                  end
                  f = false
                  o()
                end
              end
            end)
          end
        end)
      end
      t(s)
      if s.Parent and (s.Parent:IsA("GuiObject") and (s.Parent ~= j and s.Parent ~= g)) then
        t(s.Parent)
      end
      if r and r:IsA("GuiObject") then
        pcall(function()
          r.Active = true
        end)
        r.InputBegan:Connect(function(c)
          if c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or c.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            w = true
            f = false
            o()
          end
        end)
        if r:IsA("GuiButton") then
          r.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            w = true
            f = false
            o()
          end)
          r.Activated:Connect(function()
            w = true
            f = false
            o()
          end)
        end
      end
      return true
    end
    local function y()
      if not m then
        return
      end
      local e = i()
      local g = e and (v.BypassToFRestrictions and (q("BypassToFRestrictions") and (c and (c.BypassToFRestrictions and h()))))
      if not g then
        if r and r.Parent then
          r.Enabled = false
        end
        if f then
          f = false
          o()
        end
        return
      end
      local j = false
      pcall(function()
        j = x()
      end)
      if j or u and u.Parent then
        if r and r.Parent then
          r.Enabled = false
        end
        return
      end
      local k = guiParent or localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
      if not k then
        return
      end
      if not r or not r.Parent then
        r = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        r.Name = "VD_MobileWeaponHUD"
        r.ResetOnSpawn = false
        r.DisplayOrder = 99996
        pcall(function()
          r.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        end)
        r.Parent = k
        s = Instance.new("TextButton")
        s.Name = "MobileAimButton"
        s.Size = UDim2.new(0, 56, 0, 56)
        s.Position = UDim2.new(1, -145, 1, -190)
        s.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 30)
        s.BackgroundTransparency = .25
        s.Text = "AIM"
        s.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 220)
        s.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        s.TextSize = 13
        s.AutoButtonColor = false
        s.Parent = r
        Instance.new("UICorner", s).CornerRadius = UDim.new(.5, 0)
        local c = Instance.new("UIStroke", s)
        c.Color = UI.StrokeDim
        c.Thickness = 1.2

  local Kc = nil
  local Lc = setmetatable({}, {["__mode"] = "k"})
  function getSmoothedVelocity(c, e, f)
    local g = Lc[c]
    local h = tick()
    local i = e
    if f and (typeof(f) == "Instance" and f:IsA("BasePart")) then
      if g and (g.lastPos and (h - g.time > .001 and h - g.time < .5)) then
        local c = h - g.time
        i = (f.Position - g.lastPos) / c
      end
    end
    if e.Magnitude < .5 and i.Magnitude < 0.5 then
      if not g then
        g = {}
        Lc[c] = g
      end
      g.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
      g.time = h
      g.lastPos = f and (typeof(f) == "Instance" and f:IsA("BasePart")) and f.Position or nil
      return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end
    if i.Magnitude > 60 then
      i = e
    end
    if e.Magnitude > 60 then
      e = i.Magnitude <= 60 and i or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end
    local j = e:Lerp(i, .5)
    if j.Magnitude > 40 then
      j = j.Unit * 40
    end
    if not g or h - g.time > .5 then
      if not g then
        g = {}
        Lc[c] = g
      end
      g.velocity = j
      g.time = h
      g.lastPos = f and (typeof(f) == "Instance" and f:IsA("BasePart")) and f.Position or nil
      return j
    end
    if g.velocity and (g.velocity.Magnitude > 1.5 and j.Magnitude > 1.5) then
      local c = g.velocity.Unit:Dot(j.Unit)
      if c < .25 then
        g.velocity = j
        g.time = h
        g.lastPos = f and (typeof(f) == "Instance" and f:IsA("BasePart")) and f.Position or nil
        return j
      end
    end
    local k = .45
    local l = g.velocity:Lerp(j, k)
    if l.Magnitude < .2 then
      l = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    elseif l.Magnitude > 32 then
      l = l.Unit * 32
    end
    g.velocity = l
    g.time = h
    g.lastPos = f and (typeof(f) == "Instance" and f:IsA("BasePart")) and f.Position or nil
    return l
  end
  local function Mc()
    local c, e = pcall(function()
      return game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing()
    end)
    if c and (type(e) == "number" and e > 0) then
      return math.clamp(e * .5, 0, .25)
    end
    return .035
  end
  function solveProjectileAim(c, e, f, g, h, i)
    local j = h and h > 50 and h or 150
    local k = i and i > 0 and i or 98
    local l = f or Vector3.zero
    local m = Vector3.new(l.X, 0, l.Z)
    local n = math.clamp(l.Y, -4, 1.5)
    local o = Vector3.new(m.X, n, m.Z)
    local p = Mc()
    local q = (e - c).Magnitude
    local r = q / j
    local s = e
    for f = 1, 4, 1 do
      local h = r + p
      local i = o * h
      local l = 32 * h
      if i.Magnitude > l then
        i = i.Unit * l
      end
      s = e + i + .5 * (g or Vector3.zero) * h ^ 2
      local m = s - c
      local n = Vector3.new(m.X, 0, m.Z).Magnitude
      local q = m.Y
      if k == 0 then
        r = m.Magnitude / j
      else
        local c = .25 * k ^ 2
        local e = q * k - j ^ 2
        local f = n ^ 2 + q ^ 2
        local g = e ^ 2 - 4 * c * f
        if g >= 0 then
          local f = (-e - math.sqrt(g)) / (2 * c)
          local h = (-e + math.sqrt(g)) / (2 * c)
          local i = -1
          if f > 0 and h > 0 then
            i = math.min(f, h)
          elseif f > 0 then
            i = f
          elseif h > 0 then
            i = h
          end
          if i > 0 then
            r = math.sqrt(i)
          else
            r = m.Magnitude / j
          end
        else
          r = m.Magnitude / j
          break
        end
      end
    end
    local t = s - c
    local u = Vector3.new(0, -k, 0)
    local v = (t - .5 * u * r ^ 2) / r
    return v.Unit, s
  end
  _G.VD_SolveProjectileAim = solveProjectileAim

    task.spawn(function()
      f()
