    local i = "/api/log"
    local j = {}
    local k = {}
    local function m(c)
      local e = c:lower()
      return e:find("https?://") ~= nil or e:find("www%.") ~= nil or e:find(".com") ~= nil or e:find(".net") ~= nil or e:find(".gg") ~= nil or e:find(".io") ~= nil or e:find(".xyz") ~= nil or e:find("discord") ~= nil
    end
    local function n(c)
      local e = c:gsub("%s+", "")
      if e:match("^%d+$") then
        return true
      end
      if not c:find("%s") and (e:match("^[a-z0-9]+$") and #e <= 20) then
        return true
      end
      if not c:find("%s") and #e <= 15 then
        return true
      end
      return false
    end
    function sendSuggestionMessage(c)
      local e = tostring(localPlayer.UserId)
      if k[e] then
        showNotification("Suggestion Blocked", "You have been blocked from sending suggestions.", "error")
        return
      end
      if m(c) then
        showNotification("Suggestion Blocked", "Links are not allowed in suggestions.", "error")
        return
      end
      if n(c) then
        j[e] = (j[e] or 0) + 1
        if j[e] >= 3 then
          k[e] = true
          showNotification("Suggestion Blocked", "You have been blocked from sending suggestions.", "error")
        else
          showNotification("Suggestion", "Please write a meaningful suggestion.", "warning")
        end
        return
      end
      local f = "https://www.roblox.com/headshot-thumbnail/image?userId=" .. e .. "&width=150&height=150&format=png"
      pcall(function()
        local c = getRequestFunction()
        if c then
          local g = c({
            ["Url"] = "https://thumbnails.roproxy.com/v1/users/avatar-headshot?userIds=" .. e .. "&size=150x150&format=Png&isCircular=false",
            ["Method"] = "GET"
          })
          if g and g.Body then
            local c = httpService:JSONDecode(g.Body)
            if c and (c.data and c.data[1]) then
              f = c.data[1].imageUrl
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      local g = {
        ["author"] = {
        ["name"] = string.format("%s (@%s)", localPlayer.DisplayName, localPlayer.Name),
        ["icon_url"] = f,
        ["url"] = "https://www.roblox.com/users/" .. e .. "/profile"
      },
        ["title"] = "New Suggestion",
        ["description"] = c,
        ["color"] = 9066495,
        ["thumbnail"] = {["url"] = f},
        ["fields"] = {{["name"] = "Executor", ["value"] = "`" .. l() .. "`", ["inline"] = false}},
        ["footer"] = {["text"] = "6locc Scripts \226\128\162 Violence District"},
        ["timestamp"] = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
      }
      makeRequest(i, "POST", httpService:JSONEncode({["embeds"] = {g}}))
    end
  end)()

            local c = (h - f) / l
            local g = (j - h) / m
            local i = (g - c) / l

            local n = 0.25

              if e then

                end

                end
              end
            end

            _G.VD_SpecialSpearGravity = o
          end
        end)

          if e then
            local f, h = pcall(function()
              local f = c:IsA("Model") and c:GetPivot().Position or c.Position
              return (f - e.Position).Magnitude
            end)

              g()
            end
          end
        end

    local function I()
      local c = localPlayer.Character
      if not c then
        return false, 0
      end
      local e = c:GetAttribute("MorphedKiller") == "Veil" or c:GetAttribute("Veil") == true or c:FindFirstChild("Spear") ~= nil
      if not e then
        return false, 0

      if not f then
        return false, 0
      end
      if not G or getfenv and getfenv(G).script ~= f then
        G = nil
        local c = os.clock()
        if c - H < 3 then
          return false, 0
        end
        H = c
        if typeof(getgc) == "function" then
          for c, e in ipairs(getgc()) do
            if type(e) == "function" and (not islclosure or islclosure(e)) then
              if debug.info(e, "n") == "endAttack" and getfenv(e).script == f then
                G = e
                break
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if G and typeof(getupvalues) == "function" then
        local a, b = pcall(getupvalues, G)
        if a and b then
          local a = b[2] == true
          local c = tonumber(b[9]) or 0
          return a, c
        end
      end
      return false, 0
    end

        local c, e = I()
        local h = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        local i = 1
        if c and e > 0 then
          i = math.max(p.MinChargeTime, h - e)
        else
          i = p.FullChargeTime
        end
        local j = math.clamp(i * p.MaxSpeed, 1, p.MaxSpeed)
        local k = g.CFrame.Position + g.CFrame.LookVector * p.SpawnOffset
        local l = g.CFrame.LookVector

        if v.SpearAimbot and (v.SpearAimbot.Enabled and (Kc and (Kc.Parent and q()))) then

        local t = l * j

        P.FilterDescendantsInstances = {f, g, w}
        local A = {k}
        local B = p.StepDt
        for c = 1, p.SegmentsCount, 1 do
          local e = c * B
          local f = k + t * e + .5 * u * (e * e)
          table.insert(A, f)
        end

  local function Oc(c)
    local e, f = math.huge, math.huge
    local g, h = -math.huge, -math.huge
    local i = false
    for j, k in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
      if k:IsA("GuiObject") and (k.Name:find("^Survivor%d+$") and k.Visible) then
        i = true
        local j = k.AbsolutePosition - c.AbsolutePosition
        local l = k.AbsoluteSize
        local m = j.X
        local n = j.Y
        local o = l.X
        local p = l.Y
        if m < e then
          e = m
        end
        if n < f then
          f = n
        end
        if m + o > g then
          g = m + o
        end
        if n + p > h then
          h = n + p
        end
      end
    end
    if i and (g > e and h > f) then
      return UDim2.new(0, e, 0, f), UDim2.new(0, g - e, 0, h - f)
    end
    return nil, nil
  end

  local Pc = nil
  local function Qc(c)
    if not activeLoop then
      return
    end
    pcall(function()
      local e = workspace.CurrentCamera
      if not e then
        return
      end
      local f = v.CameraStiffnessEnabled
      local g = f and v.CameraStiffness or 1
      if f and (g and (type(g) == "number" and (g < .999 and g > 0))) then
        local f = e.CFrame.Position
        local h = e.CFrame - f
        if Pc then
          if (f - Pc).Magnitude > 60 then
            Pc = f
          end
          local i = math.clamp(c or .016666666666667, .001, .1)
          local j = math.clamp(g, .005, 1) * 45
          local k = math.clamp(1 - math.exp(-j * i), .001, 1)
          local l = Pc:Lerp(f, k)
          e.CFrame = CFrame.new(l) * h
          Pc = l
        else
          Pc = f
        end
      else
        Pc = e.CFrame.Position
      end
      local h = v.AspectRatioEnabled
      local i = h and v.AspectRatio or 1.7777777777778
      if h and (not i and v.StretchedResolutionMode) then
        local c = {
          ["4:3"] = 1.3333333333333,
          ["5:4"] = 1.25,
          ["16:10"] = 1.6,
          ["21:9"] = 2.3333333333333,
          ["Normal"] = 1.7777777777778,
          ["16:9"] = 1.7777777777778
        }
        i = c[v.StretchedResolutionMode] or 1.7777777777778
      end
      i = i or 1.7777777777778
      local j = 1.7777777777778
      local k = h and math.abs(i - j) > .03
      local l = v.FOV > 120 or k
      if not l then
        if e.FieldOfView ~= v.FOV then
          e.FieldOfView = v.FOV
        end
        local c = e.CFrame
        if c.X ~= c.X or c.Y ~= c.Y or c.Z ~= c.Z then
          return
        end
        if c.RightVector.Magnitude < .01 or c.UpVector.Magnitude < .01 then
          return
        end
        if c.RightVector.Magnitude > 1.001 or c.RightVector.Magnitude < .999 or c.UpVector.Magnitude > 1.001 or c.UpVector.Magnitude < .999 then
          e.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(c.Position, c.RightVector.Unit, c.UpVector.Unit)
        end
        return
      end
      local m = 1
      local n = 1
      if k then
        if i < j then
          m = 1
          n = math.clamp(i / j, .1, 1)
        else
          m = math.clamp(j / i, .1, 1)
          n = 1
        end
      end
      local o = math.min(v.FOV, 120)
      if e.FieldOfView ~= o then
        e.FieldOfView = o
      end
      local p = 1
      if v.FOV > 120 then
        local c = math.rad(v.FOV / 2)
        local e = math.rad(o / 2)
        p = math.tan(e) / math.tan(c)
      end
      local q = e.CFrame
      if q.X ~= q.X or q.Y ~= q.Y or q.Z ~= q.Z then
        return
      end
      if q.RightVector.Magnitude < .01 or q.UpVector.Magnitude < .01 then
        return
      end
      local r = CFrame.fromMatrix(q.Position, q.RightVector.Unit, q.UpVector.Unit)
      local s = p * m
      local t = p * n
      if s ~= s or t ~= t or s == 0 or t == 0 then
        return
      end
      e.CFrame = r * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, s, 0, 0, 0, t, 0, 0, 0, 1)
    end)
  end

      elseif l == "Twist of Fate" and k then
        m = "Revolver"
      elseif (l == "Veil Spear" or j) and not k then
        m = "Spear"
      else
        if j then
          m = "Spear"
        elseif k then
          m = "Revolver"
        end
      end
      if not m then
        return nil, nil
      end
      local n = m == "Spear" and (v.SpearSilentAim.FOVRadius or 240) or (v.RevolverSilentAim.FOVRadius or 200)
      local o = m == "Spear" and "Both Teams" or (v.RevolverSilentAim.Target or "Both Teams")
      local p = {}
      for c, g in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if g ~= localPlayer and (g.Character and g.Character:IsA("Model")) then
          local c = g.Team and g.Team.Name or ""
          local h = m == "Spear" or o == "Both Teams" or o == "Survivors" and c == "Survivors" or o == "Killer" and c == "Killer"
          if h then
            local c = g.Character
            local h = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild(targetPartName) or c:IsA("Model") and c.PrimaryPart
            local i = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if h and (i and i.Health > 0) then
              local j, k = e:WorldToViewportPoint(h.Position)
              if k and j.Z > 0 then
                local e = (Vector2.new(j.X, j.Y) - f).Magnitude
                if e <= n then
                  table.insert(p, {
                    ["player"] = g,
                    ["character"] = c,
                    ["part"] = h,
                    ["dist"] = e,
                    ["health"] = i.Health,
                    ["maxHealth"] = i.MaxHealth or 100
                  })
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local r = m == "Spear" and (v.SpearSilentAim.Priority or "Nearest") or (v.RevolverSilentAim.Priority or "Nearest")
      local s = Ic(p, r, n)
      if s then
        g = s.character
        i = m
      end
      return g, i
    end
    get2DBoundingBox = function(c)
      local e = workspace.CurrentCamera
      if not e or not c then
        return nil
      end
      local f = c:FindFirstChild("Head")
      local g = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:IsA("Model") and c.PrimaryPart
      if not g then
        return nil
      end
      local h = f and f.Position + Vector3.new(0, .7, 0) or g.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0)
      local i = g.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
      local j, k = e:WorldToViewportPoint(h)
      local l, m = e:WorldToViewportPoint(i)
      local n, o = e:WorldToViewportPoint(g.Position)
      if not o or n.Z <= 0 then
        return nil
      end
      local p = math.abs(l.Y - j.Y)
      local q = math.clamp(p * .6, 12, 350)
      if p < 6 then
        return nil
      end
      return n.X - q / 2, j.Y, q, p
    end
    updateSilentAimTargetHighlight = function()
      local f = v.SpearSilentAim and (v.SpearSilentAim.Enabled and q())
      local g = v.RevolverSilentAim and (v.RevolverSilentAim.Enabled and q())
      if not f and not g then
        if e.frame and e.frame.Visible then
          e.frame.Visible = false
        end
        return
      end
      setupTargetBoxGui()
      local h, i = nil, nil
      pcall(function()
        h, i = getSilentAimTarget()
      end)
      if h and (i and e.frame) then
        local f, g, j, k = get2DBoundingBox(h)
        if f and (g and (j and k)) then
          local h = i == "Spear" and v.SpearSilentAim or v.RevolverSilentAim
          local l = h.TargetHighlightColor or (i == "Spear" and "Red" or "Cyan")
          local m = c[l] or (i == "Spear" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 240, 255))
          e.frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, f, 0, g)
          e.frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, j, 0, k)
          e.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          local n = math.clamp(math.floor(j * .25), 6, 16)
          local o = e.corners
          if o.TL_H then
            o.TL_H.Size = UDim2.new(0, n, 0, 2.5)
          end
          if o.TR_H then
            o.TR_H.Size = UDim2.new(0, n, 0, 2.5)
          end
          if o.BL_H then
            o.BL_H.Size = UDim2.new(0, n, 0, 2.5)
          end
          if o.BR_H then
            o.BR_H.Size = UDim2.new(0, n, 0, 2.5)
          end
          if o.TL_V then
            o.TL_V.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2.5, 0, n)
          end
          if o.TR_V then
            o.TR_V.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2.5, 0, n)
          end
          if o.BL_V then
            o.BL_V.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2.5, 0, n)
          end
          if o.BR_V then
            o.BR_V.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2.5, 0, n)
          end
          for c, e in pairs(o) do
            if e then
              e.BackgroundColor3 = m
              e.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            end
          end
          e.frame.Visible = true
          return
        end
      end
      if e.frame and e.frame.Visible then
        e.frame.Visible = false
      end
    end
    registerConnection(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
      if updateSilentAimTargetHighlight then
        updateSilentAimTargetHighlight()
      end
    end))
  end)()
end)(...)
